We had great customer service from Ted the driver and our guide Steve even though there were some technical issues both were professional and more importantly were personal, after our tour on the bus Steve even walked us to the tube and checked that the line we needed to use as there had been many cancellations.

The tour was on a different route due to raiders closures but we didn’t feel like we missed out due to the added information and knowledge from Steve. When being told by Ted when we got on the bus that the route would be different we were both apprehensive but this experience turned out to be really unique and was worth doing.

I tried the 2 day (an extended version) London hop on / off tour’s with Golden gate and I was not sorry for it.

You realize that the things you had seen, entered and passed through actually have a story behind. The guides in the buses give you those tiny but most precious stories behind each and every cobblestone left unturned in London.
I would certainly recommend it because you will be very surprised to hear those details about the streets you are Otherwise obliviously Passing by.

I would also would like to thank from here to My tour guide Danxia and her lovely colleague (our driver) mariusz for the lovely company they kept.

Just a recommendation, to use the buses and understand the starting and ending time of the schedule could easily be accessed through the official website.

I booked 2 x 3 day tours with London Eye and river cruise twice and both times it failed, I was then asked to rebook whilst waiting up to 15 days for a refund. I refused to pay again as they had taken the money and 15 days for a refund is a joke in this day and age. Over 3 weeks later I am still waiting for a refund and they have stopped answering any messages, which you can only do through an online chat.
Absolutely appalling customer service and I would advise anybody to avoid this company like the plague.

My sister and I only had 2 days in central London to see the sights so getting in on the Hop-on Hop-off Big Bus tours was ideal for us. We were able to see lots of sights in that short amount of time. We did two of the bus tours, and the river cruise (tour guide provided on that), then one walking tour. We planned to take the 3rd bus tour but changed our mind and joined another walking tour. Those two walking tours, led by Julia, were so much better than the bus tours because we had an actual tour guide who was so informative, fun, and took us so many interesting places that we probably would have never seen or learned about. On top of that, we could interact with her and ask questions, thereby learning so much more. The bus tours only provided a recording. They would have been so much better if we had an actual tour guide like Julia on the bus. Big Bus Tour company, get more tour guides! Your patrons will appreciate it.

The big bus tour is a very poorly run business. Information is very spotty on how to use it. They give you a flyer with the numbered stops on it but nowhere on it does it tell you what the stops are. The only way you know is if you go online and look for the number on their website. Very cumbersome when they could have just put it on the flyer. Then they have 2 different red routes and don't distinguish which bus is going which direction. Was told by employees several times the bus we were on was going west when in fact it was going east and we were stuck on it.
We got 9ff and took the tube to our destination.
One day we were on it and they just stopped and said everyone had to get off the bus because the driver was over their allowed driving hours. We all transferred to a different bus and went 2 stops before they told us to get off the bus because traffic was so bad it would probably take an hour to get to the next stop and we were better off to walk. No mention of a credit or even an apology.
There are 2 other tour bus companies that were passing us all day and didn't seem to have the problems the Big Bus was having.
I would recommend you use those companies instead.

This was a disheartening tour. With the cost of the tickets, one would think it was fabulous.

Things BigBus can do better:
1. Stop at all the stops listed on the map. The drivers skipped a number of stops and never explained to anyone that they had eliminated stops clearly listed on their brochure. On the last day a patron asked about one of the stops and the driver yelled at him and told him it had been eliminated months ago. Yet... it is still listed as a stop. Get your walking shoes if you want to see Buckingham Palace because they CUT the stop from their tour.
2. The Night Tour. Don't waste your time. It is the exact same tour as the day tours without stops. In short, it is exactly like the Hotel California. You might never be able to get off the bus. We paid for the river tour, but somehow ended up with the night tour instead. Talk about a disappointment! Two hours of the same thing we did all day repeated.
3. The commentary is awful! Get some commentary that is informative, doesn't lower the IQ of those listening, and is enjoyable. A woman yelling into a microphone while you go past sites is not lovely.
4. We never knew which stop we were at because the drivers were skipping stops, adding random stops in, and the stops were never announced.
5. Drivers were horrible. Not all of them, but some of them yelled at customers out of frustration, but hey, everyone was frustrated. We paid for a ticket and sat in traffic. We constantly had to show our tickets each time we boarded and then we couldn't get to our seats before the driver jerked the bus forward and made us stumble to our seats.
6. The volume on the headsets didn't work all the time. So there were times when the commentary was so loud it nearly killed our eardrums.

Things out of Big Bus's control, but are important to note (This has nothing to do with the 2-star review)
1. Traffic in London is highly congested and it takes most of the day to do one round. So you will likely not see more than a few stops.

We loved our experience with Big Bus London!
The stops were easy to find and they have associates at every stop ready to answer questions.
The buses were super frequent so we never felt stranded at any stop.
Every ticket includes a river cruise and walking tour!

Loved taking the Red Line for live commentary!
Most hosts did a great job narrating the sights as we drove along, save for one bus where the guide had just given up and sat there grouchily telling everyone to sit down.
Otherwise, every employee we encountered was awesome.

The included river cruise was so lovely. Sailed from Tower Bridge to the London Eye, which was recommended by an associate and what a great idea! Perfect way to snap crowd-less photos.

We did the walking tour with Phil and he was incredible! It’s obvious he adores his hometown and having a history buff take you around a historic city like London was such a treat.
We only wish the tour was longer so we could learn even more from Phil! Superb!

Poorly managed. Staff let people board when there are no open seats. They give you a map showing numbered stops, but never announce the stop number. You need to charge up your phone and download their app or you won't know where you are. There wan no audio at our seats on our blue route bus - no announcement and no apology. The red route bus audio was working, but it wasn't much improvement - the narrative had more childish jokes than history. The audio wasn't linked to the bus location. Not very helpful to hear that 10 Downing St wad somewhere nearby. Staff tried to be helpful, but it didn't compensate for poor management.

Used this company via a voucher off Wowcher. When we found somebody who could validate the digital tickets, he told me off for not printing the voucher off first. he did validate it but I felt suitably told off!!!
the 1st bus we got on had no room upstairs, the driver told us to get off and get on the 1 behind, there would be room, but nope no room on there either, so we sat split up, not ideal with a 9 year old with us, which spoiled it as we wanted to share the experience with him. We got off near the Shard, when we came back to the stop to get carry on our tour, we waited over 30 mins....says every 20....even live tracking on the app didn't seem to know where it was! we managed to sit together on this trip. an informative tour, but either more buses needed or more drivers.

Today is 9/14/22. The Queen’s funeral this week has caused many street closures so Big buses couldn’t run their normal routes and so many stops were closed and guess what? They didn’t update their app or their website so guess what, went to Green Park station which was CLOSED. Already bought 2 tickets online and then had to walk to Victoria station to get a bus then had to get off again! This is the worst tour bus ever! I want a refund!!!! I cant use the 2 nd day ticket with all these stops closed down. Traffic is worse than anywhere I have ever been!

Our evening tour had a live guide, Steve, and it was great! He was funny and informative and interacted with all the guests. It was so much better than the boring audio guide! Using the bus during the day was ok. We just used it as transportation to get from one spot to another. The busses came pretty frequently and we never had much of a wait for one. The one big negative is that it only runs in one direction.

I have been on the big bus tours in several different countries. I like this tour especially in London. Everyone was so friendly and helpful. The tour always provides a complete around town or city experience.

I was on the Red Route Bus with Karen as the live commentary and Tarik I think as the driver.

Karen was knowledgeable, helpful and accommodating. It was a real pleasure to be on the bus with her as she took time to answer questions that I had and did not get upset with questions I could have Googled. Thank you Karen. You are a lovely guide. The company should be proud of you.

The driver gave us a smooth ride and seemed to know the route very well and gave us a good opportunity to view the monuments and attractions without losing time. Thank you Tarik.

I am definitely going to recommend this route and bus to my friends and colleagues.

Tell me how to avoid London traffic in the heat and all issues will be solved.
Unfortunately we spent 20 minutes just to make a left turn at Westminster Bridge and an additional 15 to get through 3 traffic signals.
In short the ride and commentary were boring.
Not so for the cruise. The commentary was pithy.
My advice is to forget theBus and sign up for any number cruises on the Thames

Great sites and historical interest to be had.. To save money they have got rid of the live commentary and knowledgeable guides…. Now we have a cheesy pathetic recording from a trio of third rate actors….. perfect for under 5s… SHOCKING!!!!!!

We took the Big Bus option for 3 days which included
- Boat Tour: Excelente with a guide that was funny and detailed in his explanation.
- Night Tour: didn´t like it too much because the guide on 18/08 after I informed him that half of the bus couldn't hear him scrubbed it off and didn´t care.
- We did also de two walking tours and those were exceptionally good if not the best attraction on the Big Bus experience. The Guide Julia was very patient and informative, she made a difference.
The rest of the Big Bus trips was good but there was a lot of traffic because of a railway strike.

The live guide Phil’s narration was really a very interesting and entertaining with a great knowledge of history. We could compare it to audio guide. He’s a very positive and friendly person as well. It was a good fun to listen to him. His Russian friends)

Purchased a ticket for bus tours with Madame Tussaud’s , the gentleman on Baker Street am 11/01/ 20 on big bus tours was so rude to me and my family , he seemed completely disinterested from the time he realises we weren’t buying tickets with him but already purchased them . He walked off from us several times and when I asked about the free carers place he laughed and slated the company we booked with . Seemed we were a bit of inconvenience to this man to be honest so much so that we actually didn’t use our tickets for the tour and didnt go on the tour that we had purchased . :(

Worst thing we spent our money on.. Three stops neare Oxford Street were closed and we did not get any notice on this. We jumped off to go shopping and to hop on at another stop, which for the moment did not excised, we had to rund around for 1,5h ant ultimately went back to where we first jumped off… All this to find out that this bus (that the driver said was the red route going towards tower bridge) went back to picadilly and we had to jump off and have lunch before going to the airport… This was completely waist on our money and time! NOT TO RECOMMEND.. Stressed out drivers who answers questions without even listening, aelling tickets just to sell without thinking of costumers at all… TERRIBLE!

We booked the 2-day tour for 2/15/2020 and 2/16/2020. The guided tour was almost non-existent. We had possibly 2 tour guides that actually spoke over the 2 day period (they were both good). Also, I wouldn’t expect state of the art headphones but what was offered was ridiculous. We kept switching them out as the sound quality was so poor you couldn’t hear. The pre-recorded tour info was ok but it was often out of sync with the sites and there was more music played than anything. The buses were also very crowded. No one should have to stand on a guided tour bus. If you’re standing you don’t have access to a headphone jack. Therefore you can’t listen to anything. This was completely unacceptable. We also noticed the bus skipped stops and we were only offered the walking tour once over the 2 days. Do yourself a favor and buy an Oyster Card. The London Underground is very easy to navigate and you can explore the sites on your own.

I took part in a city walk tour with Nick who was our tour guided. Nick was enthusiastic, knowledgable and very engaging throughout. I thoroughly recommend anyone to join one of his tours, whether you have been to London before or not, you are guaranteed to learn something new.

I would probably do it again, but not for more than one day. If you get on early you can get a spot on the roof, but they filled up as the day went on. I would suggest doing this earlier in the day as we got stuck in late afternoon London traffic. The audio did not work great in all the buses, so I would suggest using your own headphones. They have people "helping" at the transfer points, but that didn't prevent me from getting on the wrong route as the buses are poorly marked. I would also note that I was with someone who uses a cane to assist her in walking and most of the drivers did not take that into consideration when they slammed on the gas like they were leaving a Formula-1 pit stop before the guests are seated.

Took a big bus tour £81 for two combi ticket with madam Tussauds. But felt it was a waste of money ( the bus ride) spent most of it spent sat in very slow traffic . Tube ( London Underground ) & walking are better options. For touring London’s sights

The buses are very slow and reroute without notice. You can walk anywhere these buses go by walking and get there faster. There is no live commentary. Way overpriced. WE PURCHASED 5 three day passes but our 5th person canceled his trip. Big Bus would not refund for the one not used even giving a months notice! You’re better off walking or taking the subway.

Routes great, service awful. We were asked to transfer to a different bus and made to sit on the new bus for 20 minutes before leaving. Bus frequency on the Green line was reduced due to inclement weather that never came, delaying our trip 45 minutes. At many stops there were no staff there, and we sat and watched multiple buses of other companies roll by. Audio at many seats didn't work. There were bus guides who barely said anything on the red route. At the end of the day we witnessed a driver arguing with other passengers when there was a simple misunderstanding that could have been resolved if he'd calmed down and explained things. After this the driver argued and swore at co-workers in person on the street and over his radio. I have a video of the confrontation which was completely unprofessional. I would recommend using the tube and not wasting your money.

Overall the experience was average with some frustrating parts of the bus unexpectedly stopping in the middle of nowhere, but what really bumped it up for me was the free walking tour included for the changing of the guards. Julia was amazing! It was a crazy day with the heat and it seemed like things were not going according to the hundreds of year old plan, but Julia handled it like a champ and got us in great spots to see everything. She answered all of our questions and made the experience much deeper and broader than anything else. I wish that the bus had live guides instead of a canned recording.

Clean bus, exemplary assistance from staff in two instances (but not a third), superb coverage of the city, inclusion of river tour, great app.

The two exemplary assistances were ASHLEY (Stop 5, Baker St) and one of the drivers

Improvements suggested are:
1) the quality of sound from the headphones could be usefully improved and possibly the frequent soundtrack music reduced in favour of more historical detail. My 2 year old daughter felt that some headphone comments were rather over-generalised gushing praise without much information.
2) possibly we missed explanations re switching to the river cruise but these need to be stated up-front in your tour information.
3) Selection and/or training of one driver who appeared perplexed at some of our queries and was unable to respond to us clearly.

While I found the cost of the tour quite high (£100 for one adult and three kids), I have to say we all had a great day.

The audio commentary (w/ free headphones) was full of interesting facts and also wasn't afraid to poke fun at some of the more pompous elements of London history.

The boat ride up the Thames was also great fun. Lots of interesting sights and an entertaining live commentary.

I'd give this five stars if it was slightly cheaper. But it really was a great way of seeing central London on a limited timescale.

Spent 3 days in London but this was by far the best part of my visit. The sheer volume of historical information (both past and present) on this tour is amazing - and all done with humorous anecdotes and corny (but funny) jokes.
I just wish I had done this tour on my first day rather than my last as the tour guide gave us so many tips to visit hidden gems and get the best views.
Huge thank you to our guide (I think he was called Big Steven - or Arthur if I wrote a bad review :-) )
I'd highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting London.

The company seems highly disorganised. Stops were skipped without explanation, we had two 15+ minute stops for a "driver change", when changing from the red to blue line we were met by an extremely rude employee who kept shouting at people and telling them to wait for a new bus that didn't show up for yet another 15 minutes (which is when we left). It's a good thing this was included in our London Pass, otherwise we would have felt robbed. Our tickets were never checked by the way, which is also quite strange.

Most of the audio guide is advertising or music. We were craving for more historical information. There's no visual announcement of the stops, and this makes you feel lost and miss your stop. We booked the two days round, and the last day at night, the chofer (very rude by the way) in the bus ID: PNIO FOD, left us at 8 pm in the middle of nowhere, even when we were told that it was going to leave us near our hotel.

I did the red route today. Unfortunately I did not read the reviews until after I had travelled. My experience echoed that of many others. The commentary is inane. The queen died nearly two months ago but the commentary has not been updated to reflect this. Many (most?) places of interest are not even mentioned. The bus was overcrowded, the wait times much longer than advertised, the staff off hand, a lot of people were left at stops because there wasn’t room on the bus. And this was November! And while we waited a staff member was trying to convince passing people to buy a ticket. Obviously too many tickets being sold. I cannot believe that so many negative reviews have not resulted in any improvement. But I am one of the suckers who is contributing to this. Big Bus is the best priced for what they offer but not a good experience.

This tour is a waste of time and money. First, you spend most of the time sitting in traffic. When there is a sight, you often pass it much too quickly in order to get a proper view. I was told that we'd be seeing Buckingham Palace, but I never actually saw it! Second, the recorded commentary is not synchronized with the physical location, so you miss sights. You are also told about what to see if you get off at a stop when it's actually too late to do so! Third, many of the buses are crowded, especially on top. By the time I got to the upper deck and spied a seat, the driver was pulling away from the stop and I almost fell down. With COVID-19, I definitely wanted to sit in the open air, and I did not want to wait another 20 minutes for the next bus.

The hop on/hop off bus tour is the best way to orient yourself to London. We took the red line and traveled all over London which enabled us to decide where we wanted to explore further. The history provided through the earbuds was entertaining as well. We did not realize that the bus did not actually drive past some important attractions, like Buckingham Palace, but that we needed to get off the bus and walk. The bus route map helped significantly and once we figured out the route would not necessarily drive by our areas of interest, we mastered the tour. The Red route did go past many attractions (too may to list) including Westminster Abbey, Victoria Station, Madame Tussauds wax museum, Piccadilly Circus, Trafalgar Square, St. John's cathedral and many others. This tour was the perfect way to see London.

The walking tours given by Julia were phenomenal. Don’t miss them. The free river cruise that came with the bus Ticket was very well worth it. The recordings on the bus did not give enough information. I wish they would’ve had live tour guides on the bus. Well worth the money.

We spent more time waiting for buses than on them. Other bus companies had a steady stream of pickups but Big Buses were always bunched up far from us creating big delays. The app was helpful for tracking, because it showed that it was hopeless to wait. We spent more time taking to Tube from place to place. The audio tour was poor and didn’t line up with our route when we did finally manage to get on a bus. Go with a competitor.

Big Steve, what an absolute legend. We had, the most horrendous whether BUT Steve made it so fun, so bearable and so memorable! He was an absolute legend! Big Steve if you read this, it's gert lush Jess and little Phoebe from Bristol thanking you for making the bus tour a banger! We saw most the main sites and attractions on the red run, some sadly we couldn't due to a fun run marathon (no fault of the companys) but the diversions were equally as interesting! The cruise was decent as well, and we have a 24 hours ticket so will do the blue run tomorrow. Honestly if you're lucky enough to have Big Steve, sit up top with him WHATEVER THE WEATHER, ditch the headfones and let him tell the story. He's so fun (and i learnt loads as did my 6 year old)!

We took a last minute decision on taking the tour and were pleased we did. We bought on line and turned up at Trafalgar Square. After a 20 minute wait the open top bus turned up and we got on. Brand new earphone/plugs were provided. In these strange times the bus, as all of London, was not crowded and we had the choice of seating. Yes, as said in other reviews, the commentary was a bit corny but it had to appeal to all age groups and it did so quite well. We could have got on and off but the early autumn weather was with us and we enjoyed the sunshine and the whole trip. Money well spent. We will do it again but on a full day when we can make even more of the hop on hop off facility. Recommended

Company did not deliver services as described or purchased. We were directed by uninformed employees to THREE different stops before we could board a bus. This included stops that reflected active on the company app. We walked over one mile and wasted over an hour for buses that didn’t stop. I will NOT purchase nor recommend Big Bus Tour. After conversations with four employees NOT one apology. One afternoon in London and this is what We received!!

We were fortunate enough recently to travel on a hop-on hop-off Big Bus London bus that Lewis was providing running commentary. This very clever informative guide was a joy to listen to, he was interesting and humorous, and spoke to all his guests in their own language. We stayed on the bus to the end. Thanks Lewis.

No space, not enough services, once seat was found, told we had to change busses to a full bus with no space for us to get back into to the open top, or wait 25 mins. Not practical with children & £35 each. Who paid trip advisor for this award?

The overall service was shocking. Drivers and staff were indifferent at best. The concept of 'hop off, hop on' was a misnomer as it was impossible to get back on the overcrowded and full buses. Obviously there is no capacity management of bookings. The virtual tour guide system was patchy. Also the printed guide listed stop numbers for the various locations, but there was no verbal instructions as to each map number for each drop off point.

Best bus tour to go around on if you want to view London without walking for miles and packing on the tube.
Bus has different routes however we mainly stayed on the red route as it stopped right outside where we were staying.
Best memorable bus tour we took goes to a gentlemen called Mick and bus driver Julie- mick was very informative and made the ride a very funny experience so thank you.
Only negative was it was pricey however it can be used for 24hrs so we made the most out of it.

Really enjoyed this tour, despite the rain!

We picked the bus up at Victoria and took the red route. We got off just after London Bridge and had a tasty meal before picking up the river boat leg of the tour down the Thames to Westminster Pier.

It was really good that headphones and maps were provided on board the bus, but sadly the commentary was pre-recorded and really rubbish (hence marking down to 4 blobs).

The live commentary on the boat was interesting and it would have made a real difference to have had this in the bus too. A tip for the boat crew is requested but not compulsory.

We then hopped back on the bus back to Victoria.

A great day out with friends and recommended. If it's raining avoid sitting right by the edge of the covered area on the top deck of the bus as the rain was pouring off there.

Very bad recorded tellings. The stories about the city which was told on the bus was a minimum. Most of the talk (recorded) was only music or some folks trying to act like comedians. Historically telling shouldn’t be told as bad as Big Bus tour are doing their tellings

Used the service a couple times with the 24-hour ticket. The ride with driver Josh and commentator Phil was a proper highlight of our trip. Phil went above and beyond to greet everyone, learn where they came from, and would tailor the experience into something quite exceptional. Informative and funny, we learned a lot and were entertained the entire time. The driving was top notch as well, I have no idea how anyone manages to maneuver these monsters on the busy London streets. Despite riding through rush hour our trip was swift.

By the end of it I wished I could buy the blokes a pint. Phil really knew his stuff, answered questions, and helped guests sort their routes out to help min-max travel efficiencies. Had us cracking up the whole time. If I'm ever in Paris I'll definitely be taking the ho-ho (hop on hop off) tour there as well, since Phil mentioned his role in making that commentary too! Whatever they're earning, I think they deserve a raise!

The staff curbside was also helpful and friendly. Would recommend to anyone abroad.

The buses were quite crowded and hot, the prerecorded audio commentary was quiet and hard to hear (though they gave each person free earbuds to listen), the app was not very accurate as to where the buses were, and the buses did come in clumps with large gaps between each clump. The routes were great and do go by a ton of landmarks. The prerecorded audio commentary was somewhat informative but tried to be funny/cute and wasn't amusing at all.

We had so much fun on the Red Route with Ian. He added personal stories to the tour and made it very entertaining.
Additionally, the bus driver we had in the evening was incredibly helpful in making sure we made it back to our destination safely. When her shift was over, she came with us on another bus so we would know exactly where to go.

On Our stay in London, we ended to for 1/2 day city tour and was the perfect way to see London. Our guided bus tour drove us through the city, the streets and buildings history blended in with what we were seeing in front of us. Highly recommeded this bus city tour! Big Bus London Hop-On Hop-Off Tour!

Really loved the experience. After buying the ticket online we just downloaded the app for easy real-time access to bus schedules, routes and stops.

We were given an ear piece to listen to commentary along the route. Info given was great.

We also did the 30-minute cruise on The Thames. Loved it!

Highly recommend.

Horrible staff. We were abused in the middle of the street by a foreign male late 50’s short wit grey hair and facial beard, who spoke with a foreign accent after we didn’t want to buy a ticket for the open top bus.

He then verbally abused my mother and said she was a bad mum for not purchasing the tickets.

Although we chose not to as we had booked the river cruise instead and explained this. However he continued to be abusive ad he was desperate to sell the tickets.

I then complained to big bus tours via email who were unhelpful and then chose not to respond to my emails or acknowledge what had happened. This happened near Westminster pier. I’d avoid this tour and company.

Everything was going well until stop 23. Then we stopped and the driver got out for around 25-30mins. Incredibly hot on the top and bottom deck. The supervisor at the stop said that they had to wait and had made an announcement, which was a complete lie. Shop for a different company.

We only did the hop on & off bus not do they London Eye this visit. We have used Grayline in many cities in the past So initially we opted to do gray line but found they were very minimal buses in the service was not up to par Sauer within booked take bus. This is the Primo bus service in Paris in my opinion. Lots of stops and lots of buses making it convenient to see many things. The drivers are very helpful

Terrible experience, the guys at the stop were more concerned about selling tickets than helping us navigate. We needed to get to a specific location, the dismissed our questions just urging us to get on the bus. The map provided didn’t have names of the stops so just random numbers on a very false, non geographic map. I understand this is a bus tour but is also a hop on hop off and if we can’t even figure out where to hop off what’s the point? Would rather take a in person guided bus tour if we were only interested in seeing the sites from the bus.

I was waiting at the Tower Hill stop waiting for the bus to arrive with my family. The driver arrived and refused to help us with my father who is a wheelchair user, even though the bus is signposted with disabled badges. He kept shouting at us and then drove off almost injuring my brother in the process!! Unfortunately I couldn’t get the drivers name but I did get the registration of what he was driving! The man was vile and seemed uninterested in supporting us and for that reason I’m disgusted with this company who can treat people like that. The driver needs sacking!!!!

I had such a great time on the hop on - hop off bus tour. Lewis was an incredible tour guide, he made our experience fun and went that extra mile to ensure all passengers got to where they needed to before the last bus stopped. Thank you for a great tour around London, and for the laugh on our journey. Highly recommend :)

Big bus London was one of the funnest things my boyfriend and I did in London. The drivers are so nice and special things to Nour and our driver Eric. They were awesome ! Eric give us instructions to go to Abbey Road which was awesome and we really enjoyed the tour we absolutely recommend it to everyone especially if it’s your first time in London this force will take care of you and show you all the great sites thanks again will be back soon Tim and Lud From California .

This experience is a total waste of money. If there is a demonstration in London (or other such issues) then they change all the routes. On the day I took the tour there were two demos so the routes all but fell apart. Whist I appreciate it’s not the companies fault, they obviously can’t control demonstrations, they do nothing to keep you updated on these changes so you’ve no way of knowing if the Bus is arriving or not. I couldn’t even download the app onto my phone.

I was literally on the Bus for no more than 20 minutes!!

Seriously, do not waste your time or money with this company. Their customer service is non-existent.

Would never do again. Staff were not helpful at all. We waited ages for buses and then when we had already waited an hour in the cold I went about 100m to the bathroom and my partner ask if they could just wait like a min for me to get back (I saw it pull up) and they said nope and pulled out as I arrived at the bus. We then had to figure out how to get back to the train and got better service from member of the public than from their staff.

We have not decided to take which hop on/off bus but when we arrived at the station, the sales lady was there and recommended us. London pass did include this which helped us to save a lot. Upon exchanged for the ticket, we were offered to upgrade to 2 days pass by paying additional 9 bucks. However since we have a planned tour so we didn't accept. It was really a good experience to take the big bus. There were headset at each of the seat which came in many languages. The explanation was informative. It was really convenient to take the big bus as they were punctual. There are few lines that you can take but we mainly took the red and blue lines due to time constraint. They stopped at major tourist attractions with short walk. If you have limited time in London but wanted to see London in such a short time, maybe you can consider this.

We’ve spent a wonderful two days in London thanks in large part two using the hop on hop off bus tours. All of the bus drivers were absolutely amazing, but I have to do a call out for the bus driver Eric who was absolutely phenomenal. He was incredibly helpful, kind and very professional. When I miss placed my camera he went above and beyond to help me find it. My heartfelt thanks to him for that and for giving us a wonderful time in London

Limited busses in service. Commentary childish and didn't sync with stops. Bus was packed top and bottom. I asked how many busses they had running and the folks didn't know. We saw many other hop on hop busses from other companies that had lots of busses running and we're not packed

Once on the bus all was fine, however it took quite a while for one of the buses to arrive at the Piccadilly Circus stop - we waited at least 20 minutes with a couple of other families. When the bus came it was crowded with no seats available on the top level (which is where everyone wants to be)...after a few stops we were able to get on the top level and all was great. Good audio guide and headsets to narrate the sites. My only suggestion is they get a few more busses into the action so the wait isn't as long for one to come and the seats on upper level are more available

Too many people on the buses and audio quality was pretty poor with the supplied headphones and not all stops were served. We saw that toot bus had much fewer riders. Not sure of the quality of that bus though.

Nice car, good sound quality but very limited information.
The text is supposed to be cheerful and fun, but when you have said "buddy" 100 times and at the same time very limited historical information or information about historical buildings, the shine is now lost on the guide. That was a bad introduction "buddy"

Excellent and entertaining audio tour in English. We took the red route and stayed the whole trip without getting off to begin the visit with, and get a feel for London. Reasonably comfortable seats on the bus, and well cleaned and maintained. Driver was good and made the ride comfortable. Good added benefit with the possibility to do two other routes and a Thames boat trip as well, all included in the ticket price. All in all, good value for the money and an enjoyable experience.

The roots are great and the bus makes many stops on it's way.
Don't miss the walking tours that are included, check the leaflet for time and location. We were lucky to go with Nick, highly recommended!
Also note that the tour includes the boat trip which starts e.g.from the Tower of London.
I recommed to download the app to track the bus location. The buses have several routes, and they sometimes interchange from one to another without anouncements, so you better track your location)

Took the grandkids to London and one of the highlights was a sightseeing bus tour that was supposed to take around 2 hours to go a full circuit, 3 hours and we gave up at the 9th stop and didn't feel like going back on it. We took the tube to the cruise pier. The boat cruise was good, didn't consider the walking tour

The tour was average. It felt that the information given through the earphones wasn’t great and it felt that most of the time it was just music playing and advertisements. Unfortunately when we went there were diversions because the queens funeral which meant we missed some stops but this was not anyone’s fault. I felt the tour may have been better if there was a tour guide giving the information instead of through a earpiece. Unsure if I would attend again. The views were amazing though

We took the red route today and had a great time. It was an easy process to purchase the tickets online at the hotel just prior to taking the tour in order to avail of the online discount. The bus arrived within minutes and we were off. Our tour guide, William (Wikipedia Will) was amazing. He was extremely knowledgeable, very friendly, and super helpful. He provided historical and cultural facts at every turn. We look forward to taking another ride tomorrow!

Joe is an absolute legend! That does seem like a strange way to start a review but his passion for history, his ridiculously funny anecdotes and his willingness to engage with passengers made a gloomy day light up. Right down to knowing the names of the London Tower Ravens (I thought he was making up names), Joe has the art of Tour guiding perfected. Thank you Joe and thank you Big Bus Tour company for such a great show. West end watch out X-D

Not worth the money. Hop on hop off is what it says on the tin so can’t argue with that. We wanted a guided tour like in York, Edinburgh etc and what we got was a pair of headphones and a recording of a couple of ridiculous actors trying to be funny and more suited to a 5 year old. There was more cheesy music between the snippets of information provided. The river cruise was great and the commentary fantastic which is what we wanted but beware, it’s only one way which leaves you to either walk or get the bus again covering the same route, or tube. If it’s a guided tour you’re after, go with another. Expensive mistake.

We thoroughly enjoyed our experience with Big Bus tours. We used as part of our London Pass. Our tour guide, Will (aka Wikipedia Will) was full of knowledge & facts about the city. He was very friendly, a good storyteller and did a wonderful job throughout our tour. Great overview of the city.

This is the first time I have not been happy with a hop on hop off bus tour. The bus drivers were not friendly, the recorded commentary was very annoying, the timing was off so have the time we were passed the attraction they we’re talking about. We never new what stop # we were at. Would definitely use a different hop on hop off if ever in London again.

The bus did not follow the route as per leaflet and was not available at places where it dropped us off for us to get back on again which led to us having to sit through another hour of places we had already been and then did not go past Buckingham palace as it took a short cut back to starting place.

The buses where not spaced very well as three came in quick succession and then not another for over 30 mins (we saw this from other side of road).

Commentary was not great and it was hard to hear sometimes over noise.

River Cruise was nice and the personal touch was good, asking for beer money at end though!!!

I did not think it was value for money, and would use tube next time to travel.

I highly recommend you take any walking tour that is offered. Julia (a Big Bus Tour guide) came on our bus at one of the stops and offered a walking tour to see the guard changes/Buckingham palace and more to anyone on the bus that wanted it . It as such a good decision to go, we had a lot of fun and plenty of information. The walking tour shows you so many things you never could have seen on the bus! Julia was my tour guide and she was amazing!
Highly recommend Julia’s tour!

Big Bus Hop on Hop off....We luckily sat up front on the top deck next to one Royston Kean Esquire the personal tour guide on our chosen bus.
Great character, all sorts of extra info and knowledge about every street, monument and historic building we passed. All spoken in the most dulcet tones, reminiscent of Peter O'Toole.....in Lawrence!
Royston is Big Bus Co's best asset and they probably don't appreciate it. A great tour of London. PM & family from Dublin

We were greeted by Moriss,at Westminster,who repeatedly and patiently explained the whole process from payment cruise and bus tour he also took it upon himself to escort us where to aboard the boat...made us feel at ease especially my autistic son,meant so much to us.
The boat cruise staff were informative, funny kept everyone laughing,...my family had an amazing time.
Bus tour staff are friendly aswel answering all the questions and explaining with ease ..we had an amazing time thank you all so much.I definitely recommend.

Took my granddaughter for a day in London. Waited an hour for the first bus near Paddington, very packed so had to stand until we got off at Marble Arch. Huge queue for the next red bus and everyone barged on, we luckily got a seat, but lots of people left downstairs, some standing. The commentary was ridiculous and confusing, the stops not clearly announced and very little interesting history. We got off at Westminster to walk around but the confusing map with not enough detail and the fact the website was slow and not loading we never found another stop for ages. Consequently had to walk miles back to Paddington. One red bus we saw said we needed a blue bus but gave very vague advice about finding the correct stop. He could have suggested he took us to Marble Arch to find a blue bus or to have a much shorter walk to Paddington we discovered later. On the whole, lack of staff to help, lack of adequate buses, lack of detailed guides left us very disappointed and regretting the £102 we spent!

Last time I used Big Bus Tours there was a connecting Green route from Kings Cross Station to the Red Route near Madam Tussauds. This time I couldn’t find any information about it online. We’d already bought tickets so had to get to Red Route under our own steam.
Commentary was ok but it didn’t point out exactly where a landmark was like a person would.
Got a 2 for 1 offer through National Rail Days Out, otherwise it wouldn’t have been worth the price.

The overall experience was good. Not a fan of the prerecorded commentary . After 2 days it was quite annoying. The walking tours were amazing. Julia, our guide for 2 tours was engaging and very knowledgeable. Hands down having a real life person made our walking tour the most memorable part of our Big Bus experience. Thank you, Julia

This was a complete waste of money. It was a recorded narrative that was like listening to cartoon characters. The recording was high pitched and hurt our ears. It told us very little information about the sights. The bus was overcrowded, hot, with screaming babies.

I dont normally write reviews but this was awful. We waited over half an hour for the bus which was nearly full with seats only available downstairs. I wouldnt of minded but the downstairs windows were covered over with advertising so you couldnt see anything. To make things worse the driver kept on letting more and more people on who who could now only stand in the aisle.Other companies buses were more frequent so had less passengers on board. AVOID AT ALL COST

Very disappointing throughout. Absolutely no way of contacting customer service unless via Live chat which is totally helpless or actually speaking to one of the street vendors which are few and far between.

We bought our tickets online bar one member of the party who tried to purchase by staff member but after the way he spoke to us decided against it.

He basically implied one of us was too heavy or overweight to be sitting on the bus stop waiting bench and then began ridiculing us when we told him we were from Scotland. Then he began venting about the company he worked for saying that he had been made redundant during covid but resigned recently, that the company is now not family owned after being bought out , and that they don't have enough staff now but all they care about is the money. Maybe all true but doesn't make for a good first impression

Then we got on the bus and were disappointed to learn there was no live tour , just the headphones to plug into which was only mostly music playing anyway with very little information

The stops were not identified clearly , neither on the bus or on the map (the map actually had very little information anyway) we actually missed our stop and messed up our whole days plan

We actually got off for the river cruise (which was good ) and got the underground the rest of the day so the money for that was literally down the drain. Very disappointing all round , would recommend looking elsewhere if looking for a tour of London.

The commentary is the worst I have ever heard on a bus tour anywhere in the world. It was diabolical. I loved the big bus tours in the past so chose this one for my granddaughter on her first trip to London. We were on the bus an hour and a half before we saw anything of interest and put up with the awful commentary. Never again

Hopped on this bus to show an overseas visitor a quick tour of the main sights of London. It was very disappointing. The commentary/ audio consisted of cheesy pop music and the commentator trying to be funny. Very little informative commentary at all. Some of the commentary was repeated at multiple points in the tour. Major features we drove past without any mention at all.

Plastic seats on an old bus that were very uncomfortable.

The bus tour was OK. The recorded messages were good in that they did mention the more well known sites. We did just the bus tour and it was really nice to hop on and off at any of the stops. There are enough frequent buses that when you want to "hop back on", there is not a long wait.
Depending on the day and time of day, you will hit traffic. We sat in traffic several times during our trip.
For the price, the trip was great and the busses were clean and safe. Also, having the tours in different languages was impressive.

Better late than never.. I did this tour in March and I had to leave a review! The customer service of the gentlemen working on the big red bus tour red line was excellent! Special shout out to Dave, rash, widgey they helped me and my friends with our whole tour. They all went above and beyond to make sure our trip and tour was amazing. Gave us advice on hidden gems and what stops had what. We showed them pictures we had taken of the queen and were so kind to converse and help us!! Couldn’t recommended the drivers and guides enough!. 10/10. Thanks Dave, rash, widgey. ❤️❤️

I just want to leave a big thank you for your kindness and professionalism.
In July we had one day in London and had booked this tour. Upon arriving at the stop we were planning to join the tour something was wrong with the ramp to the bus and it wasn’t going anywhere. Since we had such a short amount of time we knew we couldn’t wait especially as it was the hottest day I believe and so we decided we had to move on and use the underground instead to try and see a few of the iconic sightseeing spots.

I emailed the next day respectfully and requested a refund.

I was responded to in the most wonderful and professional way and would absolutely choose this company for a tour in the future based upon this.
Thank you!@

Very disappointed. First, we were suckered into a two-day pass, including river cruise. which we never found. Due to traffic, the bus inched along and after an hour and a half, we hopped-off, never to hop on again. The bus red route was one-way, so if one wants to hop back on, you need to wait for a bus to show up. Driver would get off at a stop to have a smoke. Recorded "narration" was silly, repetitive, and often not synched to what we were seeing. Total waste of money and, most important, time.

The tour itself was fine. The person who greeted us at the bus stop at Green Park was curt and unclear about what we should do, and seemed to have too much on the go. The audio presentation was a bit cheesy. We would have much preferred live commentary. The tour took us to all the spots we wanted to see and it was easy to get on and off as we needed to. We really enjoyed the boat ride portion. The final bus driver (Dean) was fantastic and made sure we got back to our destination of Green Park after hours. He went above and beyond.

You spend way too much time waiting for a bus to get on. Then it drives around a circuit where you really don't see that much. Then you get off, spend a bunch of time somewhere, and wait some more for a buss, then repeat. You'll waste too much time waiting for and sitting on the bus.

You'd see far more using the subway to speed across town to the things you want to see, or using the uber boat to go up and down the river quickly to things, and spend far less money. All of these things work with your contactless payment card. (one card needed per person)

Westminster Abby, Parliment, Big Ben, Eye, then take a quick uber boat up to Tower of london. Tower of London then boat on up river to Cutty Sark. Then boat back town to Anchor Pub and clink. Boat back to where you started. That's one day. Far more things and less money than a silly bus.

Great experience over two days. Tour manager Craig was very understanding when we had problems booking and the guides Chloe and Phil did a marvellous job. Considering Chloe is a young Australian, she has an impressive knowledge of London's rich history and landmarks. Liked the fact that she could list a number of things about the Mary Seacole statue. Up and down in the cool river boat was a highlight. Loved seeing London from the top of the bus in the blazing sun. Pity not all the routes were open because of Covid but on the plus side, fewer people were travelling so it was never crowded. Everyone adhered to safety protocols. Overall a wonderful time had by two veteran Londoners who enjoyed being 'tourists' for a couple of days.

Did the tour today along with the river cruise which was excellent. Would have given a higher rating however some of the stops were closed which I know was beyond their control but then the driver totally ignored the Picadilly stop and would have ignored the next if we hadn't requested to get off. We also seemed to be sat ages at Green Park and then at Madame Tussards while the driver who had just got on at Green Park went to the loo. The commentary did say it would resume when back on the route but I do not feel it did . Again like previous comments was not told some of the stops not open. Fingers crossed normal service will be returned.

Terribly disorganised. The staff are all about signing up people. Once paid no one cares. Spend all day waiting for the bus which don’t ever seem to go to where you want. Just catch the public bus. Drivers don’t seem to be able to help. This is a way to rip off tourists that they will never see again. No such thing as customer service. The commentary tells you nothing useful like which stops you’re approaching or when to get off for which attractions. Very expensive for what you get. Map indicated stops by number but nowhere do they mention which stop you are at.

My partner and I loved using the Big Bus to tour around London.

Shoutout to Karen for being an excellent guide and providing very useful, helpful and interesting information about London’s sights and landmarks.

The roofless bus was fantastic. Although it was cold and windy it didn’t matter when we could see the city in full view. So many opportunities for awesome photographs.

I’m very excited to book this experience again :D

An easy way to see the key attractions.

Our tour guide -Emma- was amazing, a true Londoner, she provided us with useful tips to enjoy our stay to the fullest and interesting historical and architectural comments during the ride with of course a touch of smart humor and sarcasm !

P.S Take the bus for more than 1 day so you can have time to get off the bus and explore the city more thoroughly.
We only had one day and we couldn't explore all the places!

Identify boarding locations by name.
Sync the recorded narration to the location for picture taking.
Train the office staff to be more knowledgeable regards tour area (1/2 hr telcon, zero result).
Ensure bus drivers know the difference between blue route and red route.
Put a monitor at more stops to answer questions. The few available were very helpful.
Be more specific regards on/ off river cruise locations. The river cruise was great.
This was not our first bigbus tour, wonderful experience in Savannah GA, & San Diego, CA. Hard to believe this is the same company.

The stops were all closed. There was no information on the website to explain which were open. We spent hours walking around trying to find open stops and there were also no kiosks open to even speak to someone. Waste of money. Did not get to use at all. I emailed twice and no reply.

Worse service ever. Drivers were unhelpful. Told a complete lie. I asked what time was last bus he said 8pm. I looked on the website it states 5pm I challenged this he said definitely last bus 8pm. So off we go to do our London eye trip come back at 5.30 for bus guess what buses stop at 5pm. To top it all off we only got 10 minutes in total the whole day on this ridiculous bus company. The bus even crashed before we could start our journey. Never again will I use this service or recommend. I'm still waiting for the company to deal with my complaint. We had Ukrainian guest with us they was expecting a truly wonderful experience instead very stressful and disappointing

Booked a 48 hour bus tour with Big Bus and it did not disappoint. Even though it was chilly sitting on an open top bus in January we were wrapped up warm and prepared for it therefore this did not hinder our experience. We did the red tour all the way through on Sunday 5th along with the Orange Tour, then completed the blue tour and a part red tour on Monday 6th.
Each tour was excellent and we were lucky enough to have the opportunity to listen to 3 different live guides:- Julia (from Bavaria), Christopher and Peter were all wonderful, super informative and adding humour to the tour, thank you for your time and all the facts!
Would recommend as the live guides really add to the experience!

Wait times too long. Bus stops for Big Bus are not easy to find and are indicated only by a small tr tangle on sign at busy stop. Even venues for ticket purchase cannot give correct information re location of bus stop. Some drivers lovely and some less so. Maps are poor as sights are numbered but no corresponding name. Audio does not always tell you when to disembark for a particular place. We missed the stop for Buckingham Palace. Wouldn’t recommend.

We were approached near the London Eye by the Original Bus Tour rep who handed us a map but didn’t seem very interested. We saw Ashley a rep for the Big Bus Tours who started explaining his companies route and how it worked. The guy from the competing company cane over and was so rude to Ashley saying he handed us a map so he shouldn’t be talking to us. Ashley was such a professional and stayed calm and helped us. We decided to get our tickets from him and he was so nice and friendly. We got on the bus and we had a live tour guide called Phil who was so funny and extremely informative. Although you get headphones to plug in we much preferred listening to Phil and were gutted when he got off halfway through. I would get on again just to hear him. A really good tour bus to see all the sights and would definitely recommend this on to everyone!

Unfortunately, my wife and I started the tour a bit late so we didn't get to see much. We also missed the river cruise which I'm sure would have a great experience. Plus they have to reroute the buses because one of the bridges was blocked by protestors.

I had taken the London big bus tours back in around 2008 and it was delightful. So we booked one for February 22, 2022. We waited 30 minutes for our bus. After we were on it for four stops they kicked us off and made us get on a different route. There is no life guides anymore, they use pre-recorded audio that is primarily used for sales purposes. We got little if any historical perspective on the city of London. We sat on the red route for about four hours in bumper-to-bumper traffic. We were then kicked off the red route and told to get on the blue route which left without us. I would never ever ever recommend this to even my worst enemy.

We took the big bus tour in New York City in December 2017. It was a good tour, with live guides but they dropped us at a location and then we were on the phone for about 40 minutes trying to figure out where the other buses were. They promised us free tickets on our next trip. Never got them. Terrible company.

The whole experience was APPALLING. The headphones did not work so was unable to hear the commentary. I changed seats 6 times until I found a working set of headphones. I might as well not have bothered. The commentary was pathetic, actually, it was worse than pathetic. The bus route did not cover any of the important sights, it went down a very narrow street and got stuck and we sat for over 30 minutes as the driver made efforts to reverse and, presumably, get back on route. At onre point the bus pulled over to the side of the road and parked for 40 minutes. Over 2 days we spent 7 wretched hours on the bus, hoping it would improve. It did not.
It was an expensive waste of time. I checked with the other bus tours after my experience and they are all cheaper. My advice: ANYTHING would be better than going on the BigBus tour.

Really enjoyed the Big Bus Tour. We found the commentaries on the bus and the boat entertaining and informative - a 'light touch' approach. The staff were very helpful when I messed up the timings (we started the tour halfway round and weren't going to get to stop 1 by 5pm for the final bus) and provided us with a paper ticket for the following day so that we could complete the tour then.

Great way to tour London to get the lay of the land. Stop at a place that catches you eye , see what you want to see, and hop back on board for more touring. At major stops there is a Big Bus employee to answer your questions. The stops are marked but very in appearance. Get the Big Bus live app to track your position as you ride along!

Excellent bus driver, Naim, who very impressively drove smoothly through hectic London traffic! Naim was also very relaxed and pleasant, despite what must be a stressful job! The free WiFi worked well onboard the buses. The headsets worked well, but the English commentary was a bantering (joking) tone with irrelevant chatter between a man and woman, instead of useful information. If you followed along in the app, you could click on useful and interesting information about each site we passed- WHY doesn't Big Bus read out that commentary instead?! Big Bus loses one star from us because of the disappointing commentary. All in all, a great experience, though.

I would NEVER book this again!!! We rode for one stop and it was SO Crowded that was standing room only and people were having hard time getting off the bus.
Every time I saw this bus company during our one week stay it was overcrowded!! We spent a lot of money for 2 day pass to do this and couldn’t use it.
Save your money and take Uber!!!

Very poor recorded commentary. Mostly music played and very little history provided. Really dumbed down compared to what it could be given Londons past. I’ve done many open top bus tours in various cities and this one was the worst I’ve come across. Good drivers and buses but if you’re wanting to learn about London I’d give another tour company a go.

The route was wonderful for the most part (more on that later), but the narrative was quite possibly the most ridiculous thing I have ever heard. The route covered most of the basics, but for some reason, once we had jockeyed a nice four-seat arrangement on the upper deck, we were all told we had to leave the bus and get on another one. So we had to start downstairs and work our way up after a few stops, when people got off.

The narrative was awful. Uninformative, mostly music. And when there was narrative, it was inane banter between a man and a woman, making silly, idiotic jokes. My recommendation is to do the bus, but pass on the headsets.

My 8 year old son and I went on the non-stop bus and boat tour today, with our guide, Phil, and our driver, Adrian. I am a Londoner, but wanted to show my son some of the sights. It was the second day since the service restarted. We turned up very early to make sure we knew where we were going from. Adrian and a third colleague were extremely welcoming and informative about the service. Once the tour started Phil was great, with knowledge that clearly wasn't just a script. All the staff were very engaging and we had a lovely time. Thank you! On the downside, I would say that the company's mobile app was fine, but their website was impossible. We couldn't buy a ticket using a card on the main site, only using the app and the automated assistant pop ups were infuriating and unhelpful.

Just ok. The hard sell from two competing companies when in line was annoying. We went with Big Bus since that’s the map we already had in hand and we knew the route worked (plus we were done with the hard sell and wanted to just go with one). The central route that we started on had a live commentator but it was very monotone and boring. Several times the commentator turned to talk to tourists in nearby seats and we half heard those conversations rambling on in our headphones. We were stuck in traffic half the time and could tell the pre recorded track was made for less traffic... 2/3 of the time the headphones switched to bad classical background music waiting for the next prerecorded info set. The bus routes outside of the best of central London zone are pre recorded only for this company. Again the traffic slowed progress to a stand still and half the info track was background music. Ok way to at least see some visual sights while sitting. Best part is being on the top deck of the bus where it’s uncovered (although a little chilly in December).

Routes could be improved and more stops nearer to major attractions. Waiting times shown on app are inaccurate and changed from 13 to 16 mins to 5 to 6 mins then 21 to 26 mins. In all we waited 45 minutes in freezing weather with a 6 year old then decided to walk instead. 2nd day ticket has been wasted. Not happy!!

My husband and I brought tickets to show the sights of London to our 8 year old daughter during our weeks stay. The bus tour was great, very informative with some much needed humour from tour guide Steve, as the weather wasn't great. We decided to save the river cruise for the following day, and were greeted by Dina and Mary. Dina (baileys) came over to chat briefly about the changes she's seen in London during covid-19 but made us feel very welcomed and relaxed. She recommended a cappuccino with amaretto as it was a cold day again, which went down a treat. It was sad to see so few people on the cruise, especially in August. The tours are well worth the money, and staff very friendly and helpful. Having visited London many times, we have honestly never felt safer. Thanks London, we'll be back again soon!

Left us stranded,
We were told last bus was at 5pm but infact all buses return to depot at 5pm.
There is no return to hotel service, we were left at Piccadilly Circus and told a bus was on its way when this was not the case,
I checked the app and all buses were returning to depot and this was 4:50pm.
I am currently in contact with TFL.

I strongly recommend for those of us that love to see everything but could care less about walking to all those areas. I strongly recommend this, I am lazy and I was able to see all the relevant parts of London with ease. (Buckingham Palace, Big Ben, The London Eye etc)

Poor experience. They changed the route for a day or two but didn’t bother to put any notice at the stop they detoured. Many couples waited up to an hour for a bus that never came. Also weak jokes instead of actual information along most of the route.

My friend and I used Big Bus Tours in London on 18 July, 2021. During the day, we had several different drivers treat us very poorly. One driver left us at a stop and refused to pick us up, even though we showed him our tickets. A later driver told us that the stop we were at was no longer supported by the company, even though it is still on their app. While we can accept that things like that happen, the attitude we got from the first driver and the lack of support was terrible. Then, the second driver talked down to us like we were stupid foreigners who shouldn't care if the app is updated or not. "Why do you care, you're not coming back" is NOT the right response when we are trying to figure out the schedules. It is unfortunate that these drivers ruined our experience with this company. The actual tour guides talking were very enjoyable and the busses were frequent. Too bad that these drivers had to take out their frustrations on us. Even though we have lived here for 4 years and will be here for at least another three, these drivers have basically guaranteed that No, we will NOT be coming back.

It is the on off bus, pretty standard in every country. This is definitely a preference on how you travel, but for London, this is a good idea! There are wait times when you see the sight then return for the bus. London is a spectacular city and this is a great idea to get a lot of sights seen in one day!

I have come to London in a work trip and I have been lucky enough to catch one of Big Bus London, with a Guide Tourist included.
I already have that experience in other cities overseas and the fact that Phil the Tourist Guide be present explaining all the attractions of London make a huge difference and worth the trip.
Next time, I come I will bring my husband with me for enjoying as well.
Big Bus London with a Tourist Guide is priceless.
Thank you Big Bus London and Phil for the wonderful trip.

Buses don’t come on time, every hour if you’re lucky....so if you’re doing hop on hop off you can hardly complete the tour in a day. Staff are unhelpful and there is no social distancing on board. If you try to complain or get a refund the staff are rude and sarcastic. I had to complain via PayPal to get a refund as I stood for so long waiting I didn’t even take the tour. Try another company with better customer service not just a greedy company that want to take your money & offer a shoddy service.

Fantastic experience loved every second of it! The guided bus tour was very entertaining, played great music and commentary was very interesting! Driver’s were very nice! River cruise was fantastic, especially with the sunny weather. Travelled all the way to Greenwich from Westminster. Highly recommend this tour!

It was a great idea and we saw a great selection of sights on the bus, even though we had to wait for spaces to open up on the top deck. However the river cruise from London eye to tower bridge more than made up for it. Saw amazing sights and had a great and hilarious commentary along the way. We loved it

I really didn't like it. The maps have stop numbers yet the bus drivers never announce the stops by number. Also it was pouring rain and the blue line bus was there but wouldn't let is on because he had to move up the street before he would let us on. Drivers were rude wouldn't recommend it.

We enjoyed the hop on hop off bus tour, as we were able to quickly and easily see the main attractions and learn more about the history of the area. However the real highlight was our Jack the Ripper walking tour with Julia. She is a super knowledgeable guide, extremely passionate about the subject matter and very funny as well. She made the tour quite enjoyable.

We hopped on the red line tour around London and was greeted at the top by a friendly gentlemen who was our tour guide. His name was William or "Wiki Will" and he was incredible. Our original plan was to get off at Buckingham palace, however decided to stay on for the remainder of the ride as William was incredibly informative, and entertaining to listen to. We learned so much about England and it's history on this tour, highly recommend. Thanks again William and Big Bug tours for an unforgettable experience!

Our party thoroughly enjoyed the tour on both bus and boat.
The river cruise was probably better as there was live commentary which was clearly audible and managed to keep everyone’s concentration, whereas the bus commentary was thru recording on headphones, and was rather difficult to hear with all the background noise unfortunately.
However, overall a most enjoyable experience- London really is a fantastic city to visit.

This is the best value ticket from big bus. We only had live commentary on two of our buses. It’s a great way to get around but buses don’t run as frequently as promised and finish early at this time of year. The buses are fairly new and well kept. The boat trip from London Eye to London Bridge is relaxing and nice to see the city from the water. If you have time it probably better in foot

My first trip to London for my father-in-law s 70th birthday and we used the tour to see the sights but save the older legs! This was a brilliant way to see all the big sights and our second tour guide Emma was a fantastic commentator. She made sure she knew when we wanted to jump off and kept us right all the way. She had a great balance of historical and humorous knowledge and kept us all entertained.

Very disappointed in narration. Tried to be funny but the content was weak. It was out of sync with landmarks. I remember Big Bus being
much more informative with their audio narration,
Will try a different tour next trip.

We enjoyed the ability to hop on and hop off the bus at different stops. As first time travelers to London is was the only way to go. The drivers and the staff at each stop were willing to give us tips as to where to go and helpful with tickets for attractions.

The narration on the bus tour was pretty poor but the buses were clean, regular and stopped at all the main places of interest. The river cruise was fantastic and the live guide was really funny. What really made us give this ticket 5* was the free walking tours. We went on the changing of the guard tour with Nick and had a fantastic time. It was fast paced but was such great fun. Nick's knowledge was immense. Not only did we see the guards at The Mall, Buckingham Palace and Horse guards we were lucky enough to see a black swan, pelicans, squirrels and pauraques. My son enjoyed all the wildlife in the park as much as the soldiers. We were disappointed we did not manage to fit another walking tour in as some of our group were raving about another tour they had done with Nick and said it was the best part of their holiday.

The hop on hop off bus started well, staff were all pleasant and helpful and really enjoyed the commentary. Later in the day however, found we were having to wait longer for buses, even though drivers and buses seemed to be at the stops. We were crammed on to buses and had to stand so couldn’t listen to the commentary. Disappointing so we ended up getting the underground later in the day as it was quicker.

By a stroke of good fortune the computer had gone down on the bus so Phil, one of the tour guides, jumped on board and provided us with a 1 and a half hour live commentary. He was hugely entertaining and so knowledgeable after 21 years working for Big Bus. He was a real hero on the day and it was money well spent.

We had a great experience riding the Big Bus. We found the pre recorded audio commentary was adequate (although we certainly would have preferred a live guide). We felt the value was good, especially as our 1 day pass including the river cruise.

Was on bus with Big Steve who provided a commentary of sights and places of interest - thoroughly enjoyed bus trip,went around twice enjoying his advice and commentary. So much better than previous trips with that terrible recorded guide. Thanks Steve for a wonderful trip.
Russell and Tracey

We had a thoroughly enjoyable day doing the hop on hop off big bus tour and cruise. In particular I would like to mention @Wikipedia Will! He was amazing! We actually did not want to get off his bus at all. His knowledge is unbelievable, he is a great entertainer and made the city of London hugely entertaining for our 9 year old. Well done and thank you Will.

The whole bus experience was pretty good. There are quite a lot of things out of their control with road diversions etc. Thought the man selling the tickets could explain things a bit better. I had to drag information out of him, he was mainly interested in seeing the colour of our money after that care factor ..zero.
The walking tours was the highlight of the whole experience if you miss these you will have missed the best part of the whole package. Our guide was Julia and she did a fantastic job. It is a shame that there isn't a guide on the bus to do live commentary as the pre-recorded is repetitive and uninformative.
The boys on the ferry trip did a good job.

Very disappointing. Hardly any commentary despite it being recorded. Full of cheesy sing song commentary and advertising and random music. For example, not one word about the history of Marble Arch or Hyde Park despite us being near both for quite some time. Much of the tour occurred in silence. I know enough about London to know we were passing history without a mention.

I wish I had read the reviews before deciding to purchase tickets. As others have written, the recorded “guide” is truly worthless. There were so many interesting sights along the way, but the guide mentioned almost none of them. I have taken Hop-on Hop -off busses in many cities and never experienced a worse commentary. The tone of the two voice actors was belittling and they tried to be funny without success. The view from the front seat of the upper deck great and protected from the elements.

Fantastic experience! Julia was our live tour guide. MAKE SURE you get on the bus with the live guide. Due to the pandemic, many of the buses don’t have live guides anymore. They make it an amazing tour. #bringbackliveguides

We bought the 2-day pass and definitely used it. It was a great way to see the city and get around to all of the sites. There is so much to see and this was the best way to do London! We had a great guide, Molly, who narrated one of our days on the bus and also guided us on a Jack the Ripper walking tour. She was very knowledgeable and a fun guide! Sit on the top if you can - great views of the city!

The itinerary is good as expected. So much to see. Sadly the recorded commentary was awful. Jumping, overlapping and attempts at comedy just resulted in details and information being missed. The music was also unnecessary. So many sights not mentioned. Disappointing. I understand there are some actual tour guides. All I can say is that they are few and far between. Whereas the river cruise with live commentary was excellent. Bring back the live commentary on every bus and provide the experience that visitors of London are looking for.

This is an enjoyable way to get a glimpse off the sights…if you get a seat on the top level. The bottom inside level is very hot. The recording is very cheesy. I would have enjoyed a lot more talking about the sights and history. Also, we didn’t get to see Buckingham Palace which was disappoint. If you get off the bus, the wait can be lengthy to wait for another bus with seats. Overall it was ok but I probably wouldn’t do it again.

Unintentional timing of our Hop on Hop Off trip had us arriving at Buckingham Palace for changing of the guard. A favorite on my wife’s must-see list… very low on mine. So obviously we were going!
We were directed to the preferred starting point, not Buckingham Palace and hooked up with walking tour guide Phil. From the very start of our time with him, my feelings quickly changed. Phil’s knowledge and demeanor and sense of humor and 20 years of doing a job that he obviously loves, turned my expectation of “mediocre” into one of the best experiences of our time in London. It was like winning tickets to front of the line and best available seats (walking seats). What we saw was available to everyone who comes to London, what we experienced was only available to those lucky enough to join Phil’s group! Thanks, Phil, for an excellent time.
Your Canadian Friends

Booked online on the day, very easy to use, hop on and off at the stops you are interested in. Very quiet first thing we got on the first bus at 9.05am from St Paul’s Cathedral. Buses get busier as the day goes on. Driver advised us on which stop to get off. Commentary with free earphones, ok, lots of history included. Each stop is announced so you have time to jump off. Buses come every 20 minutes. Really enjoyed this and would highly recommend as a good way to see all of London. Cheaper to book online. Red route for all the main sights.
