Bus rides with audioguide were quite mediocre - you'll get to listen to decent songs while waiting in the traffic jams, but won't learn much about London (or British) history. The evening tour with live guide coverage (courtesy of the amazing Julia) was a totally different experience - make sure to check, if the evening tour has a guide or just the audio version (and pick the day with a guide). The guided walking tours with Julia the next day were the best out of all Big Bus package - if you want to learn about London, these are a must!

We got to see plenty of the London sights on the red route of this tour. All the staff were very helpful, on the bus & off the bus. They pointed us in the right direction for next bus stop, when we hopped off/hopped on. The Thames boat trip was a added bonus & the boat guide was very informative & comical.

Took the red bus tour with 2 guides, Chloe and Julia. Julia was fun and friendly. Chloe was really funny. The service was great. We thoroughly enjoyed it and would not hesitate to recommend the tour to anyone unfamiliar with London. It’s a great first or second day of a vacation as you get a good view of many things that can be explored later in greater detail.

Easy and informative way to see a big city. Some said the audio guide was childish, I found it entertaining & funny. It kept my 11 & 14 year olds attention. We always take a hop on hop off bus anywhere we go- it gives you a good lay of the land and you end up seeing more than you would just walking.

Big Steve and Jackie (guide and driver respectively) were incredible guides for our group of students! Steve discussed bits of history throughout the tour and gave our students optimal picture-taking opportunities while we passed notable London landmarks. His English accent made the tour immensely entertaining as he also shared stories and connections between the history of London and of the U.S.A (where our group is from). I have no doubt the students enjoyed the trip as well as learned a bunch about things to do in London! Would highly recommend!

We loved and enjoyed our experience. We enjoyed the red line specifically having the tour guide - something you don’t see in other major cities. Shoutout to FREDDY who made us chuckle along the tour. The bus was exceptionally clean and we loved hearing all the fun facts about London. The best part was getting on the inclusive boat that tours across the Thames River. Absolutely the best experience ever. We had our little one ( 3 yr old) sans stroller and it was great utilizing this versus taking the subway.

We had a start point from Marble arch and managed both tours in an action packed afternoon including the river cruise.

The commentary as ever was lighthearted and shared key facts and information. If I had my time again I would advise buying two day pass. Do blue tour first and spend morning in Harrods and picnic in the park and see Diana monument in afternoon.

The red tour the following day again an early start and get out at Trafalgar Square and Tower of London. Then get boat cruise back for mid afternoon to see the final leg at Buckingham Palace.

What a waste of money. The audio was silly chatter and didn't really share any information about what we were seeing or history of the area/sites. I get on these busses to learn about the area/sites I'm seeing, and have never experienced anything like this before. We might as well have taken the tube. Will not be using Big Bus Tours again.

Great tour company to use to see all of the sights of London! Amazing bus drivers and guides. We bought a two day ticket and it was great! We had no issues until our second day when the bus’s didn’t have WiFi and the bus we hopped on to you couldn’t see out of the windows clearly due to a massive advertisement over the whole bus.
This was a little annoying when I had work emails that needed to be checked and we were unable to.

Our trip was 2 days and I was so Happy that we decided to book Big Bus
The bus took us to great places, with the app we downloaded onto our phones we managed to see where the nearest bus stop is and how close the bus is.
Julia the tour guide was super friendly, had great knowledge of the history and was very interactive with the other people on the bus.
Loved the double decker, we usually sat on the top, and took the sights in.
Highly recommend Big Bus if you want to see the city in an easy and fast way.

In our experience was a good hop on hop off service, it has a long red route and a shorter blue route, with all that you cover a lot of the must see of London. We didn´t have any problem with the service we used during 2 days ( Premium ). Julia from the Walking Tours included was really nice and a good guide, we had the chance of doing 2 of the 3 walking tours and she was a sweetheart. 5 stars to her!

Possible to see most of London and spend time at your chosen attractions. But if you have a group , make sure each person has a single ticket. Also make sure you sit on top deck. Viewing very limited and stuffy on bottom.Also a live help line could eliminate wasted time for international travelers not familiar with London. We wasted an hour looking for the Victoria Station site to begin our tour.

Me and my mummy really enjoyed ourselves on the bus tour. The tour guide was funny and very informative. After about an hour of the trip we had an option to get off the bus and go on a walking tour with one of the tour guides named Tiffany. Tiffany showed us around st Paul's cathedral and through many streets and alley ways we would not have been able to see on the bus tour. This gives you the opportunity to see the small details in the streets of london. Tiffany was very informative and was very easy to talk to. She even told us a couple of secret spots to get a great view of the city. I would definitely recommend it!!

It was ok but can’t understand if you book online it asks what kind of attractions interest you. Then it gives you a list of places that fit into the categories chosen. I noted down which of the suggested places I found appealing and the stop numbers. You are given a map with the routes marked out and they are also numbered. Sounds easy right? So you listing to the commentary and so why don’t they say this is stop number 5 or 6 ect?
This would make it much more simple to know where to get off the bus.

Big bus zero stars (if I could) river cruise five stars.
Big bus - Crowded, recorded commentary out of sync with location and boring as hell. Just dreadful. Learnt nothing saw nothing.

Enjoyed it, despite most of the stops being closed due to the Ride London event. We were lucky enough to have a guide on board who did a great job improvising with all the diversions, thanks . I lived in London for 12 years and never did the tourist thing, so it was good to go back and be driven around for a change. I have forgotten the name of the guide, but I think it was Julia?

Our London experience today was brilliant for so many reasons but the open top bus tour along with the river cruise added to the enjoyment of it all. It’s pre-recorded commentary or at least it was with us but with headphones included you could listen as much or as little as you liked. The river cruise was brilliant. Jack the ‘captain’ I’m sorry we had no change with which to tip you but hopefully a good review will be a good second best…. Your sarcastic narrative was perfect and had me chuckling away the whole time!! Well worth it for that alone! Definitely all money well spent. All the work force we encountered were polite and friendly. We will definitely use you again! Thank you.

The hop-on hop off tour is a great way to see the sights and get a lay of the land while in London, especially if you are only in town for a short period of time. We were able to see most things from the bus and could stop when we chose to take a closer look at the few things we had more interest in. Because there is so much to do in London if you followed all the tours and never got off the buses (except to change from one tour to the next) you could sit on the bus all day without actually visiting a site. The automated tour guide (in multiple languages) was great, we did have a live guide on several tours and found they were not as good as listening to the pre-recorded descriptions of the sights.

If I could give 2.5 I would. Lots of bad. One thing good, after a bit of an email exchange.

Never got to use the service. We unfortunately booked our London visit (unknowingly) during the 70th Jubilee Weekend. Sounds good right? Not.

16 of 25 pickup stops closed. Crowds like you've never seen before. Horrible. When I called it was..."make it to the closest stop and you can get on". Highly unlikely if not impossible.

Initial denied refund, nor even an offer of a partial refund. A couple of frank emails - "put yourself and your FAMILY in that position...what would you expect?"

After an escalation or two, full credit. That's why they get anything in the middle.

Word to the wise - check local activities and where you'll be staying for pickup locations.

I purchased 3 bus tickets and my credit card was charged. The website had an error once I clicked to confirm my purchase which caused me to never receive the tickets. I tried to contact Big Bus Tours but they never responded. I even contacted my credit card company, Chase, and filed a dispute but they did not assist which has shocked me. I never took the tour because I obviously never got the tickets. This is very upsetting. I just want others to know and beware. I just wanted my money back because I paid for a service that was never used.

Not frequent enough bus service! Also we booked online so didn’t get a map. Couldn’t find any maps on any bus, and the app was awful! Luckily I’d been to London a number of times, so recognised some of the places and could point them out to my daughter.
The traffic was so bad as well, that we got off and walked!
Also found a couple of the drivers were extremely miserable. This experience was no different to getting on a regular London bus, but much more expensive! In fact at least you know where the regular London bus is going, as it announces each stop!
I would advise updating your buses to have bus stop announcements or video screens. We’re paying enough.

Me and my kids really enjoyed seeing London from the bus tour. The bus stop was easy to find and we loved the breeze. I am not really impressed by the staff in the bus and they refused to ask a noisy passenger to leave. Overall it was pleasant

W had a lovely guide that came onto our bus and ask if anyone wanted to do a walking tour. Our guide was Julia and I have to say she was exceptional she was full of information and we thoroughly enjoyed the tour . I would highly recommend taking the tours .

Meh… ok way to get around but crowded and not that frequent. Other buses came and went more frequently. Recorded guides somewhat informative but also kind of annoying. To see buckingham palace you have to get off the bus and walk across the park. Views probably better from the upper deck than from inside.

Waited over an hour for a bus, no bus. Based on the map of where the busses were we walked to another bus stop and finally a bus came. The driver told us there was a parade and the route was shut down and not to get on the bus. Waste of time and money. And they refused to provide a refund.

Fesih at Hop on Hop pff based at Victoria Station was an absolute gem . He was extremely helpful and friendly. Five stars 🌟
Highly recommend Hop on Hop off ; a brilliant way to see London. On board audio was great provided by headphones that you plug into the seat.Different languages available

When we had the live guide the tour was fantastic and we learnt lots of interesting tit bits about London. The recorded tour was not great and really was underwhelming. Goes past all major landmarks so combines well seeing the things you don’t want to actually visit and providing a mode of transport to the places you do want to visit.

Got tickets through virgin experience vouchers, was easy to exchange for tickets. Kids age 10,13 and I enjoyed it and commentary was interesting and kept them entertained. Was sometimes confusing when to grt off. Never waited more than 15 mins for a bus. The river cruise was great.

A total waste of time. Bus stops are not located where they say they are. After searching for an hour to find the stop, we waited two hours for the bus. It never came. Had to walk three miles back to our hotel. The bus sits in traffic and it takes twice as long to ride the bus than to walk. Save your money. Walk where you want to go. If you have the money, take a cab.

Was in London 5/17/2022. Thought this would be a good way to get a feel for the city. I have taken various HOHO tours in cities in the past. Was very disappointed with this tour. There was no live guide as the picture in their ad depicts. The guide info was pre recorded and provided minimal information at best. I do not recommend this service when in London.

We loved the hop-on hop-off tour. They have a great connection with different (coloured) lines. The busdriver Patrick and touroperator Chris where very nice. After the last tour they brought us nearby our hotel. Great service! I recommend!

Hop on Hop off provided just the overview of London that I needed for a short visit, having not been there in 40 years!

I found the commentary of the guide on the bus to be helpful and informative.

We couldn't always hear him quite well, but most of the time good enough.

We took advantage of the free boat trip the next day, a significant bonus value.

Purchased a 2 day ticket which included a river cruise and evening tour. The bus tour itself was great however the stops on the App aren’t always where they actually are! The river cruise was a highlight with great commentary provided by Tom, not actually his job but should be, his knowledge of London was superb and we were given an insight into the history and present day goings on. We cruised to Greenwich and back and it was lovely.

On the 1PM tour from St Paul’s with Nick. Good guide, very enthusiastic. He is new to the job by his own admission. Knowledgeable but needs to tone down asking clients to “respond enthusiastically “ so often. It’s fun, 1,2,3 times but then, not so much. Oooh, aaah, grrr, etc.
Hoping he gets to create walking tours of his own in future.
The Mexican/ Trump supporters.

We used the big bus tour round the centre of London today and thought it was fab! The commentary is brill, the traffic was a bit of a pain but you’d expect no less for London city centre! (& protests). Every driver was extremely helpful and the stops are dotted equally around the centre, meaning you never have to walk far to access one. My 7year old thought it was great fun and loved hearing the info for herself and seeing the sights from a height!

This is the worst experience I have ever had with Big Bus tour. Save your money and book with a different company that has live guides. The recorded commentary was beyond horrible. I learned nothing! I was alerted Everytime there was a stop with an annoying - Ding ding the witch is dead. Take the city bus - you will get just as much information about London. I tried to get a refund after being on the bus for 5 minutes and realizing how bad it was going to be and was told no. If you want to listen to music from artists not even from London as you drive around wondering what landmarks are this is the tour for you. If you want to learn about London go with a tour with a live guide. Huge waste of time and money!

I am giving the Big Bus all 5 stars because of Phil- the nighttime tour guide. The only time we had a live guide was during our night time tour and Phil was AMAZING!!! He was personable and knowledgeable. He kept everyone engaged. The daytime tours were pre recorded but were good. Buses ran on time. The river cruise was also good and both guides did a good job.

I highly recommend you take any walking tour that is offered. Molly (a Big Bus Tour guide) came on our bus at one of the stops and offered a walking tour to Tower of London to anyone on the bus that wanted it m. I had no idea what I was getting into but it sounded cool so I went. SOOO glad I did!! The walking tour shows you so many things you never could have seen on the bus! Molly was my tour guide and she was amazing!! I’m so happy I decided to take a chance on the walking tour! Highly recommend Molly’s tour!!
🇬🇧👊😃

We took the evening bus with Steve as our guide and he was great! Very knowledgeable, friendly and entertaining. Paul was our driver and was very helpful! We enjoyed the river tour as well- the guide had a great sense of humor. London is a beautiful city!

We have spent the day on the hop on hop off bus. Such good value for money with the cruise included. It’s the easiest way to see all the sights especially with two kids. It was made with having a live tour guide “big Steve” he was very informative, helpful and fun.

It was great! Sometimes it’s tricky getting a spot on a bus and you can’t see out of the lower level in the back, there’s decor on the windows. I loved the audio recording though. It was a great price as well.

had weekend in london bought 24 hour ticket at 2pm but from 6pm till 830am no buses.
then we spent well over an hour waiting for a bus walked to 3 stops still no bus.

other than these little issues rest of tour was good, river cruise was amazing

I was taking my 83-year-old dad to London and thought this would be a good way. After we found the pick up point at Trafalgar Square, the driver seemed nice enough. But the headphones for me and for the lady in front of me didn't work and there were just too many stops where we just sat there. We got off an hour later at London Bridge and took the subway everywhere for 4 days, which was great!! We were never given any commentary over the speaker.

Purchased 2 family passes online (8 tickets) from Hop on/off Big Bus London. The website crashed but still took my money. I never received any confirmation of tickets but they assured me they would refund me when I spoke with them face to face. I’m still waiting over a week later. I have proof of purchase from my bank statements but can’t get speaking with anyone. Have tried to contact them several times with no success. Their live chat is ridiculous- waited 14 hours for a response !!! Their email not much better - one automated response saying they will get back to me shortly (which was a week ago). Very poor - do not book online !

Terrible customer service! Nowadays when every decent and responsible company helps their customers with any Covid-19 related issue, this greedy company will not. We couldn't make it to London due to Covid and even though this company didn't incur in any expenses when we canceled (since their busses will run no matter what), they refused to issue a refund. We had to escalate the issue with our credit card company to get our money back. Do NOT do business with them!!

This is an FYI. The Big Bus is really great, however, the stops are not clearly marked on the street. Small sign with no identification,per se, on the existing signs. The map that is given shows the stops, but no names. When I asked my driver to let me know when I got to stop 33, his response was the he did not know what stop 33 was! Big Bus should add a list of their stops & the names for each on their maps. The two routs are wonderful & do give you a great view of London. I did find it difficult to locate other stops once I got off.

The company notified me on the day of my tour that 10+ stops were going to be closed due to Pride celebrations. These closures would have been known when I bought the tickets a few days earlier but I wasn't notified until after I had fully paid for my ticket and was literally about to hop on the bus. When I tried to get a refund they basically told me to f off, absolutely terrible customer experience, and beware of the cancellation policy in particular

Disappointed, we booked the tour expecting to have an tour full of historic facts. What we received was limited historical information and more just approaching a stop for the following sights.

Went past numerous historical places no mention of them, the recorded commentary was mostly music or what was know has “big bus banter” not what we were expecting. I would say that the recording was around 70% music.

Would not recommend.

This tour in comparison to city sightseeing tours is really crap. The commentary is basically banter and rubbish. Tells you where to go shopping and fails to point out what is being talked about. Doesn’t mention many interesting sights. Not mich better than just a public bus. We jumped off and got straight onto a city sightseeing bus..

The cruise travel very good 😊. The bus travel too very nice and convenient that you can hop on any hop off anytime . As London is extended much more than what we see there , it would be if they tailor a program which extends coverage to other important areas as well . For example the famous residential area etc ..

the only way to travel around the city except for using the Tube. It was so great to listen to the audio tour but more importantly hop on and off at the various locations. Just be mindful of when they stop their service. Clean and very helpful drivers.

We did the River boat cruise which was short but very informative with a great funny tour guide. He made it worth while! Another day we did the changing of the guard walking tour with Julia. Her wit and charm made the tour fun! She had all the right stops on the tour. Do not hesitate to try the walking tour with her. You will not be disappointed. I loved her accent too 😃

We have been with Big Bus tour for 2 days and the experience was good. The audio in the buses is wished to be better, cause it didn’t tell a lot. But the guides were perfect. This tour included as well 3 walking tours and those were amazing, of course because of great work of guides Julia and Molly! We have been with Molly only during one guided tour, and with Julia we have been for two walking tours and evening ride. Thank you both very much! We had fun with you. 😊 And the boat trip was great and guide - Jack was very funny and awesome.

We were disappointed by the limited narration given during the tour. They spent much time trying to make jokes, but little to provide insight into what we were seeing. Paid for a two-day ticket but used it only one day.

We didn't take the tour the first time we were there. We thought we don't need it,as we're more of a DIY kind of a couple. Our second time in London, we said "WTH, Let's try it". And you know what, we enjoyed it! The guides were very very knowledgeable. Also, it's a great way to get around London, which saves you your Oyster card load. Ohh btw, take the river cruise. It's free one way, but if you plan your itinerary right (from Tower of London to Big Ben) you save up as well. And did I mention the guide on the river cruise was funny as hell? Dry British Humor at its best.

Busses were dependable. Always showed up at the right time and place. On the map the stops are listed as numbers but the announcements and physical stops never mentioned a number so it was hard to follow the map. The trip on the boat was a little confusing because the boat never mentioned big bus tours, it was called something else. The nighttime tour started at 6 pm and it was still light at 8 pm so it really wasn't a nighttime tour. Overall good experience. Saved us some walking.

We had a great day on the big bus tour, we did both the blue and red and the river cruise. First on the red tour from tower hill, settled with headphone to listen to commentary, it was awful. The women's voice went right though you and the attempts the pair made to be funny was not appreciated at all. We missed a lot of the information because of all the rubbish in-between, just couldn't keep listening. Time to get a new recording. Where as the blue tour was informative and great music in-between commentary. So much better. The hop on hop off was great and the map to be able to see where buses were and how long to wait was great. Also I must congratulate jack the guide on the river cruise, really informative and a great laugh as well. Really finished the trip off nicely.

The narrator would tell you what you were going to see way too much ahead of time and then you would pass it without it being pointed out to you. No interesting facts on most buildings. Bus stops not marked. Not worth the money.

Great experience for our family and managed to sew all the sites in one day!! Julia was fabulous on the walking tour. Bus ride would have benefitted from live commentary. Glad we took this option to see london. Thanks Julia!!!

Absolutely enjoyable time visiting all the popular hotspots in London in an engaging way. Thank you to Andy who got us an empty bus so we didn’t have to wait in the heat! Our family loved the river cruise with Jordan commenting in a humorous way. Would 100% recommend these 2, especially the 2 men who helped out and made our trip in London enjoyable!

Loved our day on the on off bus! Went during summer holidays and there was always a bus just around the corner and plenty of seats available. Unfortunately due to road works we didn’t get to see the Buckingham Palace on the bus but was easy to get back to. I recommend this company!

Overall an excellent experience with a recorded commentary. Although we have visited London many times over the last 50 years it is always good to have a reminder of the various sites to view. The cruise down the River Thames was most enjoyable.

The good part about this tour is it was a beautiful day and we sat on the second level. The bad part was we had to guess what we were seeing, because the guide's microphone or speaker was barely audible. So we tried to us the earphones they gave us and at multiple seats, they did not work either. Also the guide was a big grouch. He gave the impression he hated his job. Thumbs down.

This was a complete waist of money. Stuck in traffic most of the time. Some stops they did not go to and the commentary was absolutely awful. We actually listened to music most of the time. I did this tour 20 years ago with a real guide and it was a completely different experience.

The only good thing about this tour was that a Thames cruise was included between the Tower of London and Westminster and that was excellent. The guide during that tour was 5 stars. Learned much more on that tour and on the bus.

So save your money and get a Thames cruise instead.

In late afternoon we asked driver if he was going to Piccadilly Circus, he replied ‘yes in 20 minutes’. Over an hour later we were told the ride was over and we never went to our destination. We had to walk more than a mile to get to Piccadilly Circus.

I have a 48hour big bus tour with river cruise. I’ve been for the first day, I found the bus stops easy to find and close to attractions. I did a free Jack the Ripper walking tour with Julia, who is fabulous! She’s so friendly and makes the tour very informative. I’m currently on the river tour with live commentary from our crew. I highly recommend Big Bus Tours London

Amazing team of staff in London. We had a little trouble with our ticket but this was quickly resolved. (Thank you Ashley and Debbie) the bus tour was a great way to see the sites of London and the river cruise was highly entertaining the captain was really really funny and very knowledgable. We had a wonderful time and would definitely do all over again tomorrow if we could.

We did the loop then we went on our first walking tour. Our guide Julia was fantastic. Told us what to expect on the way and what we would see. So it was off to the changing of the guard. In my mind we saw more than had we stayed and jockeyed for position at the main gate. Thanks Julia a great walk. Because we had a boat tour we left our second walk to the next day. The third walk we couldn't do as there wasn't time.
Next day we got off the bus for the start of our second walk low and behold who turns up but Julia so we new this would be good and it was.
Julia is very knowledgeable in her job and will quickly help with things outside her job which really is an asset to london and Bigbus. If management read these reports it's time you had more than 3 guides.

Great way to see the city especially if first time. there’s two routes which great. Although since the routes are long I feel like you spend a lot of time on the bus and waiting for the bus that it’s almost better to see the sites on your own using the underground. says bus comes every 20 minutes but sometimes it’s longer .. better off to start walking to the next site see. In conclusion it’s a good way to see things but don’t rely it on your only use of site seeing

Chose this company because of the frequency of buses - 15 to 20mins. Still waiting at the stop after 60 minutes on a Saturday morning. All other companies have had at least two buses come past. The app is terrible with buses just disappearing. Ruined our day trip. Avoid at all costs.

Was not thrilled with this tour. We waited more than 30 minutes for a bus to come after we realized we got off at the wron stop. Not a personal tour guide at all. The commentary was boring. The two people talking on the audio kept saying the same jokes (they thought were jokes) throughout the tour.

It was very efficient / very useful for a day in London - we could jump off and on as we wished. Stopping for lunch and as many attractions as we wanted / the commentary was so interesting and the drivers great. The traffic was good as it was a Sunday but I think during the week there would be a lot of ‘standstill moments’

DO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY - many of the buses seemed to go their own route whilst others followed the set route but it was a roulette as to where your bus would go. A whole section of the tour from London Eye to Tower Bridge was cancelled - however it took the 4th member of staff we asked to find out this information. Save your money and get an all day travel pass/use the subway and get a guide book. The buses we did manage to catch - neither took us the correct route and neither had working ear phone guides.

We wanted to do a tour where we could see the sights and learn some info without having to get off and 'do stuff'. We did the red route tour and had a great time. We got off a couple of times for a closer look but mostly just stayed on the bus and listened to the live commentary, which is exactly what we were after. Our ticket was valid for 24 hours so we did the walking tour the next morning which was fantastic! I highly recommend making the most of your ticket and doing the walking tour.

A huge shout out to Christopher on our bus for being an awesome guide, he was fun and friendly and full of knowledg. Also to Julia who did our walking tour, it is clear she loves her job and loves history and she taught us a lot.

Our family visited for a long weekend to enjoy a bit of London and, as we often do, booked a Big Bus tour to get the lay of the land. First guide was okay but not especially informative about the geography or history. Second guide "Nobby" (presumably Clark since he's ex-forces), was excelllent. Humourous, informed, and engaging on a cold morning, he made it a great part of the trip.

We thoroughly enjoyed our experience on the hop on hop off bus. “Wikipedia Will “
Made sure we had a entertaining and informative tour.. he made the whole trip! He knows everything there is to know about London and it’s history and imparts his knowledge in a fun and engaging way.
Very happy to recommend this tour.

If you love adventure and get a thrill from being lost, this is the tour for you. After a good start and a knowledgeable guide, we got off the bus at Waterloo and took the river cruise. Everything fine so far. When we got off the boat we were told to wait at a certain bus stop. A kind local told us the big bus did not stop there and we needed to walk across the bridge. On the other side of the bridge a couple of Big Bus staff gave us directions to another non existent Big Bus stop. We paid for public transport to Victoria BC and walked to Buckingham Palace. After that we found a Big Bus stop NB and got on the next Big Bus. We plugged in our headphones and discovered many languages but not English. We gave up, got off and found our own way back to London Bridge and home. Never again Bug Bus tours.

We bought the ticket but due to traffic cuts we were not able to see all it was supossed and we were disappointed becuase nobody told us about that at the time of buying the tickets. Thanks to the driver Govind Wikeumd, who was really really nice, we enjoyed the part of London we could visit. This happened 3 years ago but I lost the paper with the name of this person and today I have found it and decided to write. Congratulations for having people like this nice man.

Great that you can hop off throughout the journey to visit places that interest you in more depth, then hop back on to continue your tour later on. I didn't partake in the audio part as was content with the sights. A nice couple of hours ride around London in a open top bus.

Wanted to give Chloe & Jackie a shout out for an awesome experience today! Chloe was very knowledgeable of London and kept us very entertained throughout the tour. Jackie was and exceptional driver and knew her way around.

Also a shout out to Craig,
the on street manager at the Tower of London Big Bus Stop who was very welcoming, friendly and helpful upon arriving at the stop.

We will be back again!

Able to see many sights with recorded commentary including MUSIC . The red loop took me from Hyde Park to the Tower of London, past the Eye and Parliament and all the shopping streets as well as neighborhoods. I really saw and learned a lot..and since most museums are closed, this is the best that I could do for April. Ashley was particularly helpful!

My family and I visited London last week coming from Australia and thoroughly enjoyed our tour on the red route. Our tour guide was William and we all praised him for his interesting facts and engaging demeanour. Would recommend!

We’re visiting from the states and this was a great way to see a bunch of different places and travel across London for the day. Julia was an amazing tour guide and very knowledge. You could tell she was enthusiastic and like everything she talked about. Very friendly!

We were able to enjoy the red line and river cruise during our ticket window. Always a great way to get oriented in a new city, and learn a little history. Sitting on top of the bus is the best way to see London, especially on a nice spring day.

Pretty poor tbh. Haven’t been on the Big Bus Tour and wouldn’t again. Giving 3*’s mainly because the city cruise was worth it. The bus wasn’t. Commentary was terrible and probably worst I’ve experienced on a tour bus. We wanted facts and history not listening to rediculous patronising banter between two people speaking to us like we were school kids. 95% of the bus were adults. The music inbetween was also annoying, esp as it kept going off, along with commentary starting then going off. There was less facts and more banter trying to be cool and funny..it wasn’t. Major landmarks werent even mentioned and some stops were skipped. Also, the Queen has passed now so the commentary needs updating. Banter about the Queen is not appropriate. Will not use Big Bus Company again.

We had to wait over 40 minutes for a bus. Every time one came the driver said to wait for the next one. This was a week after the jubilee and roads were open. We missed some planned activities. I sent a request for a refund and did not get a response.

Was disappointed in the bus trip. We boarded at Westminster and was expecting to go a circular tour and go to tower bridge to catch boat trip but it just went basically to Green Park and back again. We had to walk from Westminster to Tower, there were others on the trip announced as well. Boat trip was super and super commentary too.

We used the bus tour for two days in a row and were delighted to have the same host, “Wikipedia Will” for both days. His excellent and informative commentary really added a lot to our experience. Our sincere thanks to him for such a wonderful job well done.

I went on all three walking tours with Julia and all three were amazing!! Julia is so full of knowledge and made my trip so much better with all the information she provided. I definitely got more out of the tour by doing the walking tours and the experience was so much better than just riding the bus around. I have rode the bus around in other cities and can definitely compare the two experiences. Great job Julia!!!

I really enjoyed my experience with Big Bus! They provide excellent service, all the staff were friendly and earphones were provided. A special thanks to Christopher (our live guide on the bus), he really did a great job and made the bus tour very enjoyable. Another special thanks to Julia (our walking tour guide), she was considerate and lots of fun.
Great value for money if you use the bus tour, cruise and walking tour!

Had access as part of the London pass during November 2019. The schedule was very confusing and we ended up spending 45 min waiting for a bus to take us to Kensington Palace only to end up taking an Uber instead. Come to find out, that bus only ran in the morning and not at all in the afternoon/evening. We then had to take the Underground back to our hotel.

The next day we spent > 1 hr trying to get to Westminter due to traffic. While not specifically their fault, you can save money buy just buying a pass on the Underground which will take you everywhere you need to go.

I will say that with the right tour guide at the right time of day, it is a good way to get an overview of the city.

Booked through Groupon which was good value for money. The tour itself was great as the weather was perfect and you did get to see most of the sights of London on the top deck. Automated commentary wasn't great as it was very sporadic, although the music choice was good. A highlight of the experience was a very generous Ticket Salesman named Rosh who was very accommodating and empathetic when we had a problem with our Groupon voucher. So thank you Rosh, you were a gentleman👍😊 The River Cruise was great as well with better commentary from Dave from whom we learnt a lot about London.

As a party we joined the bus at Paddington on the Blue route. After a couple of stops we changed to the red route.
What a wonderful experience to see all the sites of London, in the comfort of an open top bus, along with running commentary explaining all the wonderful landmarks.
Unfortunately, we didn't have time to have a river cruise which was included in the price of the ticket.
Very good value for money, particularly if we had more time to go all around the blue route as well.

My husband and I visited London for the day as I wanted to see London Xmas lights. We were at Leicester Square when I saw a bus pass and thought I'd look into it. The man sold it to us and it looked good fun to see everywhere and we could hit off where we like but we decided to stay on all the way around which took about 2 hours. Very informative and good fun.

This was such a disappointment compared to hop-on buses in other cities. Although they offer three color-coded routes and a river cruise, the ride consists mainly of sitting in traffic with a smattering of narration and mostly music. We wasted a couple of hours that could have been filled with London facts and history. At least they could have had a running commentary of what we were looking at as we went along. We found getting around was a lot more efficient using the Underground.

We only had one day in London and wanted to make the most of it. It’s our first time here. We started early in the morning, and fortunately we were able to also do the complimentary walking tour of Buckingham palace with Nick, it was great. Being seniors and having just flown in from Orlando, we are tired, we didn’t want to walk too much, but also wanted to see more of London than riding.
Nick was great and we saw so much in a couple of hours. Plus we got to do 2 complete tours around the city on the red line. So I feel like for having only one day, we got to see a lot. Tomorrow we leave in our cruise and we are already planning on our next visit to London because it is a beautiful city

Had a really enjoyable time. we used the app to see when a bus was close by, and we hopped on at covert garden. it was raining but still enjoyed it and got to see lots of London on the red route. You got prepacked headphones which you plug in and listen to the commentary which was very interesting! we had a helpful driver to who explained the whole process to us

Pros: multiple routes so ensure you give lots of time to view it all.
Cons: Had to ask for headphones as the drive assumes your not on the first ride. Ask as you board rather sitting expecting someone to come with them.

The tour covered so many sites. The audio was clear & informative. There were always company staff at the stops to assist. Don’t miss the River cruise included with the ticket; it was spectacular. We were lucky to catch a sunny day and got great photos. The tour whet our appetite to return soon for a more in depth visit.

I have used a hop on hop off for years to tour the cities
The bus itself was good. They did take us to most of the common tourist destinations in London. However, the commentary and tour information was terrible. It didn't point out highlights as expected and it was very difficult to follow where they were or what information they were trying to give.
Kind of a disappoint.

We had several choices for hop on/off buses, but picked the Big Bus hop on/off. We did a twi day pass and was very satisfied we them. They had plenty of buses and we did both the Red line and blue line. We will see everything on those two routes. Glad we did two days. Highly recommend them.

We purchased a 48 hour hop on, hop off ticket prior to our arrival in London.

Unfortunately when purchasing on the app (and forgetting to sign in) I had to contact their customer service department who sent me the email (and my mind at ease) within minutes.

We were staying in the Tower Bridge area and therefore the 1st stop was right across the road from our hotel.

The exchange for tickets was easy, the app worked for me showing the frequency and approx location for the buses and the river cruise was also very informative (good local knowledge).

Whilst not my 1st time in London it was my children's and wanted them to be able to see as much as they could during our stay.

I would definitely recommend the hop on, hop off experience.

We paid too much for it at £39. Buses crowded. No live commentary and when we had to change buses (no explanation) we had to fight for a space.
The worst thing I have ever been on. Utter pants for the price. In fact if it was a pair of pants it would be y fronts with skid marks. Appalling service, no communication, book with the red official sightseeing one which is what we thought we had booked.

Very disappointed. Done the big bus many times and I have to say on Friday was a total waste of money. Took just over 1 hour to complete the tour. Lots of stops missed out.
Very disappointed as it was my daughter’s and granddaughters first time on the tour bus. Was expecting to hop on and off but the places we could wasn’t of much interest.
Don’t waste your money or valuable time with this company. Go with another one that does cover the popular stops like Buckingham palace, Trafalgar Square, leister square, Covent Garden. Recorded information waste of time. Not very interesting.

Being able to see all the main sites and attractions of London was so convenient and fun! But I have to say the real gem is the guided tours which are free with the day long bus ticket. And Nick L was a wellspring of interesting information and history. He was funny and had all the best recommendations around town. We legit did three of his walking tours in one day! Take the bus and take his tours.

We passed many beautiful buildings but opportunities were missed to share fascinating and interesting information- instead we were subjected to ridiculous trivia about fish and chips. I particularly disliked the trendy happy banter of the narrators and would have preferred less pop music in between snippets of dialogue. We were, at several intervals, informed that we could ‘hop off’ and that’s what I would advise.

Met Sid at Baker Street who was friendly and funny. Told us our options and provided detail of what we needed with our tickets and what we would see. Very knowledgeable and to do it with a smile and making us laugh was great start to the trip

If Nick jumps on your bus and asks you if you want to go on one of his walking tours. Just go! Don’t even think about it. He does a bunch of different tours. He is fun, charming, knowledgeable and has many fact useless facts that make the tour interesting. We loved it it!

We first took the blue line and it was audio recorded commentary, it was terrible. Timing was off and we missed so much. We then took the red line and found it was live commentary with Julia, it was fabulous. So much better!!! Bring back the live commentary!!!

Poor supply of buses was my experience. Waited 40 minutes at the stop and no service. At least 4 busses each from 2 rival companies. Eventually had to pay for another 2 seats with another company - City Sightseeing. Same tickets were cheaper and buses more frequent.

Clifford is the rudest driver ever on the service. Ticket was bought and wasn’t working when scanned but told us it’s not his problem. Lucky one of the guys from the beginning of the tour told us he would help us get on the next bus and ran straight over when next one came and helped us didn’t get his name but amazing customer service.

Bought 2 day ticket for a family of 3. Great way of seeing more of London than previous visits. Loads of bus availability and app was very helpful.
Staff were friendly and we were blessed with the sun to enjoy sitting up top.
Yes the bus made detours sue to road closures and heavy traffic. However certainly not a negative as the experience as a whole was great.
Would recommend.

It’s the best way to see as much of the city as possible in 2 days . The information on the tour is great and it’s fun. The staff at the bus stops are great fun and helpful.
I used the app to see when the next bus is coming, worth every penny

We chose the deluxe ticket and it was great. 3 days of hop on hop off was perfect for all we wanted to see. We really enjoyed the river cruise and evening tour. The best part was our tour guide Nick, who took us to the changing of the guard. He knew where to take us to get the best view. He was very knowledgeable and just downright funny.

It was horrible. First had to wait 40 min to catch first time and get started. Later on we hopped off and then tried to hop on later. After nearly 1.5 hrs later we finally gave up. Total waste of time and cost us the ability to see many sights we wanted to see.

Loved that I got Steve on the hop on hop off tour. Was disappointed when my first bus was just headphones. I enjoy a personal tour. He gave great commentary and tips for the best pictures. More busses need live tour guides!! Still overall a great experience to see all the big stops in London.

Bus covers all the basics. However we completely missed Buckingham Palace (presumably because of the upcoming marathon) but got no advance warning. Stuck in traffic half the time, so tour takes longer than it says. Prerecorded commentary tries a little too hard to be funny, should focus more on informing.

Me and my wife had a great time hopping on and off to get round London, Emma on one bus and Phil on the other bus had us completly immersed in London history. Their knowledge was second to none and we felt as if we were living the past today.

Thanks Big Red Bus Emma and Phil

The bus is great for seeing all the sights and getting a grasp of where everything is...From a bus. The audio is corney but informative. A lot of stops and sitting in traffic tho. Getting on & off to see the sights ..I don't know. I think you are better off walking, taxing, taking the tube or bus system to where you want to go. You spend to much time sitting in traffic on these busses.

Always wanted to take the sightseeing bus around London even tho we’re locals. We booked the bus to take our 4 yr old daughter who’s obsessed with everything London. We throughly enjoyed the trip. Tiffany was the guide on our bus and she was amazing. So informative and told us some great facts that we never knew. Elan was our drive and was brilliant and helpful when we got on and off the bus. Thank you to you both. :)

We got the two day ticket and it was very much worth the money.
The auto recording was informative and had nice music to it. But the tour guides themselves were so much better to listen to.
We had 4 different guides, including Ian and Lulu (I think). They all provided different facts, as we did go round a few places twice. All of them made jokes, which were bad but still made you laugh.
The drivers are polite and amazing for driving round London!
Had a great, but cold time on the buses and would definitely recommend.

Very poorly organized. Waited at stop 25. Bus arrived full. Walked to stop 24 there were two empty busses. Crowds of people waiting for over 15 minutes. Other hop on hop off tours seemed better organized.

Worst hop on hop off tour I have ever been on. This was our first time to London and this was essentially useless from an information standpoint. Instead of info on the amazing looking buildings/neighborhoods you are driving by you get weak jokes and random pop music for blocks and blocks. Total waste of money. I hope I save others from this awful tour.

The worst tour we ever did. The commentary lacks of information. It's supposed to be funny, but it isn't at all, it's just annoying and distracting. F.e. you cross Westminster bridge and nothing about Westminster or Big Ben is told, instead they bring some advertisement for shrek's adventure or the dungeon.
Because of the London Marathon one tour changed, the guides sent us to the wrong place to change the bus, so we had do go back by underground. We will never ever book a Hop-on-hop-off tour with Big Bus again.

We were stranded in the London storm Ciara but decided to make hay while the sun shines. We had a flight to catch in the evening so decided to quickly tour London with Big bus. We were lucky to have Ian as our tour guide and Sullivan as our driver. Ian is a very jolly and funny guy and we had a wonderful tour of London with great historical insights and a lot of pun!! We were sad to leave the tour but will definitely be back again!!

thames cruise had good commentary . go to a bus stop where the big bus stops and activate your ticket with the friendly staff at bus stop . did the london eye river cruise big bus hop on off in day time .. everything was good not sure what people are moaning about on here .. london eye was closing at 6 o clock ..

Great way to spend a morning familiarising yourself with all the key landmarks in central London. Both guides were excellent - knowledgable, friendly and chatty. Would highly recommend. Not cheap but probably costs less than pottering around the shops.

The guide Mr Benedict was extremely helpful. We had booked our ticket online and there was a glitch hence we did not receive the ticket but he made sure we found our booking. Ms Ellen also went out to the way to help us. Shows entire London sites and is worth the money. Very nice experience. He also talked about all the places we visited. Very informative and welcoming.

I wanted to give Rush a big thank you for his assistance on 10 July. I purchased a two day ticket and left my tickets at our AirBnB. He informed me it wouldn't be an issue to get and off the bus since I had proof of my purchase in my email. He told me of there was any issue with the driver, it tell them Rush approved it. This was a life saver. Thank you!!

We're already born and bred in London but wanted an easy way to show my daughter some of the site's she's seen and knows exists but not visited properly. Phil was very informative, and is very funny and made it child friendly. He also encompassed all the different nationalities on board with his facts. Very much enjoyed!

Our tour guide on the bus named JOE was not only amazing and upbeat, but informative and knowledgeable. He was willing to answer all of our many questions and we found our experience with him to be uniquely fantastic. It wouldn’t have been the same without him!! WE RATE JOE 5 STARS :D

Was in London 10/08/22, did the Big Bus tour with a bunch of us in for the Giants game. This tour was one of the highlights of my trip. Nick was our guide, he was charming, hilarious, knowledgeable and friendly. We lucked out with him as our guide.
Thanks Big Bus and Nick!!

Waited and no bus even though website sent me to pick up point but no bus show up and upset family. Called customer service and gave false info even though website said other. No help. Staff
Kept on saying 830 one spot and no info for other pick up points or why no show. Lien they knew nothing about tour and hop on hop off policy . Finally on other side of town hours later we saw and hopped on hoping for better result. No headphones available . Brought own just in case but connector did also not work. Waste of time and money. Horrible family experience. Represents London tours poorly. London scam. Worst customer Service ever

Amazing experience! Highly recommend! Tiffany was incredible, knowledgeable and extremely helpful! My first bus tour in London and really enjoyed it and will definitely be doing it again at some point to experience more of the routes. Peter the bus driver was really helpful too, reminding us to get headsets. A really helpful lady by the London eye on Saturday 29th was incredible.

The HopOn HopOff is always a good way to see the sights! Julia was our walking tour guide for the Jubilee tour and WE ENJOYED every minute of it.

It was really like having having a friend tour you around - something you cannot get while on the bus.

We got to know about the Queen, her preferences, the palace etc.

Just be prepared to walk for 2hrs - but the weather was so pleasant and there was enough time to catch your breath.
Such a great way to see the city. Emma is amazing and does a great job of making the city’s history come to life. She points out good details, photo shots and helps you think of what to do next

London is an ancient city filled with history and culture. This tour gave us nothing if that! We drove past wonderful landmarks and historical building and all we heard from our pre recorded guides was tat and rubbish. Using stupid voices and not telling us anything if any use. There are plenty of other tours do one of them instead. Waste of £80.

Buses always late on app. The speakers on bus didn’t work. One his driver didn’t stop despite seeing us. Called to get help and was blown off. TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE. Literally go with any other company. Heck walk instead.

The big bus was okay. I have used it in several other cities. It takes you to the major sites, but the wait times are long on some of the lines. (Mainly the red line, which is the longest route). It also takes a long time to get from point a to point b. Honestly, it’s probably cheaper and more of a time saver to take the public transportation. I wouldn’t take the big bus in London again.

I came to the city to ran the London Marathon. Because of that I reserve the Big Bus to avoid walking so much before the race. It was a great decision. I saw and enjoy all the most famous destinations seating in the bus. Great service
This was a really interesting tour with amazing views. Our tour guide Steve made the whole experience even better. He was knowledgeable, friendly and funny. His accent impressions made my day

The tour was amazing! Our guide Louis was extremely funny and entertaining. I didn’t want to leave the bus because he was so enjoyable. He made everyone feel welcome and a part of the experience. So glad a booked this trip. For note, Russell was also a very good driver. Evernote was great, even the guys who took over after Russell and Louis. Would definitely recommend.

Currently on a tour in London. Don’t use this company. All we’ve had through the headphones is music- hardly any commentary at all. Went past all the major sights and all we had was pop music. Use another company with a live guide instead.

When I did this in the past, we had a live tour guide. It was much more interesting and I learned more. Plus, I felt treated more like a person than a commodity. Also, the head phone plugs were working intermittently and constantly had to be adjusted. Lastly, the recording kept saying announce stops and it never did, plus stops were skipped and we had to walk a long distance to get where we needed to go.

We paid for two days and only used one. Waste of money!

Best day ever. Big Steve the tour guide was phenomenal!

This was the first time I have been on here. I went with three friends and would deffo go again.

I learned so many interesting things that I had no idea about before.

Thank you.

We really enjoyed our ride with maybe one of the best driver : his name is ALVARO. He was so kind with us and made a detour for us at the end of the day to drop us off closer to our hotel. Best customer service ever thanks to him. Employees like Alvaro are rare nowadays. He truly made our first day in London. Thank you again Alvaro for your kindness. Arnaud and Melanie from Canada 🇨🇦

We met Ted at the Park Lane/Marble Arch station. He was so very helpful explaining the best way to use the service and also alerting us to the fact that there would be route changes because of a parade or demonstration. He is an asset to the company. They are lucky to have a gentleman on their staff who is interested in providing customer service!

We had a fantastic experience starting the tour at Gloucester Road. We were a group of English students from different countries and we were so lucky a Spanish girl called Marzia managed to explain the tour to each of us in 5 different languages! She had such great humor and a beautiful and genuine smile, it was inspiring! The driver was so nice, and the guide was brilliant and great fun too. We had a fantastic time.
I highly recommend it!

This tour was TERRIBLE!!! The only thing was saw was Parliament, Big Ben and London Bridge all at a distance. We did not even see Buckingham Palace, except for the back of one of the buildings. The bus broke down. So, it was a waste of time and money. I'd been to London, but my friend had not, so I knew what she was missing.
There were no headphones.
Not recommended!!!

With 2for1 train tickets the price was good. The river cruise (1 way from Embankment to Tower) was excellent. The open top bus was a good way to travel and the staff were great. The let-down was the naff audio which lacked content about the sights we passed..

Recently went in the half term and we loved it. Friendly drivers, good bus routes and quick not stuck in traffic.
The river ride was really nice to see London from a different view.
Would highly recommend the company.

Nick of Jack the Ripper tour fame was awesome!!! He's got a real talent for engaging tours. He put a great emphasis on the victims of the tour as people which isn't heard too far and wide when talking about this serial murderer. Would come back in a heartbeat if he could do a food tour or music tour!

Noel O'reilly at stop 15 was a welcome helper. He was the epitome of London friendliness and charm. He was so kind to my Ukrainian guests and clearly explained and advised us of options on our tour. Thank you so much.
Big Bus is infrequent & guide on our bus is condescending & rude.Wait is very long for bus 2 come. The other buses have come & gone but Big Bus is nowhere, we had 2 ride d public bus instead.

I'm so glad I booked the two day pass thing. I was able to use this as a method of transportation instead of paying expensive rides to uber for every stop. Great bus, and Lewis our guide was KEY to making this tour memorable! Lewis was funny and well informed! He knew several fun facts about many of the historical landmarks. Thank you Lewis for making this memorable!

Had a 2 day ticket for the Hop on Hop off bus. Lots of information while going around places. Saw a lot more of London than if we had travel on the Tube.
All the staff were amazing and very helpful. Ashley sorted out our tickets and gave us all the information we needed to throughly enjoy our time in London.

Let me start with how great the staff was! Everyone was very helpful and friendly. My only complaint was the seats were small. I’m 5’6” and even my knees were right up against the seat in front of me. My poor husband (6’2” was VERY uncomfortable.
My favorite part of the tour was the Jack the Ripper walk. Julia was our guide and she was FANTASTIC! Very knowledgeable about the history and very engaging. She did a wonderful job of bringing the story to life.

Emma was outstanding on our red line big red bus tour. Great knowledge and local resident she gave great background and highlights. Also a wonderful sense of humor

Larry Geohagan, USA

Waste of money and not that reliable. Save yourself some money and use the tube and water taxis. Cheaper and much quicker way of seeing the sights of London. We spent £64 on family tickets and feel ripped off. Would not recommend being honest

Great way to see the sites of London in a quick fashion! Also, an awesome method of transportation around the city. Our tour guide, Emma, was very knowledgeable and energetic. She shared tons of history and fun facts during the tour! Very happy with our experience!

Overall our expectations were met. Bus was clean, reasonably comfortable. Didn't have to wait long for one or more to come along. Would prefer a more straight forward narration of the prerecorded audio tour. Their attempt at comedy and characters from the past were more distracting than helpful.

I took this tour on my last day in London (a bit of reverse of what folks normally do). It was great sitting in learning about the history and seeing all the sights. The nice part is you can literally hop off in one area of London and then pick back up after you're done. Our tour guide Emma was so personable, amazing and smart! Would definitely try to get her if you plan on going on this tour.

This option included walking tours. Julia took us on a Changing of the Guards tour. It’s was excellent. She knew where to go for the best views. She also took us to the horse Guards. She was knowledgeable and an excellent guide. Highly recommend.

The best way to visit London. Simply get the ticket online and ride the bus. Get down wherever u want to on the stipulated stops. I got down at Trafalgar Square and London eye. All day pass. Ride as many times as u want. No fear of parking and fear of anything else. The best to see London is big bus.
The tour is great to get a good immersion into London. I has à glitch as I bought my ticket (wrong one from an agent) but Andy, the manager at Bus stop one. Sortef everything. Thanks Andy!

Really enjoyed our tour given by Jamie. Very friendly, knowledgeable guy, who delivered the information really well, making for an enjoyable and interesting tour.
Unfortunately their wasn’t consistency in the quality, as we hopped on and off

Chloe and Jackie were great with the tour and excellent with their job. Would highly recommend, especially if these two are your host's. Excellent experience for anybody who wants to see London for what is. Very pleased...will go again.

My first time ever visiting London, UK and what an experience it was starting of with a big bus tour. Remembering Big Ben as a kid and actually to seeing it was awe to me,seeing london and tower bridge, the famous St.Paul Catheral where Princess Diana got married, along with the service for Winston Churchill as was amazing along with many other sites. A bus tour in my opinion is highly recommended.

Had a lovely time on the Big Bus London Tour seeing all the sites. My 2 and bit hour trip had 2 separate hosts - Joe, then James. They were both ace! I award them 1 million points each! Well done lads!

It was a bit rainy on the tour, but luckily I had a hat and a light jacket. Always good to come prepared for showers or sunshine when in London / anywhere in the UK.

Got on a bus straight away so they seem to run often which is handy. Lots of stops along both routes too, so great if you are going to 'hop-on and hop-off'.
Main complaint is that you just get a pre-recorded commentary, some of which is nothing to do with where you are and actually a little annoying. Didn't really learn anything new, commentary really needs an update so it gives more detail.

In london a couple days ago. 5 stars for our walking tour guide Julia, she was fantastic and knowledgeable and very entertaining. We went to all 3 of her tours, it was awesome. However, minus 1 star for the bus commentary, very cringey and not good. Bring back tour guides on the buses!

There is so much to see and this is a great way to see as much as you can and relax and rest your feet. Headphones are provided (accommodating many languages) so you can hear the highlights of the sites you are seeing. The drivers/ staff are very friendly and helpful. You can get on and off and the buses run quite regularly.

Thank you to Govind Wikenmo our driver. What an incredible person, kind, helpful and very kind with our little one. We were all offered a sweet. At the end of the day Govind very kindly dropped us at Piccadilly very near to our hotel. He was amazing with all the passengers. We need more people like him. Grateful and happy to serve and help others.
Congratulations! We wish you many blessings and thank you so much for making our experience a wonderful memory.

Organised, lots of interesting facts and great staff - A special thank you to Chloe and Jackie who were great. Made us feel very welcome and provided excellent customer service. Highly recommended for first time visitors to London or even residents living in London.

Great live tour, good stops around London. Had Chloe as our guide, very fun and interactive and also helped us get off at the right stop! Highly recommended, managed to see all the sights we wanted to and learnt a lot. Thanks guys!

Boat trip great. Crew member very funny with commentary. Bus included major sights. But tried to get back on at Buckingham Palace to be told was only going to Marble Arch when we needed to get to The Ritz for 5 for afternoon tea. Driver told us to walk through park and The Ritz at other side which we did but not the best wearing heels!

Was only going to use the bus as a way to get to a specific stop but decided to stay on the whole way around as it was so good.
One of the only buses to have live commentary by 'Big Steve'. Very informative and personable and added to the interest of the trip.

We had a fantastic time using the big bus tour in London this week. Julia was most helpful and told us lots of interesting facts as we were going round. We loved the boat trip aswell. Would use again next time.

Did the red bus route with Fred doing the commentary. Brilliant guide, very knowledgeable and funny too. Who’d have guessed that Iron is not the staple diet of Ostriches.

Hop on one of Fred’s tours to find out more. Brilliant!

The tour itself is really good but the commentary has changed. It is now in the style of a Horrible History show (aimed at about 6 - 10 year olds) and was really disappointing.
I hope they keep this commentary but add one for the guests like me just genuinely wanting to hear a bit more about the capital than "everything you can name about Queen Elizabeth in 40 seconds".
I did however like the music. Waterloo Sunset whilst going over the bridge at Waterloo - lovely.

Great way to get an overview of London. Unfortunately our timing was off so weren’t able to hop off to visit some sites. Our guide on the red route, wish I could remember her name, was fantastic. Energetic and engaging and she wasn’t even supposed to be working our route. Made for an enjoyable experience! Would highly recommend.

Great way to have a quick look at all the major attractions. Only problem is that your guide is a luck of the draw. Some are quite entertaining and speak clearly enough to understand whereas others seems quite disinterested and drone on causing you to lose attention. Lovely to sit at the top for a birds eye view. However, tog up in winter.

Recommended to do it over 2 days at least unless you start really early.

Not enough time in the day to do full route and have time to do the boat ride. Also sound in the ear pieces was very difficult to understand what was being said. But it was a great view from the upper deck of the bus.

We loved our time on the hop on hop off tour. It was informative and easy to hop off and rejoin. Big shout out to our walking tour guide ‘William’ around Trafalgar Square. He was very helpful and a wealth of information. Highly recommend

Took the kids on a half term day out and absolutely loved the Big Bus experience. Having lived in London for years, the commentary taught me so much I didn't know and all with the backing of some great tunes.

Driver and staff really friendly! The best way to see London :)
Really good Tour. Even after coming back from lockdown and in the rain. The live commentary from "Joe" was really good for both young or old. Very helpful as well. Would recommend. John - Mildenhall.

Took a Jack the Ripper walking tour with Guide Nick. Excellent tour, informative, thought provoking. Obviously he is well educated, a natural teacher and story teller.
Best tour I have ever taken.
Thank you Nick!

Joynul Ahmed joy of a sudden, but the most popular. the only thing I can get the latest news, I have a great day. I am a beautiful person. the only way to get the best of luck. I have a great time to time. I have a great time to time. I have a gr eat time to time. I have a great time to time time to

Had the 72 hours pass where 3 walks and the boat tour was included.
we did the jack the ripper tour with Molly, the boat ride on river thames and the exchange of guards walking tour with Phil. We really enjoyed all of them.

We absolutely loved the Big Bus Tour of London. We did the red route and part of the blue route. They were both highly informative, the live guides were entertaining, the boat on the Thames was great and the locations of the stops were perfect for the sight seeing we wanted to do. We enjoyed the music in between facts on the headphones. The staff were friendly and helpful. Thanks for a fantastic tour of London!

At the 6th stop on the red tour, we got off and did the tour with Fred. This was definitely a highlight of the tour. He was very friendly and super knowledgeable, definitely enjoyed his tour. He was open to suggestions and was very concerned about making sure we were all with him.

while we were in London in March 2003 we decided to take an open top bus tour. We first took the Original Tour, which had a very bad audio system blaring out information that did not keep in synch with the whereabouts of the bus, causing us to miss much of the sights explanations.Several days later we took the Big Bus with a live commentator who couldn't have been more fun and informative. They cleverly have a way of talking to the driver to see if anyone topside wants to get off at each stop and answered questions with laughter and correct information. We were sorry that we didn't take the Big Bus first as we ran out of time, but we are going back to London in November and this time we'll take the Big Bus first. I highly recommend them to first time visitors to London.

London is magic, is wonderful and magnificent. When I left the underground tube station in Westminster, suddenly arriving on the street it was emotional to appreciate the Big Bang. The tour with this bus is perfect to visit London.

We had an awful experience with this company. Their employees are rude and impolite.
We were taking their tour in a family and we have witnessed something terrible by Big Bus crew.
A couple who was sitting in the seats in front of us forgot a bag in the seat when they left the bus. In the meanwhile, people were getting in the bus. One of the company's employee (not the driver, one of those who stays in the bus stop with a radio - see attached photos) took the bag, and told us that he would return it back to the couple which had forgotten that.
What happened was that the couple realized about the bag and was coming back to claim it back. Then a discussion started because this Big Bus guy told the couple that that bag was his bag, and not theirs. At first I thought maybe there was a mistake, and explain that I saw that bag with the couple, it belongs to them for sure. Them suddenly appeared this young lady, also Big Bus employee (see attached photo as well) screaming with me, that it was not my business and that I should stay quiet or that they would throw me from their bus.
I couldn't hold myself when I saw that attempt of theft. Then we said that we were calling the police to clarify everything. This Big Bus guy (who was obviously trying to keep the bag for himself) start insulting us with bad language, and then screaming that there was no need for police, that he was giving HIS bag as A GIFT to the couple, and that we should leave the bus, because I was creating trouble for them. We were them putting out of the bus, and had to take a taxi to go back to the hotel.
I nearly went to the police station to make a claim and register a complain about the occurrence, but considering we had only a day to spend in London, we didn't want to spend more time and get more nervous than we already had.
I totally dis-recommend that company, as long as they are not able to select honest and polite people to deal with tourists. This was not only a lack of courtesy and politeness, but this was a police case.

Big Bus is a great way to see the city without being committed to a tour! You get on and off at your own pace and just catch the next bus when you are ready to move on. They also offer tickets on attractions. Not always a discount, but you don't have to wait on line!!

Tip: See by the tour guide if you want to pay attention to his stories. People like to talk on their own and you will miss the commentary if you are too far away from the speaker!!

We greatly enjoyed our "red" tour on the Big Bus route, and would definitely do again ourselves or recommend to others; however, to be smart about it and get the most benefit, it is wise to study the route maps and carefully consider the timing and what you want to do. Consider this: the red route takes about 2.5 hours; the blue route 3.5-4 hours; London traffic is terrible. So obviously, if you choose to "hop off hop on" more than 1-2 times per day depending how long you are "off", you really cannot enjoy the entire tour. London is just too big and traffic too bad to make a lot of hopping off/on realistic. Instead, here's what I recommend: Get on either route (red/blue cover the most) first thing in the morning as they start and do the entire route, just sitting upstairs and watching/listening. Take note of what you'd like to return to later, on your own time, as this tour gives a great overview. When you're stuck in traffic, take note of the amazing details you can see higher up on the buildings than if you were at street level. Perhaps plan to get off at one attraction you most want to see that day, but I think a better plan would be to hop off toward the end of the entire loop, have lunch, take a small break, then get back on the other color route (look at the routes and be sure to get off at one of several stops where the red/blue routes overlap). Take the other route and do the entire loop to get the overview. It does take a long time, due to traffic, to get from one stop to the next, but keep in mind which things you want to see in the future, don't use this slow bus as your "transportation", but after you've seen the overview, the next day get from place to place via the tube which is very fast. By then you have a better idea of what you really want to see. We had a one day pass on the Big Bus through London pass, and wish we'd had two days so we could have done the blue route as well. Study the route maps first and carefully plan your strategy! One last observation; there seem to be a lot of different hop on/hop off busses in London, but this one had by far the most busses (and therefore more frequent pick-ups) than the other tours. That's why we chose this one and we were very pleased.

First let me say that the Big Bus Tour in London is the way to go. Whether you are there for a couple of days or a full week or more, it is a great way to see everything and then you can decide what things you'd like to go and do more in depth. I booked this tour online so that we could save 2 GBP per ticket. The ticket price is 20 GBP if you do not buy in advance. You can buy in advance online at [---] and you will get an e-ticket which can be used any day you are in London. Once you give the e-ticket to a Big Bus Tour rep at any of the stops, your 24 hour period begins. You are entitled to a free Thames River cruise at any point in the 24 hour period. Hours of operation are approximately 8:30am through 6:00pm when the last bus runs. There are 3 different tours - red, blue and green - all included in the price. The buses are the same, but the red tour offers a live tour guide (which is great), and the blue is an audio - you are provided with ear buds to plug in at your seat. We took the red tour from Victoria Station to Tower Hill, where we departed and took the river cruise from Tower Hill Pier to Westminster Pier (a must do as you see so much from the water), where we picked up the Blue tour and did the entire western region (Kensington and Paddington areas) ending up at Trafalgar Square (which we had passed on the Red Tour - thus making a complete circuit). Note - the Red Tour does not do the west side (Kensington/Paddington), so if you want to see the Royal Albert Hall, Kensington Gardens, Paddington Station, Madame Tussauds and other things around Kensington (Harrods), you'll have to take the Blue Tour. The Green Tour is basically a short run from Aldwych to the British Museum - we skipped this as we planned a half day for the British Museum later in our trip. We hung around for the 6pm included Ghost Walk Pub Crawl walking tour - fabulous to say the least. Our guide was very animated and seemed to have fun walking us all over. There are a few other walking tours that you could take as well, but this one appealed to our tastes more. On the tours you will get a great feel for the city of London and you will get many excellent photograph opportunities - so keep your camera handy. We were able to sit on the top deck as the weather was decent the day we were on. You'll definitely want to do the full circuit - and then perhaps hop on and off if you are not too tired - this way you'll at least see everything and get the best value for your 20 GBP.
