Not enough buses for it to be reliable or consistent don't waste your time or money there are better ones to use I could not recomend this service any less.

We had high hopes of seeing all of London, but the route was very slow, the tour guide was hard to hear, and getting off meant then trying to find the next bus stop and that was very difficult - our map just wasn't specific enough. Asking locals for help didn't get us to the right stop to catch the next bus, and the busses stopped running before we were back at the hotel, so we added the expense of a taxi to our day. Locals told us getting the Oyster card is much much better.

The buses are so crowded. Most times you have to stand. We waited forever at every stop for a bus to come. The instructions on where to get the bus and what lines to go on are very confusing and the agents at the stops are too busy talking on their phones to help. If you want to do one of these tours look into the “The Original London tour” company. They seemed to have a lot more busses and their guesses were not full. Big bus really needs to start running more busses. You shouldn’t be standing packed like sardines on a tour bus. Total waste of money!!

We have used big bus in various places, this was not the worst.
However as the title of my review depending on which colour route u take will be what experience you get.
The blue line clearly doesn’t have a person for commentary. And you have to be really fast at getting on and off, like Olympic runner fast.
The red line is a little more pleasant, with a commentator and the stops you can actually get off and on at a better pace.
Big thumbs up to DINOSAUR JOE, he had great information about history, buildings and a great sense of humour. If it wasn’t for JOE I think this would have been given a rating of 1
If your comfortable with the train and walking, most places are easier to access and cheaper then this.
Emma provided an on-going entertaining and informative presentation while we saw the sights in London.

The Hop-On big bus was a great experience. Four different routes and most of the staff are happy to help you find where to transfer over.
A bit annoying to be told to get off of the orange bus and wait for the next orange bus, everybody off, everybody back on. What a drag.
The headphone system is great with the places pointed out as you go along. BUT the driver has to keep it timed with where you are. Especially on the red route, it was all out of sync.
Now, for the negative - Red route - Tuesday 15th October, they had some guy/tourist guide (Dinosaur Joe????) on with a microphone- the earphones didn’t work on any number he was tuned in to. If you sat near him you could hear what he was saying, if you weren’t, tough luck. The microphone was pointless. It wasn’t plugged in separate to the sound system that wasn’t working! So frustrating.
He kept yelling out no. 13 for the ear plugs, didn’t work! Then he proceeded to put down the queen, Winston Churchill, the metropolitan police, brexit, Boris Johnson (I may have left a few out!).
He gave us his point of view on dinosaurs, global warming, politics, gay rights, disabled rights etc etc etc!!
Jeeeez! I didn’t get on a tour bus in London (home for the 1st time in 13 years) for a lecture on the state of the world.
Totally ruined my afternoon. I got off with a headache. He was too loud, too opinionated. And not a good ambassador for Britain. He wants to take a look at himself as he is earning money from being British.
Only had 24hrs in London.. booked a tour and loved the LIVE red tour with Emma! so glad we caught that bus! Wish the blue tour had live commentary too. Too much down time but was good too!

My husband and I always start every visit to a city with a hop on hop off bus. It gives such a great overview of the city. We have never been more pleased than we were with our red tour guide, Will. He was so informative, warm, and witty! We had a blast. He can sing a Beatles song and can channel the queen. Thank you for such a great experience!

It was a good way to see the city,,, but lots of traffic and busses took a long to go get on one.
once o n a bus you do learn the history of the city by your guide or by your head phones.
buses are old and do not have USB charging ports.

Had a few hours to kill before my luton flight so hopped on big bus tour near to Oxford circus. Saw most of the main attractions and also went on river cruise which was informative and entertaining. Definitely the best of the hoho tours. You can change on to other routes so can really get all round London. I finally got off at St Pancras station to catch train to Luton airport. If you book on line it's cheaper but you can pay on bus. Good value especially if you had more time than I had. Would definitely go back if I were to be in London again.

We enjoyed our one day Big Bus tour. Emma was our tour guide and she did an amazing job. Our route was augmented due to the environmental protests and there was a lot of traffic but Emma kept us informed and gave us great information despite being off the regular route. I would do this again without hesitation! Best deal in London sightseeing!

Had a great tour with Medwin. He was polite, funny and had so much information to share. Made suggestions for guests. Bus was very clean and stopped often. The different lines truly take you all over town. Helpful in deciding what places to spend time at.

The Extinction Rebellion (The Climate Change Nuts) have started this week and will continue for at least another 2 weeks. The protesters and marchers have disrupted traffic and all of THESE BUS ROUTES. Very little commentary is piped in as we go passed churches and important looking places that we’d like to know what they are! No information and nobody to ask. Since the buses aren’t on their normal routes, we don’t have the proper commentary and we’re forced to listen to the same “elevator music” over and over!!! We arrived this morning and my friend and I were anxious to start seeing the sights we’ve only heard about. We bought a 2 day ticket and boarded the Blue Route at Paddington between 9:30 and w 10:00a. We have had to sit in traffic all day. We FINALLY finished Blue Line at Marble Arch and got on the Orange Line. It’s 3:50p and we’ve yet to see Buckingham Palace, Trafalgar Square or Westminster! We just went over the bridge into Waterloo, our 1st glimpse of the River Thames. THIS is a terrible way to spend the day, stuck at the Piccadilly Circus for over 40 minutes. The music is driving us crazy. £40 is a lot of money for a bus tour of the city where we can’t get close to any of the BIG NAME PLACES we came to see. The tube is the only was to get around Ina reasonably quick fashion. I usually love Hop On Hop Off, but for the next two weeks DONT BOTHER. It’s disappointing, frustrating and I’m ready to scream sitting in bumper to bumper streets with no commentary, no history and only one live guide on the Blue Line. He wasn’t very good or as interesting as the little bit of canned commentary we had w our headphones. (We could listen to either on that route, but traffic was backed up) It’s after 4p and we after just coming up to Buckingham Palace!!! It’s been a long, tiring day.

oh man, this guy was funny. The hop on hop off service was great and we do this in every city we visit. We were a bit unlucky what with the protesters making the traffic come to a standstill but Rob was great at keeping everyone's spirits up.

Have travelled through 7 different countries and done hop on hop off in six of them with different companies. Big Bus London had the best service, the most buses and the best commentaries. Specifically Rob on the red line was seriously the best employee I have met in my journeys not only extremely knowledgeable but his comedic repertoire made the experience incredible. Thank you Rob your company is lucky to have such a great employee!

We arrived for our first time and wanted to take the bus tour. We had Emma who was fantastic. I'm amazed at how knowledge she was and super helpful with our questions!! It's a great way to get around and see some landmarks and get a sense of the city.

We typically take the hop-on-hop-off tours in every major city that we visit. It's a great start to see a city and to decide on which sites we want to see again or in more detail. London was no exception and Big Bus offered 4 routes, a night tour, a walking tour and a river cruise included in the price of the 3-day ticket. They also have an app with interesting information on the sites on the tours.
Typically one tour has a live guide offering information and stories as we go along and this is usually the highlight of the tours. I was fascinated by the wealth of knowledge of our guide until I looked at the information on the app: I think he just read the app info. Oh well....
We only did the bus routes and the river cruise but these were exactly what we wanted.

We only had a day in the city so decided to do the Big Bus tour. Our guide Rob was hilarious and full of information on our tour. He also provided some great recommendations for restaurants, pubs, and other tours to do while in town. Strongly recommend this tour as a first activity during your stay. Request the bus Rob is on, you won't regret it....

Took the Red Route tour that also included the Orange and Green Routes as there were protests interrupting the normal route. The guides were fantastic being able to talk about areas on the fly that aren’t apart of the normal routes.

Would recommend the Red Route to see central London.

My husband and I enjoyed the Big Bus HOHO tour very much! We booked the 1-day ticket and didn't start until noon on Saturday. You have 24 hours from the time you first use the ticket, so we rode all of Sunday morning as well.

I was worried after reading some of the reviews about being stuck in traffic or queues to get on the bus...that was NEVER a problem, even on a busy weekend in London!

If you want a great overview of London, want to walk a little and ride a little, this is absolutely the tour to take!! Don't hesitate!

I had such a wonderful time on my tour today. Our guide Big Steve was extremely knowledgeable of the history of London and the schedule of the changing of the guards. After our walking tour, he even took a small group of us on an extended tour that only the locals would know about! We were able to see the true history of London and even ancient Roman ruins that were hidden under the city for thousands of years. I couldn't have gotten a better experience even if I tried. Definitely try this tour out!
I have just finished a tour on the Red Route and I have to say the guide was so funny. Well worth a trip just for the commentary. Well done Rob.

An exceptional way to see all the significant sights of London as well as providing an informative and interesting narration . The tour stops at all the main attractions thus providing transportation as well. Helpful guides at each bus stop. We take this tour each time we are in London.
Was on the tour today with Emma as our live guide. An extremely insightful and lovely experience to this beautiful city. Would definitely recommend to anyone who wants a quick tour around London.

Our tour guide is Ms. EMMA. She was very friendly, knowledgeable, bubbly & warm tour guide. She provided us with very good and useful advices and tips. Keep up the good job, EMMA !! Many thanks again.

We did two days on the bus and both times were good but the second was the best. Not only is it super convenient to be able to travel around but the staff are so nice.
We hopped on the red route and had a fantastic guy called Will doing our commentary. I never laughed so much while also learning a tonne of things I hadn't known before!
He was lovely and lively and a credit to your company.
He would be the reason we do this bus tour every time we return.
10/10.
-Jade, Andy (with the cool hair) and Sean, from Dublin. 🇮🇪
First time in London, took the red line. Our tour guide was this young man called Will, and he was absolutely lovely! Never had that good guide in anywhere! Warmly regoment his guiding.

Heard only good things about the hop-on hop-off tours. The big bus tours came highly recommended through trip-advisor and we were not disappointed. Very convenient way to get from sight to sight and found all the live tour guides were pleasant to listen to and reasonably knowledgeable.

Found ourselves driving past places we didnt think we would be interested in and enjoying them thoroughly. We got the two day ticket and found it was reasonably priced. The tour is a must for people interested in seeing the sights.

Recommend grabbing a map from on board which provided a simple and easy to understand visual aid for the routes and stops.

Avoid the BiG Bus Tours. Buses are overcrowded, the queues are much longer than the other tour buses and the waiting times are far too long.
After 20mins of sitting at a stop waiting for no obvious reason I politely enquired how much longer we would have to wait and one of the reps snapped back at me 20mins. When I explained that we had already waited 20mins he rudely told me i should have got on a different bus then. On top of this there was no live commentary as promised, no way of knowing where you were or where to get off and finding the intial place to validate your ticket was not easy.
We were issued a thin paper ticket expected to last three days (one of which they forgot to give us)
Altogether a very disappointing and disrespectful service.
No stars out of five.

We bought 3 days ticket. It was a waste of time - it goes very slow because of traffic and often stops for a long time (I don't know why) at the stops. Staff sometimes rude (bus driver shouted at us). We had also very unpleasant experience on the night tour. We came one hour earlier and there was nobody at the stop, we strolled around, came back to the stop a few times, waited in the rain. When the bus came we were first in line, after us a few people, but suddenly out of nowhere came the big bus guide and told us there are people in front of us... He told us there was a queue somewhere else. How could we know that the queue was not at the bus stop? We did not hear the answer... Finally we could get only seats downstairs, not seeing anything (it was raining). We got off at the next stop. Waste of time and money! I I gave two stars, because it's nice to see London from upstairs of the bus, but the experience in total was bad.

Not the best experience. I seemed to spend more time waiting for the next bus or parked up outside Madam Tussard than traveling. I intended to see London not wait for something to happen. I saw far more Golden Tours buses than I did Big Bus and it seemed to offer the same routes. The commentary was disappointing as it was mostly music and far too many plugs for commercial places the bus was about to pass. Also too many Big Bus staff at bus stops trying to sell tickets than being there to give their customers helpful information.
Not the best experience and I would use one of the other Hop On Hop services next time or use my Oyster Card as that got me to and from the Imperial War Museum which Big Bus does not cover. Golden Tours do cover it, and I saw a Golden Tours bus near Greenwich.

The Big Bus was easy to use and in most cases was there within 10 minutes or less for us. The drivers were very knowledgeable and sometimes there was also a tour guide on the bus, which was great. They were able to help us navigate around London ourselves, too, because some sights were near each other and did not require getting back on the bus. An overall great experience!

We only had a day and a half in London and wanted a quick overview of the main attractions. This is a great way to do this. We now have a list of places we want to return to next time we are there and have more time.

We were able to see 90% of the top sites you need to see in London. Nice guides. Easy to walk from the bus stops to see attractions. We would have seen all of them, but we had so side tours planned and had to get off the bus route.

Toured around London on The Big Bus. Our live guide (Emma) was wonderful, pleasant, knowledgeable and entertaining. It was a great day!
We also did the Royal walk with Josh to see The Changing of The Guard. He provided outstanding photo opportunities and was very informative. We loved it!

Big bus is a little dated compared with its competitors. Fewer buses equals longer waits. All the land based London tourist bus companies need desperately to standardise their stop numbers and to make them clearer to tourists. Stop numbers don’t agree and stop positions and they are wildly inaccurate on Google Maps. You represent our Capitol City and your disorganisation is a poor example to set to the rest of the world. In contrast the river cruise is superb, I enjoyed every minute.

Best way to see the sites and get familiar with the city. We use a hop on hop off tour in every city we go to. Bought the three day package with river cruise. Didn’t have to use any public transportation with the tour. We were not looking forward to the busy transit system here in London. Got to all the popular sites on our list with the bus. Drivers and sales agents were extremely helpful and would give very good tips to help us plan our days. Great photo opportunities from the bus. Live commentary was awesome. Big Steve was the best walking tour guide we’ve had anywhere. Saw him again the day after our tour and he remembered us, our home town, and gave us more great tips for the day. Would definitely recommend him and this company.

Rode bus September 23 and 24, 2019. Bought 2 day pass since boat and night ride was included. It was rainy so not able to use boat hop on and night ride is difficult since had to be in the correct spot to get on the bus. The route set up is awful and not worth it. Stopped using since it took forever to get anywhere. 6 in our party. Used Big Red Bus Paris last year and it was great, used on many US cities and always had a great experience. Very disappointed. Use another company when in London a wonderful city to visit. Bought ticket on street.

I booked the 24 hour ticket to use with some friends while visiting London in September. The day turned out to be quite nice day despite a couple of rain showers. But those are to be expected in London and you just have to come prepared with a rain coat and umbrella. The drivers and commentators on all the lines did an outstanding job, however Christopher was our favorite. He was so funny and he made the tour so much fun. We really didn’t have much of a wait at any of the stops but keep in mind that the traffic in London can be very bad at times so you might want to plan ahead to avoid running late due to being stuck.
Emma was very good at telling us important facts. She was warm and welcoming. The stop was very close to our place near St Paul’s.

Really enjoyed our trip! Buses clean and routes to cover all the areas and attractions we wanted to see. Our first bus had an excellent engaging and entertaining live guide. I would highly recommend downloading the app for real time bus information which kept us informed about when our bus was due! Thank you!

We were extremely disappointed with the wait times on the Big Bus Tours. The red line is only bus with a guide. The other three lines use prerecorded which is 95% music and very little information. The hop off was easy however the wait time to get back on was often 30 minutes or longer and crowded buses. Be prepared to be forced to transfer buses (with no advance notice) and jockey for seats. This happened to us more than once. We waited over 45 minutes after one transfer to get back on the tour even though the bus was full. Not worth the money or the time.

O September 24 2019 I went on a tour with Big Bus London. They offer the Purple line to return to my hotel area after the tour lines are done. A super kind Green Line driver patiently waited with me on stop 17 for the last Red line bus to arrive to take me to stop 4, where I would take the Purple line. When I arrived on stop 4, we were redirected by the Big Bus staff to a different bus, supposedly the Purple line bus. I told them multiple times I needed to get to the stop 27, which is a regular stop for the Purple line. Then, during our way, out of sudden, the bus driver stoped the bus and told me to hop off because he was not going to stop 27, since there was traffic in that direction and he was clocked out already (?). The problem is beyond not having the service I paid for and was counting on: Big Bus left me, at night, alone, as a woman, in a dangerous city I don't know, without phone service or assistance to go back to my hotel. London is not the safest place in the world. I didn't know where I was and I was afraid to get mugged, hurt, killed or raped. If you're a woman counting on Big Bus, DON'T! It was freaking scary.
Great way to get a good overview of the entire City of London. We took the 48hr pass which gave us time to go back and spend more time at the places we then wanted to visit.

The Big Bus London tour and service was superb all round. Emma, one of the tour guides, sttod out above all the tour guides we encountered. She was energetic, funny and a repository of information. I give her 5 stars.

Visiting from Australia I had read many many reviews over the past months and although mixed, I decided to give the hop on hop off bus a go knowing full well the congestion caused by London traffic etc. Started early 8am and got to out first stop with no issues a brilliant guide and helpful staff, boarded the bus once again for our second trip at about 1015am and soon found that traffic was not the issue, it was the number of passengers waiting at each stop compared to the number of buses coming through so much so that the driver missed 2 stops completely driving straight past the people waiting (luckily we hadn’t wanted to get off here). We decided to press the stop button when we got to the stop we wanted to exit and were surprised to find a completely empty bus waiting at that stop for whatever reason and our bus stopped completely here too. Bus driver got off was reprimanded by someone in a big bus uniform for overfilling the bus we had just got off (yes there were passengers standing in the aisles). Couldn’t help but wonder why another bus hadn’t been sent around.

We did not get on again... went straight to the tubes and never missed a beat. Hope this helps for anyone trying to decide.
Really good second half with Emma the tour guide. Lots of funny stories and excellent commentary. Can thoroughly recommend. Just expect to spend at least 3-4 hours on a round trip so start early

Only had 2 full days in London, so this was a great way to see as many sights as possible. The end of the day schedule was confusing. Everyone was trying to get on the last bus. People were pushing and acting erratic. The staff tried their best to get people to behave in a humane manner, but it all could have been avoided if the schedule was clearer especially since there are lots of detours due to road work or requesting another bus. We saw multiple buses pass that said "not in service". Other than this miscommunication, we were able to tour London on 3 of the 4 lines in a short amount of time.

We had an amazing drive around London on the hop-on hop-off bus! Emma was a fantastic tour guide and really shared with us the details of London as well as her contagious love for this city. A great way to get to different destinations around London instead of taking the subway. Live commentary in English provided by the guides or GPS enabled commentary in many other languages. The top deck is mostly open and offers great views of the architecture and monuments of London.

Thank you Emma for making our day on big bus tour informative, interesting and fun! Great sightings of London Bridge with best place to get a picture. Learning that the streets of London are still laid out as they were during a Roman times. Also facts on the great fire of a London 1666 and the cholera epidemic were memorable.

Walking or driving aren't practical, and the bus was a good way to see the city. Emma was an excellent guide; knowledgeable, entertaining and engaging. In fact, you should have a tour guide academy and make her the trainer. The other two guides paled in comparison - why would you have anyone but Londoners doing tours? Thanks Emma!

The boat tour was worth it; not sure the bus tour was. We spent so much time at the Tower of London, we really didn’t have the chance to hop on and off much. The bus narration was OK. The boat narration was fun.
Just got off big bus your with Karen, she was a fabulous tour guide with great commentary and history ! She also helped us navigate a snafu with our ticket! Definitely recommend this package !

this was an experiance of a life time we all really enjoyed our bus tour learnt heaps about london and highlight was the changing of the gaurd which was so cool. you have to put this on your to do list in london.

I haven't lived in London for over 30 years though I visit regularly. So when my mum suggested a light hearted and lazy tour of London on a sunny day in September (!) i was game.

Ok £35 per head is off putting but it turned out to be worthwhile. We booked the red route passing by the core centres like London Eye, Tower bridge, Trafalgar Square, Piccadilly Circus and the Bank. I was most interested in the modern additions which we passed like The Shard, Walkie Talkie building.

Criss crossing the Thames in an open top bus is unbeatable and great for unblocked photos. We happened to sit adjacent to the friendly and very knowledgeable young guide so it was easy to catch his patter in English. Fresh earphones for the 12 other foreign languages are on the bus.

We commenced near Waterloo station (look out for the Big Bus ticket booth to ask directions to the stop). An easy place to stop off for a toilet break and coffee in Starbucks is at stop 1, Green Park. Or indulge in afternoon at The Ritz hotel! Easy to jump back on as there seemed to be always 2-3 drivers ready to start.

The web site and app can be much improved. For example, it should have estimated and real time of travel from one stop to another so tourists can plan their trips better.

Bus driver and bus stop guide are not that friendly and patient. Not only do the frequency of the buses is low but the buses are always packed and those seats that required tourists to sit face to face have super tight space for their feet.

The complimentary ear phones are so fragile. Airline ear phones are much better and at least last for the ride. Its reception is also really bad. You can barely consistently hear what the guide is saying. The volume buttons all all broken on every ride and every sat I rode on.

The good thing is considering the cost. It's very reasonable priced to tour around the city of London in a day. The one way river cruise is a definite plus.

Not happy one bit. £80 was an absolute waste of brass. Told that we had a river cruise and it’s a one way ticket. It’s all a scam. The staff couldn’t have been anymore rude. If you’re coming to London I would avoid them and go with another company like we should of done. Not happy as you can tell. Fuming.

Having the option to use the river ferry was a great plus. The only draw back is that the pre recorded trip recording did not give you the number of the stop as listed on their route map. Have used hop on hop off prior to our London trip and will again.

The great ratings mean that everyone wants to book Big Bus. The buses run packed. Their frequency is low as well. For every three buses of Golden Tours that pass us, comes one of Big Bus. Then they are so crowded, that passengers are denied boarding and required to wait for the next bus.

Really enjoyed the big bus tour. Great way to see the most iconic locations of London. Valdas was commenting live and his commentary was spot on - funny and very knowledgeable.

Thoroughly enjoyed!

I found that young staff who station at bus stop no. 27 on Sept 10 was very helpful and good attitude.

Cheers!

The best part of this tour was the river cruise included with it. The river cruise was wonderful. The trip on the bus, though, was a nightmare. It was disorganized, with very little information, and no guide--except for 10 minutes. It was hard to find the right stop and the right bus. Our visitors had the pleasure of experiencing the thousands of shoppers and nightmare traffic around Oxford Street twice--going in the same direction towards the Thames. Note that the telephone number given by Trip Advisor is no longer staffed.

The tour guides have so much information that they are spilling out and trying to show you without missing a step. They did a great job. The buses were clean and the different tour guides gave different info.

We hopped on the bus on Southampton Row and switched to the live tour orange line at the next stop. The lively, informative and often-hilarious running commentary from our knowledgeable young guide, Medwin, drowned the incessant noise of jackhammers (London as of sept. 2019 is a maze of closed roads and giant construction equipment). And he distracted us from the congestion. He also dispensed trivial and invaluable advice, thus a perfect introduction to this metropolis. Two cautionary remarks. Because of the insane traffic, we waited quite a bit for our first bus on the green line. Also, by way of advice, try to use more taxis than ubers. The Uber drivers have no clue on how to navigate this city.

I went on Saturday, the service was nice and there were many buses, so I don't need to wait long to get one after getting off to enjoy some of London's touristic scenes. They have some people waiting in some popular spots, which was really helpful for visitors.

Once I arrived in London myself and my wife decided to buy a family pass for myself her and the 2 kids at a price of £100plus for the day .
The site states buses every 15/20mns we were greeted in the green Route not far from the station after waiting around 10mns we noticed we had to get off at No17 stop to get on the next part of the journey which switched to Red .
We then waited over 40 mins for the next bus ? When we got in the bus there was no room to sit and we have 2 small kids ?
I asked when the next bus was as the App was making no sense at all in regards to were the buses were due to buses going on new routes due to road works and demonstrators.
We carried on for as long as we could and had to just get off !!! We couldn't even see out the windows .
We went about doing some site seeing then headed to another bus stop and waited again for 45mns and NO bus came we later found out that station was not in use that day due to demonstrations??? Nobody had told us this and there was no warning ???
Once we got back on a bus again we managed to get upstairs we travelled for about 25mns then was told we had to get off and get on the bus in front ? I asked why he said they had to many buses too close together!!
We got on the bus and there was NO seats ?? They said we would have to stand I asked what about putting another bus on and a guy with a clip board said
"If you want to sit you would have to wait 20mns for the next bus "
This was enough for me to realise this company have no idea how to run .
Understandable there was demonstrations going on BUT they had no clue how to plan around these things ...and NOBODY even told us they were going to be disruptions but they would quite happy take your money in a heart beat .
Very very disappointed in this company your money can be spent else were getting around London the tube is a better option.

Did BB sept 6&7 in London. Red line always good, informed guides polite helpful drivers. Blue line had no guide and only recorded assistance. Recordings were inadequate and driver terribly unhelpful. Instead of being able to identify and get off at the station closest to where we wanted to go we ended up missing the stop going around the whole route an unnecessary second time( we had embarked at Harrodsburg heading for Buckingham palace, so we were unfamiliar with the route) until the recording told us we were approaching Harrods, as neither the driver nor the recording informed us of the palace stop. When we returned to the first stop the driver had to ask others and then gave us wrong information, again. Initially he had said not to worry he would tell us when were at the right stop- he didn’t.
We finally took a taxi but the palace tours had already closed. We were very disappointed.

Review of trip taken on Monday 5 August 2019:

40 min wait at Trafalgar Square to get on the bus and standing room downstairs only, inadequate queueing system at bus stop with a lot of pushing and shoving to get on the bus, inadequate ticket checks, could only get on the river cruise at Tower if we waited for 1 hour 40 mins, poor commentary, and route was changed with no prior notice. I realise road works and road closures are outside the control of Big Bus Tours.

In fairness, after a lot of messages and several letters, I did eventually receive a full refund. The non-day had cost us £165 for 2 seniors, 2 adults and 1 child so not cheap.

Unless Big Bus Tours address some of these problems promptly, I'm sorry to say that I would not recommend.

We took the red route with this bus company as they had live commentary in English. We went the entire route around seeing all the famous places, Buckingham Palace, Tower of London, Tower Bridge, etc.

They gave you ear phones so you could hear your guide which worked well for me.

We had just arrived in London from the US so we were tired. This was a good overview of London for our first afternoon.

We bought the 2 day pass and did the blue route. It was a little hard to find the blue route, but after asking some questions we were able to find it and did this route too. It was not as exciting as the red route though.

The tickets also came with a free boat tour which we were not able to do since we were so tired at the end of each day.

I purchased the tickets on line prior to leaving the US which I believe saved us a little money.

Again I would do this red route again as it was a nice relaxing way to spend our first afternoon.

Goes to many places, very interesting, and staff are friendly and helpful. Also went on the boat with it which was nice.
Had Valdas & Lewis

This was perfect for us. We able to see all the highlights of London without having to fight the traffic, which is horrible. It was price efficient, yet we still did some walking. It was easy to follow the map and if in doubt, the drivers and guides at the stops and on the bus were very nice and helpful. We use it the two days we were in London and would do it again when there.
Great for orientation and a little history. Our Londoner guide Lionel was very knowledgeable. Strongly recommend.

I have always been a big supporter of big bus and used it in Dubai, NY, DC and now in London. Unfortunately the experience in London was the least satisfying.

For some odd reason the staff seemed totally not interested in any sort of customer care. It looked more like a normal London Bus with mostly recorded commentary. Paying quite a hefty ticket amount seemed a bit of a waste. In one the cases the driver misbehaved with us, something I normally ignore while traveling. But I suppose some people don't. A Chinese couple faced something similar and they took the drivers to cleaners. Driver found it convenient to race away after dropping them off. Bad experience overall.

London buses must have a temporary roof on the top. We all know the rainy weather there.
Would have liked to have taken this tour but the stops were few and far between. Next time we will opt for the Original Tour, we saw those busses everywhere.

Lots of stops to shop and see. A good way to get oriented with the layout of the city. You can pay at the stop and it was fun to take the water bus to the other city. The water bus is relaxing and you can see the city from the boat.

Good service, handy to use if not visited London before, covers all sightseeing to be visited. The only thing spoilt it for us was one of the drivers who was absolutely rude towards us, we were asking if that was the red route and he was huffing and puffing, had a go at my brother for not having the ticket handy while he can see we had a newborn and 2 children meanwhile he let all other passengers get on the bus not even asking them if they had ticket! And when I said I will put official complaint against him for the way he spoke to us he said do what you want! His name was Wesley. But because of the driver attitude he spoilt our day and the kids were upset so giving that I will not ever use this bus company again or recommend it to any family or friends!

Big up Nick for giving us a great live tour of London yesterday. Guy was a comedic genius. Don't care what they say about cheap jokes, funny is funny. Had such a fun time on the bus and learned so much. Nick also took time out to answer any of our questions and man, the guy delivered. He took time with each and every one of us which you just don't see nowadays. Thank you Nick, you rocked, we appreciate it. Also, the guy knows how to get a crowd going.

This was a great way to get the lay of the land. Not all buses have live guides but but the audio is still helpful. We had Casey as a live guide and truly enjoyed her. I would recommend this for first day in to get acclimated.

great access to the sites we wanted to see and easy access from our hotel . fun to sit on the top either in or out of the sun . great tour guide comments on the red line . good advice on hope to get to different sites from guides . Times were good for our needs . Would not have wanted to be the driver in the tight turning situations but felt very safe with all of the drivers .

Joe the guide and Ivan the driver. Great tour funny Comme tary which made it fun and informative made it OK to be stuck in traffic whilst Tower. BRidge was raised.
Worth the money great day out

We had two days in London, on the Thursday we went to the natural history museum then on the Friday we done Madame Tussaud's ending with the Big bus tour on the Friday, we absolutely loved it, Emma was our tour guide and she made the journey a memorable one, we were glued to our seats with the History that she gave us, even our children loved it and found it very interesting, we will definitely be coming back next year to finish off some of the Route we missed, lovely memorable day for us, our children and my Mum and Dad, Emma keep up the good work you made our experience an awesome one, ooh Arr 🏴‍☠️
Had a great day today from start to finish the staff couldn’t of been more helpful. Well done to Louis he was so knowledgable and lovely to listen too 5 stars!!

My family rode the Big Bus tour of London for three days in August 2019. Although the bus does take some time, and is nowhere near as quick or direct as a Black Taxi or Uber driver, it can be a pleasant and extremely informative way to get around London. Caron was an unbelievable guide - I could have rode with her all day!! Just be aware that the direct sun in August can be a bit much to tolerate, and morning and late afternoon rides are most comfortable. We enjoyed taking the same routes repeatedly just to get some familiarity with the endless fantastic sights and historic locales. Catching the right bus can be challenging at first because there are so many different bus companies in London, and there are several different routes to choose from. Just keep asking guides and checking your map and schedule until you get the hang of it. Cheers!

Enjoyed an excellent red route tour with Lewis' live commentary.
Be sure to find him on your bus when you get on the red route bus.

We bought a 2 day hop on hop off tour, which included a Thames cruise to Greenwich and a night Tour of the sights for £130 for four of us.
It’s good value, however our vision of hopping off and on around the city didn’t quite happen due to spending so long in traffic jams! Nothing the bus company could go about that though.
The earbuds were a great guide and useful when telling you which stop you were approaching, although they weren’t suitable for our youngest son as his ears are too small to keep the headphones in.

The cruise was great, the staff did a commentary explaining what we were seeing which was good but started to grate after a while, as did the constant requests for a tip for the commentary.
We got off at Greenwich and had some food and a little explore, before catching the boat back with the same commentary and requests for a ‘few bob for the silver bucket. It was definitely a bit irritating but we have had fun since then doing our impressions of the staff who were slowing their voices down so everyone could understand. It was quite comical

We then got on the night tour which was really good especially as the lights started to come on. Again, the commentary was lost in my youngest son (8) as the earbuds wouldn’t stay in and he soon became bored. It was 2 hours, which was a little bit too long for us but I would recommend it for older people.
The staff were friendly and helpful.
Bus was clean.

We first got on the bus and the live guide was a bit boring to be honest, didn’t say more than the recorded audio guide. But after we had to change to an other one and we got Nick as our guide, and he was amazing. He was funny and told us a lot of interesting facts and stories and we ended up going abot one and a half round instead of the half we planned to. It was great, I do recommend it. Thank you, for the nice ride around London.
Drivers were very good and polite. The Recording was clear. The Tour Guide Emma was superb .. perfect

I took my family from the USA on their first trip to London and we decided to use the Big Bus tour. Unfortunately it was terrible. The “live” tour guide had little to say most of the time and when he did it was difficult to hear due to the volume and background noise from bus (technical issues he was unable to rectify). The pre recorded version of the tour was mostly music and,sadly, ads for other big bus tours. I ended up giving my family the tour myself. Though my knowledge was limited it was far more than offered by the recording and other tourists around me were glad to have some information at least on what they were looking at.
I had suggested this to friends visiting England in the past but I will definitely never do that again. This was the worst thing we did while in London and is a massive waste of money.

We had an afternoon spare so decided on jumping on a bus to do a bit of sightseeing. Opted for the Red route as it had most of the significant landmarks on it. The whole experience took around 2 and a half hours and was far better than we thought it was going to be. Chris our tour guide was very informative and witty, keeping all on board entertained throughout. If you want you can get off at any of the stops they have and explore the area a bit further. We chose to stay on and very much enjoyed the trip. Unfortunately didnt get the chance to go on any of the other routes but if and when back in london will def try to!

Highly recommend you do this tour on your first few days just to get your bearings..we stayed in Kensington so picked up the Blue route to the Marble Arch then swapped over to the red line. Buses were super clean, fantastic live tours (guides had so much knowledge), never waited longer then a few minutes for a bus anywhere.
We bought the 2 day premium ticket. We used the bus the 2nd day as a bus service to get back to places we really wanted to see more or had booked tickets to go to eg London Tower. I think we saved a lot of money this way.
Included in the ticket is the City Cruise to Greenwich. This is a must do. Such a great place. Vibrant, markets, good stalls... beautiful.
Being on the top deck of the city cruise tour was like being on the bus...live commentary, very informative and witty.
Also included in the tour was a night tour but as our days were so full and the pickup points were quite a distance from us, we didn't use this...but what we did see in 2 days was fabulous. Highly recommend this tour bus.

We did this tour our first day in London to help us get oriented and get a sense of things we wanted to explore more. The tour didn't disappoint. It was a comfortable, informative overview of London's sites.

We did our first ever hop on and hop off tour in London. We happened to get lucky and do a personalized walking tour with molly. She was great and really made it easy to see things in London. Later we hopped back on and had the chance to tour with Emma. She was super down to earth and gave us the heads up on a couple attractions. Overall it’s a great price for all that you can see around the city.
I recommand tacking the big bus tour-great way to start a trip in london. We really enjoyed the commentation of Nick in the red line. We was great, funny and we had a really good time!!!
Very disappointing, most unhelpful and unfriendly staff. No obvious on an off points, difficult to find amongst the crowds.

First of all I'd like to start by saying I'm often a fan of Big Bus; I've used them in many cities all over the world. The one in London was terrible. The buses were never on time and no one knew when they were coming; the map was all bugged. They pushed buses to leave that they claimed were 'full' even though we could see many seats inside. At least 10 on the bottom floor alone. There were 15 or so of us waiting for almost 30 minutes as they let two buses go that were not full but they continued to say they were 'full'. Also, we asked 3 different people about the night tour. No one knew when it started or where. Pick a different tour company, there are tons to choose from.

We pre booked the hop on hop off bus for a day trip to London with our two young children. Started off ok once we left Kings Cross we got bus and it took us into central London on green route, we then got off to join red route which continues to main attractions, problem was, we did not have a guide on first bus to tell us we should get off and the ear phones did not work, so we did the same Green route several times. At the end of a long day we got a black cab to get us back to Kings Cross, so stressful, not a great experience, expected better for price!!!!

If you're not comfortable with the tube or good with directions, or maybe just want to get on the bus and listen to the historical commentary, then this may be for you. It wasn't for me and my family and I totally regret my purchase (purchased prior to traveling). The lines at each stop were so long that we ended up only taking one ride and the bus was packed. Even if the lines we're not long, I would still not take it.

In my opinion, get Oyster cards for the tube and get where you're going faster and use that time to enjoy your destinations. Plus you get to experience the transport the locals use. All in what you want, but it wasn't for us.

I booked this bus tour as my 12 year old granddaughter was staying with me. I thought it would be good for her to see the sights of London! It was a complete waste of time and money!! it was completely disorganised, the tour guide was very rude and abrupt. He kept stopping and starting the commentary and was telling people off! We got off half way through as we felt so stressed out! We should have used our travel cards and got any London bus. I would not recommend this service!

Thankfully, I began my tour on the red route with a great tour guide named Rob. He was the funniest, the most knowledgeable, the most caring tour guide ever! When we would be stuck in traffic, he would have all these tidbits/trivia to share (you will want to bring a notebook and pen if you are lucky enough to be on his tour...I didn't get off at any of the stops for fear the next guide would not be as knowledgeable and/or would put me to sleep with their delivery of historical information). Impossible to pick a favorite with all that Rob shared, but learning the origin of 'Peter to pay Paul' had me laughing. Also having someone finally explain in a way I could understand re: City of London inside of London...Rob said to think of it as Vatican City in Rome (so simple, now I get it, thanks again Rob). Rob also went on to say that the Queen has to get permission from Mayor to visit City of London (if only that would have been the case for all things Ireland). Needless to say, the interesting tidbits Rob shares goes on and on....if you are lucky enough to have him as your guide. That's the good news....the bad news....after that fabulous 'live guide' tour...it all went down hill quickly on the blue, orange and green routes. I thought the blue, orange and green would have 'live guides'....sadly they do not and even worse...the recordings are pathetic (especially on green route). The quantity of trash on those buses was also quite gross (don't understand why at beginning or end of each route those selling tickets are not re-assigned to do clean up instead...and/or why there is not some kind of non-plastic trash receptacle on each bus for folks to dispose of their crap). Also didn't understand why....not once but twice, I had to get off a bus and re-board bus in front up the road (apparently, bus drivers are scheduled to take breaks or end shift at middle of route, not at the beginning or end of route)..it .made for a lot of wasted time sitting and switching buses. Speaking of bad management, when you switch to begin green line (after jumping through various hoops because links between routes are very poorly planned)....you board green route at Covent Garden...you then go around a few blocks in a circle and stop at Covent Garden again...not sure what that was about visiting the same stop twice, nor all the other non announced stops that were made on the green route. The most disappointing....going by some very interesting historical looking buildings....and not one word about them on the recording. With all that being said, my above five star rating is only for Rob....management of Big Bus London Hop-On Hop-off Tour gets ZERO.

We like to take hoho bus tours in a big city to get an overview before deciding how to prioritize our visit. The two day deal is nice because you get a discount rate and it includes a round trip boat tour and a night tour. Our favorite on bus guide was Emma. She was informative and funny. Even though it rained it was still great. Be sure to book online for a discount.

Despite checking on booking and what the website states having paid £160 for bus river and night tours for 4 of us we were refused access because one of us uses an electric wheelchair. Never use this company. We will be raising formal complaint. What happened led to the equalities act? It’s the LAW

We had a great tour with the Big Bus Company today. Short lines and frequent busses. The tour we had was Rob. Rob was very engaging and caring. He helped many people find their way including us. Thank you Rob!

A group of us did the hop in hop off, and it was the best way to see the city ! Living in London- I've never seen London - as a tourist, and with friends arriving from Canada, this was a perfect way. We had lunch and got back on bus, did a small pub crawl, and got back on the bus. The Hosts were great, and made the day fun for everyone.

I would not recomnend this service! Two of the drivers on the Red Line at the end of the day were extremely unmannerly and uncoperative. Two of the customer reps, one of whom was riding on the bus, was more interested in his phone than answering my questions. One of the customer reps at one of stops was more interested in vaping than answering questions. The tour ended at a stop on the route leaving me unsure of how I would find my way back to my hotel which was on the other side of London. The driver couldn't care less! Totally unacceptable especially as a tourist to London. Undoubtedly this totally spoilt what was an otherwise good day.

I have done the big bus tour a few times now. I really think this type of hop on/hop off bus service was a great way to explore a new city. In my opinion, one will never have enough time to visit every spot of a big city on their first visit. So my approach is always to pick a few places where we will spend a few hours exploring. Outside of that, we will just ride the bus and listen to the recording/live guide as we drive through the city. This way, I feel that I will have seen the most important places I should go while getting some basic knowledge of other parts of the city. If the other places sound interesting, they will be the spots I will hit next time I visit the city.

Anyway, I feel the big bus route is pretty good and the buses are quite frequent so you never have to wait for too long. Occasionally, you will have some trouble finding places on the second level but it's not too bad.

Our commentator, Mehmet, was great. He was diligent in pointing out all the interesting buildings/places and some history behind them as we go through the city. I feel that he did as good a job as the other professional tour guides from the top tour.
Had an excellent tour with Mehmet as the tour guide. The commentary was informative and fun! Definitely recommend to other visitors.
I along with 5others were on the hop on hop off bus tour on the 8th August and had an amazing experience with the amazing Emma, she was a joy and a credit to your company

We had a lovely time with our very knowledgeable guide, Emma. We didn’t have to wait long for the tour and were able to get a top side seat very easily for the beat pictures. Can’t wait to visit again.

Booked the bus first thing Saturday morning on the website. Turns out that there was unusual activity in London that day. Many of the bus stops had been suspended and the routes canceled. There was zero communication of this on Saturday morning when I booked my trip for 200 pounds. We spent more time walking around looking for the bus then we did actually being on the bus. Only rode the bus for maybe an hour hour and a half instead of the two days that I have booked. When I asked the street agents what the problems were they gave me the look of a confused dog. On top of that our spirited toward guy turned out to be an 85-year-old man and a straw hat that’s left for the entire hour to one and a half hours while we were on the bus. He never spoke a word.

To make matters worse the website map completely misread our position versus the positions of the bus stops. It had us anywhere from 5 to 10 blocks away from where the bus stops actually were. This was extremely frustrating. The only thing more frustrating was that there was a downloadable app that worked fine. Of course, in keeping with the substandard website, there was no mention of the app on the webpage. It would seem to me that your webpage is your customer intake portal and you should provide all the forward facing information you can there. Things like status updates and the availability of smart phone applications.

As a business owner, I would be embarrassed if this was the best level of organization I could achieve.

We were in London for 5 days and booked the 3 day deluxe tour which included the river cruise and night tour. We only used the ticket for 2 days and took the river cruise.
We visited the weekend ride London was on so there was a lot of road closures so bear that in mind when booking.
The buses and the river cruise was busy. We took the river cruise trip to Greenwich which is quieter after tower pier and certainly worth a visit wandering round Greenwich.
We got the first bus on the morning if Friday 2nd August to Buckingham palace and the tour guide Emma basically went round the bus speaking to everyone and helping them plan their day. Emma advised us best place to go for changing of the guard and was very knowledgeable and helpful and is the main reason I am giving this tour 5 stars.
Good tour only downside is that it's very very busy but it is London.

Big Bus is a great one day excursion where you can hop on an off at any of the many attraction stops. It is not a proxy to travel around London as a replacement for the Underground. Big Bus is a circuit, whereas the Underground is direct.

The Thames Cruise is a must as an add-on. However, wait times at the dock can take an hour. The river tour guide we had was excellent!
Took the entire A route. Took quite a while, but certainly beat walking. Slow due to local huge bicycle race, many detours. Still, fresh air and saw a lot.

This is a great way to see London without the hassle of traffic. The staff was friendly and helpful. We had 3 great tour guides Sorka, Valdas and Chloe. Thank you very much for helping us see London in a unique way.
Very nice trip and easy way to get around London, but a bit crowded in the afternoon and hard to get seats for a family of five under open sky

I always tell people that when they visit London for the first time they should ride the Big Bus first. Why, because then they will know what attractions they really want to see and what to skip, especially if they are short on time. This year my brother came with me and as usual I insisted that he take the bus before doing anything. Being his older sister he agreed, and was so glad he did. Although it was raining we sat on top, putting up our umbrellas and enjoying the ride. He said it was one of his favorite things to do. Not only because he saw all of London, but because the guide was amazing and the people were all so happy just being there. The rain actually made it extra special, adding the sort of atmosphere one might expect from this amazing city.
I'd recommend the bus for all first time visitors and even for those of us , like me, who visit regularly. It's not only fun but quite useful in a city that spreads out for miles.
Emma was the best tour guide we had!!!! Would highly recommend but if you get o. The red route make sure to have a good guide!

Wasn't very impressed. The red run was good when you had a live guide but we joined at the green run Kings Cross where you had to rely on recording.There was competition between the companies which was a bit unpleasant when they were trying to get your attention and soon disinterested once you've bought a ticket. We bought a 2 day ticket but on day 2 ended up going around in a circle on the green run when the bus driver didn't tell anyone part of the route was closed. The driver was then rude to a fellow passenger who tried to ask a question and insisted he had given us information about closures. We ended up getting the tube.

I don’t know what the other hop on hop off bus companies are like but this one wasn’t that great. The first bus we got on the driver was unfriendly, the live guide was boring, and at 2 or 3 stops the driver turned the bus off (we were only on the bus for less than one hour). The staff on the rest of the busses were better, but the audio (earbuds) were never loud enough so it was always hard to hear.

Out tour guide Emma was amazing! She gave us great tips to be able to see everything we wanted to see in our two days in London. She has so much knowledge about the history of London she made the tour really interesting and enjoyable. If you’re lucky enough to get Emma you won’t be sorry.

Hopefully you’re lucky enough to have Emma as your tour guide. She had a wealth of information about not only the tour, but how to get the most out of your stay here. Great experience! I’d hire her personally as a tour guide if I could.
We had a wonderful tour on big bus London with Emma! She was so knowledgeable. The tour took us everywhere we wanted to see.
Emma absolutely killed it. Helped with food recommendations, directions, best way to plan your day. Cannot recommend asking every driver if Emma is on to help!
Could not believe how badly organised it was and how slow the first part was. First half mile took an hour. A complete waste of money and a day out in London ruined.

We bought tours for the day and ended up only using them to get from near the London Eye to Tower Bridge and back.
The drivers and people doing the commentary were good but there were at least 3 bus loads of people waiting at each stop, it was an unpleasant free-for-all to get on and around 20 people standing in the isles so it wasn't even possible to hear the guides.
There really should be a limit to how many tickets are sold as the number of people trying to use the service makes it effectively unusable, which is terrible for the price!
If you have only a few days to take in the sites (average 2-3 sites per day), then this will cost you valuable time due to traffic. Take an uber instead.
Every city has a hop on hop off, but the Big Bus seems to offer a little more with their routes and coupons. Great way to check out the city without miles of walking
Great bus rides Thank you Nick was very interesting and knowledgeable on the red bus we rode all of the different routes and enjoyed our day went past all of the major landmarks in London

This is the third time I have done this tour bus. You used to book one day and get the second for free. Not anymore. The ride was good, a little long as major streets were closed when we did it to due to gay pride weekend.
Christopher was an excellent live guide! He made the trip fun and added lots of extra info. He helped what could have turned into a very long ride (3 hours) to be bearable. He would even tell people how to get to spots they wanted to visit since the main roads were closed. He was definitely the highlight of the tour :).
There may be cheaper options out there in the future but overall not a terrible experience. Just wish they were cheaper like other major cities.

We enjoyed our ride around London today and want you to know Emma made it enjoyable and interesting. Being from London she added nice color commentary to our trip.

Thank you!

Great and knowledgable guide Valdas provided interesting overview of London's history and interesting facts. The other guide on the same day was not so great and was trying to be very funny, making innapropriate jokes, asking peoe to express their emotions and all his interests were focised on money, rich people, etc. So my high rating is only due to Valdas.

To fight against a jet lack is th hardest thing ever, so we decided to extend our big bus experience with a tour in London. Unfortunately the guide was not as good as in New York, maybe she was new, but she was hard to understand Anyway you can always switch to the recorded commentary which is quite okay. Great overview of the city, even when you are very very tired.
An awesome experience. I’m definitely doing this anytime I find myself in London. A must do for any one who visits London for tourism.

Hello. We took the bus from Victoria Station and did the whole tour of the red line. The two people at the Big Bus London office were so helpful and suggested the exact route we should take. So we took their advice and took the red line. Our driver Mark was amazing! How he got around the city with traffic and construction was nothing short of a miracle. Our tour guide Karen was excellent! She was so knowledgeable and her wealth of history was impressive. She answered all our questions and helped us get to our destination of Kensington Palace. It was a hot hot day, but we had a great time touring around London. Thank you so much!

There are several companies offering similar services but we have chosen the Big Bus as their number of bus is more. We have also chosen the premium level for 48 hrs including Thames River cruise. Everything OK even though we experienced slight traffic congestion. We fully used the 48 hrs services and the river cruise (see another review) without any probblem in terms of bus availability, services and routes. We have tried 2 routes.

I’ve done this tour a few times, over various trips to London. As such I’ve had 4 different guides - Christopher is by far the best! He’s funny, very informative, and easy to understand (some of the other guides didn’t enunciate as well). I would highly recommend these tours in general, as a quick way to see London, and if you can get on a bus with Christopher take the opportunity!
We had a great time learning about all the top attractions and history on the red route. Our tour guide Zane was fantastic and very insightful. Will be doing the Blue route next.

Needed to kill a few hours so hopped on the bus and did the red tour- perfect as didn’t need to walk around with bags! Live tour was different and interesting!
Headed back to Gatwick after a great tour and realised I’d left my backpack somewhere.... thanks to the team for finding my bag and keeping it safe. You saved my day!!

We did this as part of our London Pass, the day started off good and we got to see quite a bit of west end of the city and had a really knowledgeable tour guide. After getting off for a bit and then jumping back on, it wasn't the same experience. We barely got around the city after that as our bus kept getting snagged in all kinds of traffic and no live guides on the rest of our buses, just the pre recorded audio, At one point we had been on the bus for 45 minutes and had barely moved 2 blocks. The buses also don't have any A/C on the lower section which made it stupid hot while we sat in traffic, we were quite thankful to finally get off. We would have likely seen more of the city had we gone on foot or by the Tube. I understand these are all factors out of their control, but do feel there could be more down to help with comfort especially when things like that happen.

Hop On, Hop Off

Emma, the Guide - the best guide one can imagine, best humour, good stories, very entertaining!

The tours were a fantastic way to see the city with young children. The walking tour to see the changing of the guard was great. We were always in the right place at the right time to see all the great moments including a fun performance from the guard of a Bruno Mars song.

Our walking guide, Joe was the star of the show. He was so great with the kids and even helped us find a stop when we saw him hours after the tour. We will use this tour company again when we’re back on our next visit, and we hope to have Joe again!

A group of family and friends visited to London to celebrate a 40th birthday... The Big Bus was fabulous.... the tour guide Mehmet went out of his way to make the tour informative, humorous and interesting... he was really friendly too... hats off to him...
. We saw some amazing sights and learned some amazing facts about our beautiful city. Only very small criticism was that the tour couldn’t stop at some of the more popular stops .. Trafalgar Sq... due to road works we think... would have been nice to have been told this when we bought the tickets.

Big Bus is absolutely the best way to travel around the city and you can see every landmark as you go.. because the ticket is 24 hours it’s good really good value.

We got the river cruise back from Tower Bridge to Westminster and the chap on there was great too... we learned lots more from him.

Well Done and Thanks to Big Bus London .... we’ll be back
Did Big Bus London with live commentary by Emma. She was amazing. Her passion for the history of London was evident which made for a very informative tour. Thank you Emma.

Very commercialized and very busy. The Red Route is worth it if you will actually hop off and see the sites yourself. It passes through or near most of the major landmarks in central London.
The guides we experienced and good; their speech a little fast though. However some of the drivers we had lacked good customer service. They weren’t interested in helping/ explaining at all. At times they were rude and abrupt, no smiles, and two of them couldn’t wait till the end of their shift.
Those selling the tickets at Baker Street explained the routes etc well.
On each bus one of us experienced faulty listening devices. Please check them.
To be honest, I wouldn’t do this again. I would prefer a less commercialized and less mass tourist mode of touring. But as a first time, it’s okay.

Emma is a tour guide that should be made available for all tours. Impossible, but what a value for the Big Bus Company, Emma has the skill to keep her clients interested and always ready for the next tidbit of information. Big Bus will always be my choice because of the communication skills of Emma.

i got the 2 day ticket with river cruise which i did on Monday 15th July. to pass time before travelling home Tuesday i did the bus tour again. my guide was Emma she was an absolute joy. pleasant friendly and very knowlegable patient with travellers. Anyone having her as there guide is lucky

Paid £39 each yesterday to be herded around like sheep on an overcrowded bus system, difficult to get a seat, taking ages to drive around a few sites. Why do it? Next time I’d book a smaller private tour that would be much more comfortable & better value.

Had Emma today she was amazing such fun and great knowledge of the city
Fantastic very professional and the wait for bus was never long I only wish I’d gone sooner gave me great bearings to where everything is
10 out of 10 Emma

We have never been on a hop-on hop-off tour before, we always looked at them and thought they were lame. Not the case!! It was a fun way to get a little historical information and enjoy the sights at the same time!!

Very convenient and informational.

You can listen to the drone of the automated tour on channel 1 for English or go to channel 13 and listed to your live tour guide. They proved disposable earphones when you get on the bus. Since people get on and off often, you can work your way to the front of the bus if you choose to.

TIP: Download the app, it makes it easy to see where you are and where you are headed!

All interactions with Big Bus employees were very nice. Definitely recommend if you have sore feet from walking, you can still get some touring in.

Easy to find pick up points and comprehensive coverage of this wonderful city. Tour guides could be a bit better....some were better than others but generally they weren't a great addition to the trip

We’ve taken this type of tour before in Rome, which worked very well for us. So it was an easy decision to try this one, in spite of some of the reviews. To be fair, the experience we had was greatly affected by the London traffic.
We caught the bus at stop 11, easy enough. But after the bus headed out it was only able to move in short bursts and, much of the time, it sat still in traffic. London traffic, high tourist season . . . Maybe that’s the norm. But it turned a projected 2 1/2 tour into 4 hours. We didn’t get off at any stops, so we were aware of the time. If we had gotten off anywhere, it’d have been a really long day.
The tour guide that spoke during the first half of the tour was obviously inexperienced. She had to refer to the map occasionally and often injected personal observations. The guide on the 2nd half was much more experienced and anticipated the upcoming sites.
With no knowledge of London mass transit, maybe this is the best option. But you need to go into with measured expectations.

Our driver let us on for free, it was a great start of our Euro-trip! We had the time of our lives, saved more than 100 pounds! Thank you, driver (we won't mention his name of course) This is the best way to see a city in a short time, you can just sit down and listen to beautiful stories told by a live guide, our guide was Will and it was perfect. We stayed on the bus the whole route and had a clear overview on what to see and what to skip. I'm not sure if I would have paid if I had to, because it gets kinda crowded, so this was the best way to do it. Of course, I cannot promise everyone you'll get a free ride, but it's worth a try.

Had an awesome couple of hours riding around with Emma as the local guide, she was very knowledgeable and kept me engaged... despite how badly I needed to get off and use the bathroom, I wanted to keep sitting listening to her talk! ☺️

The idea behind these bus tours is great. The quality of the tour was subpar, on one bus we had a live guide however we could not hear him because the intercom was up so poor quality. The pre-recorded bus rides were better, but several of the seats that Jack’s that did not work. There are other bus companies that provide the surface which are better than this one. This one was cheaper, so we got what we paid for, which basically was transportation to the different stops.

We were very fortunate to have both excellent weather and a very good guide who was knowledgeable and enthusiastic during the whole trip. However do be sure to bring your own headphones because the ones that they hand out are just horrible making it really difficult some times to hear what the guid says.

Big Bus London Hop-On Hop-Off Tour

The big bus tour people operate right on the road I live. I walk by them several times a day. They always offer me the big bus tour and as I pass them so often I ignore them. They insult me in return and I can say that the representatives of this company are rude and not good for London locals. I hate to walk by where they are as they are always rude to me just because I’m not a tourist giving them money.
If you are to say no thank you they try to sell it to you more, and plus it’s annoying to say that to them several times a day.
If you ignore them they’re rude. Its a no win. NOT ON MY ROAD PLEASE.

We had 2 full days in London so this was the best way to hit all the sights! We started our day by watching the changing of the guards and then visiting the Queens Gallery. The bus stop is right across the road from this site so well worth the visit. Also a toilet stop before starting the hus tour.

We were fortunate to have a really good guide on our bus so our teenage boys were happy just to sit and enjoy the trip around.

The second day we hit the blue line and the river cruise. We picked the cruise up from the Eye- recommend because we were told by others that they waited over an hour at the London Tower. We got straight on. Up the river we had to sit inside but once we stopped at the Tower we had choice of seats before it filled up again.

Brilliant couple of days!

This is the worst bus service in London. On 3 different occasions, we saw 4-5 Original Tour busses and 3-4 Golden Tour busses come to the stop for every big bus. After a 40 min wait, 4 of the big bus busses came together.

Very poor organization.

Big Bus London was awesome. Ordering tickets online was super easy and finding the first pickup spot was fast. We messed up at a stop and the staff were kind enough to point us in the right direction. It's so fun seeing London from the second story no matter where you go. I recommend starting early and possible going for several days as there is much to see. At the end of our tour a tour guide name Kiwi Ian offered to walk with him on his way home past a few sights. Kiwi Ian was great giving my wife and I a solo personalized free tour and chat along the way. Thanks Kiwi Ian and Big Bus London.
Fantastic tour with a wonderful guide. Tiffany not only gave us information about historic facts, she also made us laugh with her fine humor. Thanks a lot!
We did the tour with Emma as our guide with our three small children. Emma was very personable, knowledgeable, and a true pleasure. She truly made our tour! Thank you Emma!

Almost my entire first day in London I spent sitting on a hot crowded bus. I got on at 9am and by 12:30pm was still on bus trying to do one red line loop of city. Between two stops we sat in traffic without moving for almost a half hour. On a sunny warm day sitting on the uncovered portion is uncomfortable. I moved to the inside and it was stifling and stuffy. Between the live guides grating voice and useless commentary as well the the discomfort I actually got off and grabbed a taxi back to my hotel. Since I had a two day ticket and Thought perhaps it was just a bad day I decided to catch the earliest bus at 8 am the following day to arrive at Tower of London before crowds. Well it was a repeat performance (however guide was much better) so Once again I got off and took a taxi. Life and vacation time are short. City traffic is bad. No AC on a bus in summer is gross. Take the underground.

If you're new to a city, bus tours are a fabulous way to check out the sights. There are lots of bus tour options. We randomly picked the Big Bus tour. Accidentally left my phone on one bus; let another driver know and was able to get my phone back. Amazing. Ticket includes a boat trip on the Thames.

We bought our tickets nearby our hotel and hop on the nearest stop. When we reach the stop, the staff just took my voucher and scan the code. It was kinda rude but we are ok with that still. Then we asked if the queue is at the back considering it was really a long queue and we wanted to make sure we are not in the wrong position. The same staff offered to get us to the first position with a price and we rejected, assuming he was joking, but he kept on talking about the price and we continue to reject that. We know he was joking but it was kinda of an insult to us as this went on for few mins while the tickets were printed. There were tourists around whom looked like they were laughing at us for being ‘played’ as we are Asians, it seems like it was done inappropriately and overboard. This is a disrespect to us as a tourist in London. Other than that, the whole tour was good, with other friendly staff. Traffic was an issue.

We took the Big Bus Red Route today. We’ve done it several times before, but each time we learn new things about this wonderful city.
The live commentary was provided by Fred, and he was superb - so knowledgeable!
Highly recommended.

Went on the big bus tour of London and the experience was fantastic. Our guide Gigi from Cyprus was charming, fun and knowledgeable. We also had a terrific guide Vistautus from Lithuania. He was a lot of fun and really knew his stuff. Their English and knowledge of London was first rate.

I bought the "72-hour Delux Ticket" that includes three days of riding the bus plus the night tour and a river cruise. But you might be better off just buying one day to see most of everything and then use the tube to go to specific places.

*The Bus*
It's an awesome way to see most of the city if you don't want to walk too much or you don't know where to go. The routes are well planned and there are plenty of stops to get on and off. Additionally, employees are usually helpful in finding out which route to take and they will provide you with lots of maps and earphones to listen to the recorded voice.
Live guides are good, but scarce. I was lucky to get Valdas as our guide. His funny and detailed tour on the red line was the perfect! However, not all buses have live commentaries, mostly red line buses only. If you want a guided tour you are probably better off doing a Sandemans or Strawberry tour.
The worst thing is that you might get caught in traffic, which will make the route last an extra hour (adding up to 3 1/2 hours of tour). So, if you know exactly what you want to see or where you want to go, just buy an Oyster card and take the Underground (aka The Tube), it will be cheaper.

*Night tour*
