For example, I went to Kensington Palace & then went to walk to the Diana memorial - but then the app told me to go to a stop I had been about 6 stops ago... so I figured that didn't make sense & walked back to the original stop (20 min or so) and then 2 stops later, they said - here's the stop for the Diana memorial. Weird stuff like that kept happening, even with GPS and the app.

I wanted to see the Tower of London & a few other sites on my own - and I just got an Oyster card and took the subway. It's not that hard to do if you have google maps or citymapper, though the subway is ridiculously hot in the summer. Most people I talked to didn't "recommend" this bus but they said they could understand why I did it as a newbie to London. I did get some cool pictures from the upper deck which I couldn't have taken on foot really. That's one bonus - the views you get are very nice.

There are 2 walking tours offered by Sandemans which were a bit better for the information and even for what we covered to some extent. It's much more personal even with the big group. The bus is a better option if you don't want to walk so much. For the bus, one route has an actual person, but he has to stick to the script & isn't gonna answer random questions like the Sandemans guide.

At the end of the day, you just have to accept you aren't going to see everything in London in a short period of time, but at least this takes you through the main attractions & if you start early, you'll probably do enough to be worth the plane ticket.

We chose this as we have done in other cities to get a general overview of places that we wouldn't see on foot. The only problem was the London traffic. After sitting in traffic for 2 hours...we finally got off and did not get back on.

Our tour guide initially was very bad bit thankfully his shift ended fairly early in our tour and the next guide we got was Emma who was very knowledgeable and very nice. We were so happy with her as our guide that we stayed on the bus from her first stop to her last stop. Thank you very much Emma!
Ian is hands off one of the best live commentators. Thoroughly enjoyed the tour. Ian commentary was one of the highlight. His wit and knowledge was on point.
Really worth it, great experience and Valdas the tour guide was very good and informative! Highly recommend!

We used the hop on hop off bus for transportation. We were very pleased with the amount of stops and never waited very long for a bus. It rained all day so we decided to stay on the bus for a two hour round trip to hear the history first and then made our choices of where we wanted to stop.

Took a sightseeing tour on tuesday the 3oth July. With the delightful Lewis! It was pouring down but he still made the tour fun and entertaining. And dont worry Lewis my lips are sealed regarding the lady and the umbrella oh and not mentioning the man and the mic!!! 😂😂 highly recommended. Luv the carlisle lot!!
Brilliant tour guide, was very helpful and gave us loads of interesting facts. Would highly recommend when visiting London.

Had to deal with rude staff of a certain racial background whilst others were helpful. Wasm't told I needed a paper ticket for the cruise so had to walk from the cruise stop to the bus operators to get this (would've been nice to be told). No rain ponchos were provided either. River cruise was too loud; couldn't even hear the commentary. This was a below average experience.

i have been on a few of them, in fact, two days earlier used the Golden Bus, (which stunk, drivers were rude and even passed us at the stop because we were standing too far away, 25 feet!!, but that is another review) got on the Big Bus Tour, it was excellent, staff and guides were great, got to see parts of the city i hadn't seen yet, Ross, the tour guide was excellent and they even got me home at the end of the day. Highly recommend.

We booked a 2 day tour, which included cruises on the Thames river. Great way to see London and environs.

One of our guides on the bus was especially good; his name was Valdas and he was from Lithuania.

Touristy?Yes.Stop-start/Yes. Worth it?Absolutely. I don't know if it's all English guides or just the wone's we kept getting but they're all hilariously charming and definitely informative. If they don't know something they can at least get a chuckle out of you and if they do know something, they'll make sure you know that they know! It's well worth it and you're guaranteed a fun-filled way to get to know the city

My dad is visiting me here in London so we hopped on the blue line last night which was interesting but this morning we caught the red line with Ross as our guide and it was a lot of fun. He was funny and informative and I learnt a lot even after living here 18 months, my dad absolutely loved it too

We did this on our first day in London as a way to get to grips of the location of all the main points of interest. Really efficient service, and our tour guide on the red line (Valdas) was really knowledgeable :)
Very nice routes that included lots of sights. We really enjoyed all the routes. The staff were pleasant.
There were a variety of different areas I went too, and the color coded map let me know just where I would be an$ what I would see.

Many roads were closed on day of our tickets meaning we had to take the tube to even get close to a stop. Had to transfer to another bus midway. Could not hear/understand one tour guide. Overall not worth the money.

There is unquestionably lots to see in London. It's a great city! And a hop-on-hop-off bus tour is typically a favourite of ours to get the lay of a city. This one was plagued by gridlock traffic and hot weather (low 30s C) on a bus without air conditioning; the bus was stifling hot and the air was dead still.

We did not stay on the bus very long. Our tour guide didn’t speak good English and it was very hard to understand her. She was from another country and had broken English with difficult English to understand her when she spoke. She was too difficult to understand unfortunately.

Neil Tyler was extremely helpful to us on June 30,2019 with the Big Bus Hop-On-Hop-Off tour. We experienced a problem a few days before in that we were interrupted by a protest in London and the bus service was not available. Neil went out of his way to help us get another ride on the bus on June 30. He was wonderful and represented the Big Bus tour very well.
The trip was wonderful. really enjoyed it. I recommend it, it was very convient way to see most London's must-sees

We got the two day tickets for the hop on hop off bus. It seemed at every stop that we saw two folds more of the other companies buses than the Big Bus Company. This made us late on our site seeing schedule and we did not get to see as much as we had hoped :( The guides were ok for the most part. There was one that stood out with being super nice and very helpful! The drivers were all nice. At the end of our second day we stood in line for 25 minutes at the London Eye stop only to find out that there were no more red busses running on the route towards The Shard. We had 3 tired kids who now had to walk back to hotel after a long long day of walking around. It would be nice to have better street signage for where the Big Bus stops along the routes. Also, the app, the print map and the knowledge of the bus tour guides didn’t seem to match up. Trying to get to a certain destination would yield different results when consulting Google Maps versus the Big Bus app. This delayed us several times. A bit disappointing...

We did this 2 day tour (on the bus now for our 2nd day) ... we flew 26hrs from Sydney arrived into London with 6 hrs until hotel check in - this is the best way to relax and see all the sights. We went from blue to red bus and thankfully got on a bus that had live commentary by NICK .. he was fabulous funny entertaining witty oh bit to mention handsome😁- you need to do this tour just to listen to him 10/10 for a memorable day trip!!!
This is a must for tourist in London! You get to see the city through the eyes of locals! Hoping off along the route made it easy to walk around and get picked up by the next bus!

We have been riding Big Tours everyday during our visit to London. The drivers and staff were helpful and very knowledgeable. This is a great value for sightseeing as well as to get around the city. The best part of our trip was when our bus driver helped us get off the bus to see the changing of the guard. Ian was a walking tour guide who graciously guided my mother and I through short cuts to get to the palace and make sure we had wonderful views to see the entire band and guards. He explained the details and navigating the two of us through. I highly recommend Big Tours for anyone visiting London. Pay for a pass that gives you access all the days you will be venturing out. The three day pass allowed us to see so much!

Was happy with this tour bus. Info was pre-recorded on one we got but you sometimes get a tour guide which is better. Do a full trip if you have time rather than getting of for attractions. Think the ticket still gives you the attractions discount day or so after the purchase date but worth checking. \we did the night tour as well and it wasnt to bad. As with most it runs fairly often think every 30 mins. Worth the money, If not sure get the one day ticket valid for 24 hours, we got told it could be upgraded at any point to 2/3 days and only pay the difference, but check that to make sure.
We used a London Pass to start on our day in London on a BigBus tour and Tiffany did a grate job entertaining and educating us about London.

This is a great way to see the city without the blisters.its actually better because uou don't need to walk,look up and try to snap pictures all at the same time.You sit comfortably on the bus and can see all the sights throughout London.and a bonus is you have a tour guide giving you info. Our tour guide William was terrific. All the interesting facts were a big hit with me.

Great service however many busses were hard to get back on due to the amount of people doing the same thing. Getting the history on parts of the city was great though. We didn’t really get our moneys worth though bc we found it easier to use the tube.

We did a hop on hop off tour in London with Nick as our guide. It was a really interesting and informative trip and Nick’s in-depth knowledge into London history and his crook jokes made it even more enjoyable. Would recommend this to anyone who wants a quick trip around London with a bit of history thrown in.
Quite good tour, but highly dependant on your guide. We had mixed luck with the live commentary, and found the pre-recorded commentary quite average.
Luis needs a promotion, he is an awesome tour guide. I know exactly what to do and where to go now I’m London and I’m happy to have visited this tour

We purchased the two day tour with river cruise and night tour. We enjoyed the tours which provided a live guide as opposed to when in was just a recording. We were able to see a lot of the city and didn’t have to wait long for the next bus to arrive. We were disappointed with the night tour as it was a recording and not a live guide. We pretty much heard what we had already heard during the day. We thought the night tour would have special commentary.

Well worth the money as part London Attraction tickets. We stayed on for the whole red line trip before deciding where to get on and off, as the day goes on it get busy and not so much space at the top of the bus to see the sights later in the day. Sure our guide was Owen and he was was really good and funny, and knew his stuff.

The tour was very interesting
The guides always friendly
Super service (hotel return services)
The drivers were friendly too
The organisation was very good

We would do it again
Thank you

Writing good because it’s summer and very crowded no fault of big bus! That being said we enjoyed riding around and seeing the sights getting some information. We were in a situation where we couldn’t walk a tons so this fit the bill. They can’t help crowds but please fix the broken speakers you plug into so you can listen. Several were broke! That you can fix!’n

Wayne and Tiffany are a great team who took care of us through the financial district with a very clear amusing commentary and faced with a diversion still managed to enable us to take plenty of photographs safely.

I was sick on the tour day and unable to make it, I asked for a refund and got an automated reply, saying that they had generated a support 'ticket' and someone would be in touch soon. But I had no ticket number and no reply, it's now been over a month!! Don't expect them to help you.

My boyfriend and I have been in London for a week now, and decided to finally use our London Pass to go on the Hop-on-Hop-off bus tour with Big Bus Tours. First we had a live commentary on the bus with Aude, a wonderful French girl who knew quite a bit of fun facts (especially about Harry Potter films) and was extremely helpful! And when we got off at St. Paul’s and were waiting to hop back on, we got asked if we wanted to do a walking tour toward the River Thames with Big Steve. And quickly we discovered that he is truly just the best!! He knew his insider London facts, was hilariously good at accent impressions, gave many sweet photo spots/took a load of great photos for all of us, and showed us things that Londoners might not commonly know; places like where Diagon Alley was filmed in Harry Potter, where some good Pub grub was at, and much more! Not only did we do that first group tour and enjoy it, but he helped us get to our next bus, joined us, and decided to give the two of us another tour all the way to Buckingham Palace. He was truly such a joy to get to know and a pleasure to have met! PLEASE if you are reading this, go on the FREE walking tours!! The guides are absolutely wonderful (especially Big Steve...and even if I’m biased, be sure to ask for him, trust me) and you honestly won’t regret it! Definitely got my 10,000+ steps in an awesome way today. Thanks Big Steve and Big Bus Tours!

Enjoyed the Hop-on Hop-off tours of Big Bus London but by far the highlight of the day was taking a walking tour through parts of Roman London with Big Steve. Steve was very knowledgeable, friendly, and helpful. Steve shaped his tour to the desires of his guests and went out of his way to show us Diagon Alley from Harry Potter. Would recommend these walking tours to anyone interested to seeing London from a more local perspective!

We had difficulty finding a stop due to road works and called out to him. He ran down and had the driver wait for us to cross a busy street - 2 middle aged ladies who had chased the bus for blocks. He was very accommodating and checked in with us several times to make sure we could hear downstairs, etc.and later, helped us with a bus connection back to our hotel in Kensington. He had a very kind and gracious demeanor and was an excellent tour guide. Clear speaking voice with interesting content and a humorous manner. Well done Jonny. You saved our day and altered our impression of Golden Tours.
The bus service was good for 1 day then the next 2 days are too full and had to stand up in the bus for most of the time. Seems like success is killing them, need to add more buses on the road.

We had the amazing experience of travelling around London on one of these bus services with the incredibly knowledgeable guide of Stephen (with a ph not a v), he knew all the best picture oportunies, interesting information regards pretty much anything you could think of around the city, and most of all he was friendly and easy to understand, we thoroughly enjoyed our time on the bus.

Hosts were fun and charming, stops were well thought out and covered all major sights. I definitely recommend it. Traffic was very bad due to some taxi labour demonstrations (no fault of company). We spent a lot of time sitting on the bus rather than enjoying attractions.

Really impressed and the staff that we met were polite and very helpful. It was a bit chaotic trying to find the right route at the bus stop and i do understand with all the other nationalities its must be hard but even for me being English i nearly missed my bus. But the down side...I also bought tickets at the same time for the Madamme Tussauds with the Big Bus and assumed that one purchased we would gain immediate access as nothing else said otherwise...sadly no - we had to queue ages to show our ticket and then spend at least another 15 minutes at the desk to find out a slot which resulted us in in having to wait a further 2hrs and 15mins before we could go into the attraction - which was a complete and utter disaster as there were so many people outside not knowing which or where they should go and members of your staff getting irate and rude - which to be fair wasn't their fault either because it was so disorganised. If the Big Bus company is going to sell tickets for other attractions then they should make sure that the public are aware it doesn't mean immediate access - I expect they wont care as they are such a huge concern but listen to your feedback as its important...word of mouth etc!!

We jumped on this tour outside of our hotel and enjoyed the first portion. Once we got off the bus to get on another line, it was very chaotic as there are multiple tour lines at the same stop. We finally got on a bus and made it to our next destination. We then went to a different stop to catch the bus that claims to run every 15-20 mins. We were waiting forever for a bus and even tracking the bus on their site. There wasn't a bus in site. We finally had to take a cab back because we weren't sure how long we'd be.

I had 1 day on my own during a family vacation . I chose to purchase a one day ticket. Great access near underground stations and sites. Double decker was fun. They provide a map. I rode the blue and red line. Enjoyed the live guide. Only complaint was that some of there street signs for transfer were outdated. Use the map they give you.

It was delightful to get to know a bit more of London's history and amusing stories with this two FANTASTIC guides: Kinga is witty and knows some saucy details of some well known characters of London's history which makes it all that much more fun and interesting. Nick is a character in himself, full of energy and very amusing. They are both a HUGE asset to the company.
Very good and never will be disappointed with the guides and the live commentaries.the route map and the staff are quite engaging and cooperative and well entertained in a professional manner...

Buses are frequent and the staff are ever helpful. No shortage aboard of maps or earphones for tuning in to the recorded voice. Nevertheless, the live guides are best. Highly informational and entertaining.

We selected this option again because it was successful in our Paris trip. i appreciate the opportunity to get oriented to the city from second level. We wound up staying on for the whole loop because Valdas was rifling through so much information, and was open to questions. When new to a city, I recommend it in the first or second day. I found myself referencing so many of tour sites while traveling on foot.

Great views from the top of the bus. A very interesting commentary by Helena. ✔️✔️✔️
Wonderful way to see the sights of London quickly.

We purchased a 24 hour HOHO bus tour around London. At various stops, the bus guide would offer a walking tour by another guide for anyone interested in hopping off. We spontaneously hopped off at St. Paul's Cathedral and met Big Steve, our walking guide. Our tour was to go from St. Paul's to the Tower of London. Steve was a wonderful guide, was very knowledgeable, and took us to many fabulous spots for photos. Thanks to Steve as our photographer, we have some beautiful family photos of our visit with some of the most iconic buildings as the backdrop. Our walking tour was just my family, so Steve tailored our walk to things that met our interest. This was definitely not a scripted tour, as we took many unique stops based on our conversation, including stops related to Harry Potter. After we reached the Tower of London, Steve was headed toward Buckingham Palace for another walking tour, and he offered us the option to join him. He was such a great guide and we enjoyed his company, so we spontaneously took a 2nd walking tour with Big Steve. He is definitely an asset to the company!! Thanks for the great afternoon, Big Steve!!
Our tour guide, Big Steve, was the best!! He was knowledgeable, fun, funny, and knew all the best spots.

Steve is a very nice and funny guy. He's also an amazing guide! He thought me a lot today during my tour. I'll remember him for sure! His tour was the highlight of my day ! He's also a great photograph ;)

Jump on the red line to see most of London and also to hear live commentary. The guide on my bus was Roland and he was very entertaining. Such a pleasure!!

This particular tour takes in a river cruise as well which was fabulous. Highly highly recommended.

We had went for me tours and the river cruise to Westminster.
Our plan was to tour on to Buckingham palace, but all buses was full and trafic was cracy.
Our hero of the day was Big Steve who took us on a walking tour to Buckingham via Westminster Abbey and St James park.
Big Steve was an exellent guide!

There are at least 3 Hop On Hop Off bus tours in London. We went with the one our concierge recommended, the Big Bus. It served our purpose and the staff was really nice. Buses usually came fairly quickly, except in several occasions where we waited 15-20 minutes.

Despite it working out for us, I might suggest you try another line as this one was very crowded - and hot. We had lovely weather for the two days we did the buses and it was very nice sitting up in the open air top deck, despite the sun being a bit too hot. At least there was a breeze! However, due to the large number of tourists we were only able to get upstairs about half the time. Downstairs, inside the bus, it was quite warm and uncomfortable. There should really be a/c as in other Hop On Hop Off buses I have been on in other cities. These guys sell a lot of tickets and need more buses. Clearly profit margin rules this company.

Caron was an excellent tour guide. She knew all the right places to stand and explained in full detail what we could expect to see. This was my second time seeing the changing of the guard. This company is very professional and friendly.

We were on 3 different busses. The one with live commentary by Sheri was very informative and interesting (5stars). The other tour guide was OK. The bus ride with no commentary had more announcements about receipts and earphones than actual historical information.

What can i say , enjoyed the tour itself but the guide himself was a complete bullsh1tter who told everyone on the bus that that the reason the UK wore poppy's was for remberance day WHICH WAS ON THE 10/10 at 10 am , a lot of other stuff that really didn't ring true at all .if you want factual tours find another one

We purchased the 48 hour ticket with a walking tour of Buckingham Palace/ changing of the guards. Our leader for the walking tour was Steve and he was seriously so amazing! Answered all of our questions, promised to give us the best view and he definitely came through! We were front row for the marching of the guards and after the tour concluded Steve walked us to the best place for us to get afternoon tea just out of the kindness of his heart!! Everyone else would have pointed in a direction but Steve went the extra mile (on a 90° day mind you) to get us right where we wanted to be. He really made our time in London that much more great and we are all so thankful for Steve and all of his help and hard work! Steve if you’re seeing this your Boston friends will miss you dearly!

After the crippling heat of Saturday 29th June decided to take the hop on hop off bus on the Monday instead. Joined at Green Park (easy to find) and off we went . Vidas was our guide and he was great. Knew his stuff and was able to answer any question that was put to him. VERY good at dealing with a few annoying tourists. Its a good route (Red) , taking in all the main sites. We got of at Covent Garden , took the Tube to South Ken for the Natural History Museum and the V&A. Hooked up the Blue route from there and made our way back. OVERALL , good but £107.00 is a bit expensive for a day ticket. Vidas was excellent though and that gets the 4th star.
A great way to see the main sights without having to leg it around the city. However they do try to cram too many people into the us. Best done on a relatively quiet day if possible!

Bought the 2 day pass only needed 1 due to traffic congestion
The guide was great on the way back
Well worth it
Great way to get around and get a general overview of the city and where you want to spend time. Great thing to do on first or second day.

If the weather is good, make sure you ride on the upper deck. This tour gives you the opportunity to see the major highlights around London at your leisure. The buses run frequently, and they have several circuits to choose from, based on which areas of London you want to see. They sell 1-2-or3 day tickets. We did 1 day since we were already with a tour group for the majority of our trip. The guide gives a live tour. The guide we had was knowledgeable and funny. There is the option of a pre-recorded audio tour and it is offered in several languages. They give you headphones/earbuds when you get on the bus.

If you are traveling in London (or any new city for that matter), take the Hop On Hop Off Bus! It is a great way to see all the city highlights and if you find a particular place you want to visit longer, just hop off! Our tour guide was so funny and so knowledgeable.
Was a brilliant tour, daughter loved it also. The tour guide valak was awesome. Was very informative.

We had Will as our live tour. He was funny and made the tour interesting. The heat was ridiculous and it didnt dim his mood he was up beat friendly and was ready to answer any questions that were asked. Thoroughly enjoyed it and definitely doing it again when we take our son to London.

This was a great way to get around between popular attractions in London, and a nice way to see the things we didn’t care to stop at on our own. Our guide Stephen was fantastic! He was interesting and very funny!
Our guide was Roland and was very knowledgeable, which made the tour instructive, and he also had lovely humor.
Bought a few days using the Big Bus hop-on hop-off tours. A great way to get around London to tourist attractions. Cost is modest compared to the value.

My family and I just returned home from our trip to London. On June 25, 2019 between approximately 1030am and 1pm my family rode the big bus. We started off on the red line at pick up point number 12. We waited for close to an hour, (it is advertised a bus will come by every 15-20 minutes) and watched 2 buses pass us. During this same time, we also saw 2 of the original big bus (the union jack is painted on the side) pass by and wished we had opted to purchase tickets for that big bus company instead. We did eventually get on, however unfortunately this was not the worst of our experience. Our driver was Wesley and the tour guide was Nick. We found Nick very unprofessional. As we drove Nick was talking about the sites and asking questions to the passengers; when my 20 yr old daughter was incorrect in her answer he made her stand up and walk through the middle of the bus to the end, turn around and walk back encouraging all the other passengers to chant “shame, shame, shame” while making reference to The Game of Thrones style of treatment. My daughter protested that passengers are not to stand on a moving bus (signs are posted on the bus), but Nick said he would make an exception, putting my daughter’s safety in jeopardy. Of course during this time the bus continues to move, and we are passing sites that we paid to view and learn about. Shortly after this event, Nick also sat on my daughter’s lap. We were very disturbed by Nick’s inappropriate, abusive and unprofessional behaviour. We got off the bus at check point number 16 and did not return to finish the route or any other route.

Booked a Big Bus London Hop on hop off tour for our family of 4 and it was horrible. When we got on the bus there were no seats on top or in the bus. The bus driver packed in passengers so tight it got very hot standing with no air. Those standing had no audio. Those sitting complained that their audio was not working. One family behind us said they were standing for 40 minutes with no audio! A family with young children all had to stand for the whole 30 minutes that we were on the bus. We got off after 30 minutes with no seat or audio and took an uber which was quick and direct.

We bought the London Pass and so had a day on the tour! We hopped on in Leicester square with Valdas and enjoyed the red route so much! He was so well spoken and gave cues of where to look, just when to get the perfect shot of all of the wonderful sights! We rode the red route a couple of other times and never had as good an experience than we did with Valdas! We extended our day to include a night tour. Sean, a big bus info guy at the London Eye stop, told is to get there around 8:15 to load. We got there at 8:00 though, and were happy to nab a spot on the second, open level! I enjoyed watching London darken from the bus, but my mother was underwhelmed! Also to note, we took the last night tour bus. At the marble arch, we thought we were on the route that they call ‘Home James’ which would have dropped us near our hotel in Kensington. However they don’t run a ‘Home James’ route on the third, latest bus and we were deposited on the sidewalk about 2 miles from our hotel. Not the drivers fault but definitely misinformation! Made it home safely and were happy to extend our day pass for one more day to get around uptop! I’ve used the service in Paris and would absolutely use it in any other city! Best way to get around for touring! And I consider myself anti-tourist! So a BIG compliment coming from me! Cheers and I hope this information/review helps other people trying to figure this out!!!

Very good experience and definitely worth with money for a great overall tour of the entire city. There are several routes you can choose from covering a very large part of the city. We had an excellent day with Christopher and Chloe being the two outstanding live tour guides. Thanks guys for making us smile! Julie & Carl

The tour was only worth it as we were lucky enough to get Nick as the live guide, twice while we hopped on/off the red line. He was extremely knowledgeable, and continued to tell us bits of information even when we got stuck in traffic, so no one got ever got bored.
I was quite sad when we had to get off his bus.

Our tour guide, Will, was very entertaining and had a wonderful personality that made our time with him very memorable! And of course this tour is a great way to see all the major sights of the city and get a good “lay of the land.”

We were on the Red line on the 20th of June and really enjoyed our experience. We had a wonderful guide Valdas, who was very friendly, helpful and professional. My parents do not speak English, thus Valdas talked to them in their native language, Lithuanian. He advised us about getting to the River Thames cruise and made us feel welcome. We enjoyed London and The Big Bus Tour a lot! Highly recommend.

Took the Red Tour from Marble Arch on June 28 in the afternoon. The driver must not have punched the buttons for the commentary, pre-recorded guide. No live guide on this bus. About 2 hours of mostly music in my ear, marching music, pomp and circumstance and Greensleeves. Heard the bit about the Tower Bridge 3 different times but very few other recordings. Very disappointing. Changed buses and the next red had a live guide which was much better. And the blue tour we took had commentary all the way around.
This was the first time we have used you with family visiting fron the US. It was fantastic. Would not have asked for better guides or more helpful ones.

We booked a London hop-on / hop-off tour prior to our trip to England, Scotland, Wales and Ireland. We were looking for something that would allow us to see some London sights prior to departing on an organized bus tour of the British Isles. While we were on the big red bus, one of their guides came on board to ask if we would like to see the Queen ... well ... we had no idea that this was the day of her official birthday celebration. So we followed the guide and saw the trouping of the colors followed by seeing the royal family up on the Buckingham Palace. Our guide Caron was especially helpful navigating us through enormous mobs of people everywhere. She did her best to get around and (legally) through barricades and traffic. This was a wonderful surprise and a totally unplanned highlight of our trip.
we had done it twice in 4 years , it's nice for those who would like to spend sime times arround the city
Great way to see the sights and thanks to Roland for the commentary which was informative and amusing. Also included a cruise up the Thames which was also excellent.

Love this hop on hop off 24 hour idea. Longest tour was great. Our guide was really knowledgeable and funny. He made our tour real fun

I booked online and had to redeem at the store. Be careful not to be talked into any other attractions you don’t want to do, it can work out expensive

Don’t be disappointed that the tour doesn’t drive by Buckingham palace - buses aren’t allowed past The Palace

Fairly lengthy tour, other shorter tours are available but the long tour was fab

The guide, Nick, was amazing! Great sense of humor and interactive towards riders. We, 8 people, enjoyed the ride so much. The driver, Tamic did a great job. Not even a close call. Thank you for the amazing ride!
These tours have been a standard for out of town touring. For both local transportation and hearing the history, this is a great option to see it all without walking.

I was in London just for two days and I got to see a lot with Big Bus Tours.
You can spend the whole day touring: four diferent routes, walking tours, river cruise and even night tour.
Ian was our guide and he was so friendly and gave us a lot of information about the city.
I would definitely recomend Big Bus Tours.
Our guide Valdas was brilliant and gave excellent live commentary and was very helpful! would highly recommend!

We enjoyed our journey on the bus and the cruise boat. We were well informed by the knowledgeable guide Valdas from Lithuania! Very helpful and approachable!! Thanks very much Colin and Ros Schmidt Cape Town
Valdes was a phenomenal guide! He shared lots of great facts as we toured the city. Thanks for making our trip so exceptional. Three happy Americans!
Great trip. Very informative. Look out for Tiffany for a great experience and commentary. Thank you Tiffany.

We have used Big Bus before due to the hop-on-hop-off which makes seeing a city that much more enjoyable . The London guides are no different with local knowledge and humour to boot it's well worth the money. We had the 2-day pass which includes the river trip up or down the Thames depending where you are when you catch it. There are 4 different tours all colour coded so you know which tour your on and can plan how to get on and off. Had it not been for British weather we would have enjoyed it more but getting wet in rush hour on the top deck trying to take landmark pictures isn't fun.

We did our bus tour with Emma. She’s absolutely fantastic. Live commentary makes the experience so much more special. She’s extremely knowledgeable. The tour is a great way to see the city. Kids loved it.

Great bus tour! Valdas was super!!!! We loved sitting up top and learning so much about London. There were fascinating details about the city and culture we would have never learned without such a great tour guide!

My family and I used the Big Bus on the Saturday of the Trooping the Colour. We took the red line for a live guide. Because of the ceremony, several of the stops were cancelled. Of course, that could not be helped, but as our nice guide, Oliver, explained, route detours can happen quite often in London. The bus itself stopped at the indicated places, which somehow sometimes did not seem in a convenient location. London itself is very spread out, so plan on plenty of walking. We ended up hiring a tuk tuk at one point and were stunned when we ended up not with a price of 10 pounds for the 3 of us for a 5 minute trip, but 30 (10 pounds for each person, which the driver did not tell us in the beginning). Beware!
Really enjoyed the tour with them, very helpful app, easy to find stops and staff pleasant and helpful. This improved an otherwise quite lousy outing.

Worth every penny. Interesting central London locations in a systematic route. We had a commentary by Ian who was very knowledgable and interesting. Giving in-depth details around things like the great fire of London and local history.

如果你不知道这个城市是省钱的最佳选择。我们使用这项服务10位朋友2天。谢谢。

If you don't know the city is the best option to save money. We used this service 10 friends for 2 days. Try to buy it on Monday or Thursday. Thank you for your help.

Service runs every 45 min to 1 hr. Worst then that 2 times after the long wait, I got on the bus after 2 stops they asked everyone to get off bus and walk about 1/4 block to get on another bus, then sit again and wait for about 25 min for a driver on a shift change. By the the I got to my stop what I was trying to visit with family was closed. It actually took 3 1/2 hr just to get to from Kensington Palace to London Eye. Their cost are more then their competitors but If you like me willing to pay more for a company with good reviews this on is fake SKIP and used less costing tour bus. Trust me.

We chose Big Bus as our hop-on-hop-off bus tour as part of the London Pass on our last day in London. So glad we did! Took the red route and saw a few sights we missed and learned a few new facts about sights we’d seen. Emma was our guide the entire route and we were lucky to have her. She was warm & welcoming and very knowledgeable & entertaining. We didn’t even mind the London rain.

10/06/19 - 'splendid day' to know London .. Christopher explained guiding us through his many 'tangents'... Emma on the 2nd tour was great fun to hear from.. good luck for her next Goa trip! The incessant rain forced to change plans .. keeping most hoppers on the bus thereby adding to the surprise experience.

I can return for Red Tours (only) again and again to know more about the city from the witty and knowledgeable gentlemen and ladies with the red jackets.
Great two day bus tour, with Joe’s guided walk to Buckingham palace (and the night tour) as our highlight(s)

We did the Hop on Hop off Tour on the red line and hopped off at some really interresting places. But first we stayed a while on to see the streets of London and listend to live comments by a lady called Emma. She did a great job, bacause she knew anything and told some experieces from her private life at some spots like the bank quarter. It was also easy to understand her even as a German like me and her spaeking wasn‘t to fast. Great job, Emma. Get onto a tour like this guys, it‘s worth it!

Don't expect an all day tour or frequent buses. In the morning we did enjoy the sarcastic humor of the live commentary. We decided to switch from the Red line to Blue and after waiting 35 minutes for the bus to come, gave up to get on a public bus. Ticket salespeople said it would be there any minute, but even with the live tracking in the app, didn't see anything coming. We later got on a bus, it went one stop before we were told to move to another bus, had to wait for 10 minutes for that to leave. It went two stops then we were told to move buses again where we couldn't get seats together.
Overall, I wouldn't recommend this company. The other tours seemed to have many more buses.

Got this bus tour on Saturday 18th may
We paid £107 for my husband myself and our son who has special needs.
We got on the bus and a few stops later we were told that we had to get off the bus and wait for another bus as they were having problems .
We were told a bus would come along in a few minutes.
We waited forty minutes for a bus to come, when it did everyone got on it was total chaos we were packed on like cattle. We had to get off and make our way back to Euston station.
I have never experienced anything like this before my son was exhausted and frightened,
Other bus tours seem to be operating ok on that Saturday.
I email this company on Sunday 19th May and as yet they have not replied
Enjoyed our trip on the bus tour around all the sites of London. Very interesting commentary given by Tiffany with lots of laughs.
Valdas out guide was very nice n informative and paula our driver was nice and safe. Loved it highly recommend it if u wanna tour the city and get to the attractions on time
The Big Bus Tour Bus was great. Our tour guide Emma was ABSOLUTELY AMAZING!!! She was very enthusiastic and knowledgeable. We never got off...she was so entertaining

The staff were awesome and very informed of the landmarks and history of London. I ws disappointed that some of the attractions were not available, which was no fault of the Hop-on-Hop-Off bus company.
Had a great walking tour with Big Steve. Knowledgeable and funny. Also gave us some pearls as to where to eat to experience a good pub meal. Thanks Steve

Great service but guides were often difficult to understand between the lovely British accent and poor acoustics. Would definitely recommend, however, as it is a great way to get around London, as well as to sightsee.

If you have no problems while or after booking this tour is fine, not great but ok. Our live guide was not very informative but at least they made the effort to have a live guide. We wanted to change the day of the booking, called the company, they said they cannot help and we have to call trip adviser, so we called the US helpdesk (the only number I found after a 30 min search) which cost us 30 euros (!) only to find out from their side (After they called the company) that we can just use the same ticket on another day. Wish the guy on the phone at big bus could have given us this simple info in the beginning...

Big Steve, Caron and Alfie, you were wonderful with your explanation! Thank you!
You have encouraged my discovery of London to discover even more.

We decided to do this tour, as if well done they are a great way to learn a city's history. We set off from Green Park, all ok but with the London traffic the pace was fairly slow. All this changed when we arrived at stop 13, where we were given the offer to get off and do a guided walk around the city. Our guided Phillip, Ian and Joe were excellent, we walked from St Pauls to the Tower of London, stopping at all sorts of sites from the "Gerkin" tower to where some of Harry Potter was filmed, the guys knowledge of the city was fantastic. We could only recommend this option, we also caught the ferry back to stop 18 and the bus from there back to the end of the tour, the walk is an absolute must based on our experience. Well done Phillip, Ian and Joe😄😄😄

We only had one day in London and could have spent the whole day on the Big Buses. Unfortunately we only had a few hours but absolutely loved it. Our guide was hilarious and her commentary very informative. Would definitely choose this company again just for the live guides. Allow plenty of time to do it justice!
We did the red route tour, Christopher the tour bus guide was great with the commentary, loads of info on the go, and a few good laughs! Highly recommended for those on short visits with kids.

Even though it was raining, our mood wasn't damped, because Lewis was so entertaining, funny and charming, it made our entire day.
He really knows how to entertain while still providing you with knowledge about the city without it being boring. Big thumbs up! Greetings from Germany!

I did the Big Bus London tour with my two adult children in mid-March. I found it to be a good option for getting around London, but was disappointed by what I found to be difficult and time consuming effort to connect to other routes. If you are in London for a day, I would recommend just to get an Underground ticket for the day with unlimited travel (I think about US$15/person). The Big Bus ticket was about US$50/each.

The Red Line Tour is the central tour around Central London. Every bus except the first of the morning was packed to the gills. The buses tended to bunch up so the time between buses is longer than advertised. We watched half-full buses from other companies come past at a much more regular interval. In one case, a mostly empty Big Bus went past our stop because there was already a (completely stuffed) Big Bus loading/unloading. We finally gave up waiting and made the walk from the Tower of London to Holborn. To the positive, the live guides on the route were very good.
We took the Red Hop on Hop Off Tour. This included live commentary in English by Nobby. He was very entertaining and informative.

Due to a state visit this wss totally disrupted. Despite their claims of a bus every 15minutes at one stop we waited 45. Some of the routes advertised wete actually closed so we ended up going over dame ground several times.They kept saying on their pa that the tour would be disrupted and as these were prerecorded they wrte aware at least the day before, and probably more, that this was goong to happen. My main gripe is that we were unaware of this until they had our money and we were on the bus. Surely they were honour bound to say at point of purchase that the trip would not be as advertised. Not at all happy.

I wasn't impressed the first day, as the "live guides" were barely alive (one never got out of his seat and you could barely hear him). Thus was a total change from what I had experienced several years before. But, the second day was totally different. Reps were very personable. "Big Steve" was awesome! He made sure he walked me down to the Westminster Pier to ensure I got there, and along the way pointed out several interesting things. Changed my mind about the Company. I hope I get to have Big Steve as my guide when I am back in the fall.
Tour guide Ashley met us and helped us plan our entire day! He was friendly and helpful. The bus tour was entertaining and informative. It’s a great deal that I would recommend to anyone!
We had an awesome trip and Ashley was super awesome and helpful! We came with a group from our college and rode the bus and did the river cruise. Great way to experience all of London!

Had an apartment for a few days in London and did this tour just to get a feel for where we were in the city. It was a nice way see the highlights. Spent a few hours driving around and then hopped off to walk a bit. Fun trip with nice headphone set up. Had a guide pointing things out. We enjoyed it. Thanks.

If youre planning a trip to London then look no further than Big Bus Tours. Absolutely brilliant. We got our tickets just outside the Royal National hotel and the guys there were amazing, so helpful and informative. Nothing was too much trouble. A very special thankyou to the guys on the green line and a massive thumbs up to Ricky who looked like Peter O'toole and sounded like Peter O'toole! Using Big Bus Tours is a must if you want to see all the sights London has to offer. Our only regret is we werent there longer! Once again we cant thank the green line guys and Ricky enough. Thankyou so much for making our weekend in London a memorable one. Well done Big Bus Tours.
It was very convenient to be able to go from one area to another one with a 2 day pass. This is the best plan particularly when you only have 3 days in London.

We enjoyed the tour until they switched the route and the whole bus was trying to figure out why we were seeing everything three times. Then they made us switch a bus and everyone lost their seats upstairs. Long day.

Purchased a two day ticket in London for 4. I called before purchasing and asked if two day pass is good for any 2 days, not back to back days. I gave them the dates and they said I could use them. All of us got on bus, gave our tickets, and was told it was only good for back to back day use. I was scammed! No where did it say before I purchased that it had to be used back to back.

Stop 20 was right outside our hotel by Buckingham Palace so was incredibly convenient for the red bus tour and connecting to the orange and blue tours. We had live commentary on two trips which was really interesting. Other times we had a pre-recorded commentary or music. The guides and drivers are really knowledgeable and helpful. There is an incredible amount of building work going on in London at the moment and this along with road closures for events and demonstrations means traffic is sometimes diverted or delayed. We did manage to see the Queens Guards ride by on their way to Changing the Guard which was a bonus. It’s very easy to understand the route being one way round London but it does mean it’s sometimes quicker to walk and cut across the city than ride the full way round. That said I’d rather ride on the bus and take in the sights than stand on the over crowded tubes. Our 3 day ticket included a return river cruise which was interesting and gives you a different view of the city from the Thames. We didn’t take up any of the offers to visit experiences but judging by the queues it would be a good idea with fast track and discounts. Some stops, alongside popular attractions, are much busier than others and the buses fill up or empty at for example the Tower of London. So you’ll need to be patient - you’ll enjoy it all a lot more if you go relax and remember you’re on holiday. We chose to travel by Big Red Bus because we enjoyed the tour in San Francisco so much - the London red bus trips are similar without the hilarious guides commentary. Hop on to see many of London’s famous, and infamous, tourist attractions with a bus side seat.

We booked a one day hop and off your and made the most of it cramming nearly every route in and jumping off at points of interest to us. Our first bus had a guide on called Lewis he made you feel really welcome and interacted with everyone on the top deck. Shared fascinating facts (some personal) about the places we saw on-route. We as a family would highly recommend the Big Bus Co. one for its staff and cleanliness and two for convenience and ease to us. Good job guys, well done.

We booked a hop on/off day pass so we could see the sites with our 2 young children whose legs aren’t up to much walking. The buses were waaaay over crowded, we were stuck stood up for ages with the children so they couldn’t see anything much, we eventually got a seat but we’re all split separately. The only saving graces were Ray, the lovely driver who chatted with the children pointing out what he could while we were in stationary traffic & Joe, the tour guide who when we did eventually find ourselves in a position to plug in our ear phones & listen, was very knowledgeable and entertaining. What topped off the somewhat disappointing experience was that just when we did get seats together on the top deck it was time to switch drivers & tour guide, the bus was totally full so what a joy to be told everyone had to get off and get on another bus. What a joke! We gave up & walked. Absolutely not worth the £107 it cost, wouldn’t recommend & would not use again.
Bought the 3 day pass and gave up after day one. They sell too many tickets, not enough seats. Go with one of the other 3 options

We started with Big Bus from Marble Arch in the morning with a decent tour up to St Paul, but it was already running late.

When we wanted to continue, the bus just did not want to come. Several buses from the other companies passed and when Big Bus came it was so crowded the we did not get on. We took the tube to our next stop.

Later on we gave them another chance. We went to stop 19. Again, the bus did not come. After about 15 minutes wait we discovered a small sign, telling us that this stop is “temporarily closed”. Finally, after a long walk we was able to catch a bus that finished our tour.

I was inclined to give an even lower score, but at the end of the day a few dedicated employee made sure that we all get back to our hotels. Thanks for that.

They were totally oversold. We spent the day waiting in line for a bus. Finally after an hour at the tower of london we took a cab. They said there was a traffic problem but all ofmthe other bus comapnies continued to come and go. The cruise was another 45min wait. We have used on and off in other cities and enjoyed it. This was a very bad experience.
I really enjoyed the Big Bus Tour Red line yesterday. The live guide we had was excellent - i think her name was Helena (NZ girl with blonde bob).

The big bus tour around Central London was amazing.
The live commentary by Caron about the building and their history was really good.
Would recommend every person who Visits London to take a ride with big bus tour.
Cheers.

We purchased a 3 day pass and utilized it all three days. The bus routes were excellent, taking us to all of our planned destinations. All of the staff we encountered were first class; from the staff selling the tickets on the street, the drivers and the on board guides.
Must do when in London, we saw a lot of beautiful and interesting places. Tiffany is the best guide! We didn't want to get of the bus :p

This is a great tour to see London. My daughter and I had the best tour guide, Big Steve. He was extremely friendly and very intelligent, it was almost like a private tour. He told jokes and great stories. We did the full 2 hours around London and loved every minute of it. Thanks Big Steve for the wonderful tour.

This is a great tour to get yourself acquainted with London. My mom and I had the best tour guide named Big Steve. He took a shine to us and gave the best tour we've ever had. He was friendly, had funny jokes and super knowledgeable.

The only credit goes to one of their employees who tried to sort out the terrible situation when people had to pass at least two full buses on the red line to get on the third one - some of us had to stand. Then when changing the bus, driver declined to open middle door for me (after shouting loud two times) so I had to drag out our twin buggy through the first door between people trying to get in. On the way back we had to change buses on green line uselessly without any explanation or excuse. NEVER EVER AGAIN! WORST EXPERIENCE FROM THE WHOLE TRIP TO LONDON.

Got on around corner from Paddington station. Had no commentary at all. Got off at Marble Arch to change colour route from blue to red. Get ear phones for the commentary off a tray on the bus as you get on. Upstairs there is someone telling you all about the sites you pass but downstairs you have to use the ear phones! Very important you get these!!! Went around a small part of the journey, really enjoying it then suddenly at one on the bus stops I heard through the EAR PHONES that it wasn’t continuing on this route ( just after Trafalgar Square). It was going to divert up the map to the green route area then continue on the red route up there. This was due to demonstrations in London, roads were being closed everywhere ! We had booked to go on the London eye so we had to get off and walk a VERY long way using our phone as a map as we were just left to get on with it, no-one to give you instructions on which way to go. Went on the London Eye which was good but then went to catch the bus again to continue our journey using the orange route only to be told there’s no bus for 2 hours at that stop, you will have to walk to one about a quarter of a mile away to get it. All of this disruption meant we missed seeing so much of London as we needed to get back to Paddington to catch our train. When we eventually caught the next bus, there was no commentary again. We had no idea where we were,we had no one on any of our journey telling us which bus stop you were coming up to next so missed seeing Buckingham Palace and had to keep asking the driver which bus stop we were at. Ear phones are a must if you are not on the open top of the bus. If there is no one commentating, then good luck! It’s a nightmare.

Courtney was the guide. Very knowledgeable and fun stories. Great way to see London. You can get information on the areas or monuments you want to visit and they have multiple lines to get you to your points of interest
We loved our tour guide Sophie!! So many amazing facts, and such a fun time!!! Will do it next year again! Thanks so much Loved it!!!!!!
Booked online and had a great two day hop on hop off tour including a VERY entertaining Thames Cruise thanks to the tour guide - hilarious!

Highly enjoyed the tour with Big Steve! He made the journey very enjoyable, and I learned a lot too! This is a great way to see the city on your first day, get your bearings and see all the major sights.

It's a hop on hop off bus, so you probably know what to expect. The headset worked and the bus was pretty regular. We arrived on a long weekend so the bus was absolutely packed, and for those trying to board at smaller stops I did see a number of people turned away and waiting for the next one (only for the red line), so plan around this if you know you're there on a peak day. Blue line was quiet and seats a plenty though.

The boat cruise was lovely and included in the fee which is a good bonus.

My only feedback is really on the commentary. It's advertised as "live" but that's only one line (not mentioned by the staff at any point or on the brochure). To be honest this didn't bother me as two of the three guides we had during the day didn't have much of interest to say, muddled up their dates and just chattered a lot. The recording was much better for history but it depends what you're into. If it's just a way to get around to the tourist sites safely and regularly then it's a great option.

Tiffany was a wealth of information making this Big Bus tour the highlight of my first trip to London. She was delightfully entertaining and, with only three days on the job, she provided in-depth knowledge of the historical sights coupled with humor and a lovable personality.

My boyfriend and I decided to do a bus tour for his first time in London, Nick was an excellent guide and made sure to tell us it was only his second day on the job!! He was incredibly engaging and made the whole experience very delightful and fun! Highly recommend to anyone looking for a fun and factual way round London!

Entire experience with Big Bus London was standout. Starting with the excellent website for pretrip planning, then helpful staff member just outside Victoria Station, to the trip routes and service, this made my first day in London perfect. Steve was a standout guide, super informative, full of information and keeping it interesting.

Great service , great guide ( Nick), great sense o humor
Friendly drivers
Buses come very often
Very informative

Absolutely terrible experience with the Big Bus Tours. My family and I went to London for the weekend and purchased 5 Big Bus (costing 175 pound sterling) tickets in May, 2019 so we could enjoy the sights of London. We got on the first leg of our exciting tour on Saturday morning. The guide was terrible and most of the iconic buildings and their history passed us by. We got off the Big Bus tour to have a look around. Once we finished we tried to get back on the Big Bus but unfortunately after waiting for approximately a half hour the Big Bus that arrived was full and we could not get on it and so waited for the next one which didn’t come. With time constraints we eventually had to find a Tube Station and pay for five underground tickets to get us to our next location. We went sightseeing and around 5:10pm on the same Saturday we again queued up for the Big Bus to take us to Buckingham Place again we waited for approx. 50 mins and not a sign of any of your buses so again we had to find our own way there. We selected your bus company in good faith with the expectation that we could hop on and hop off to explore London. This was not the case and caused me and my family to loose valuable sightseeing time and also an added expensive of having to buy tube tickets. I would not recommend this Big Bus to anyone. There were 4 buses from another two companies to every 1 Big Bus.
Great audio provided. Tour gave interesting tid bits about London and history I found interesting. Glad I did not have to fight that traffic trying to get around London myself or on foot.
The hop on hop off bus tour was good except the spacing of the buses. We had to wait for more than 25 minutes a few times for certain routes for the next bus.

The first bus driver could not have been less helpful, and terse. We switched to the red line, where over the course of an hour, we heard how expensive London real estate is, how long it takes our “tour guide” to commute to work since he can’t afford to live in London, how his “mate” said a particular bar was very good, you get the idea. A complete waste of time, and due to the London traffic, we’d barely gone 1/4 of the route. We bailed and took the underground to St Paul’s, and never looked back.

Fortunately we didn’t actually pay for this horrific experience, it was part of our London Pass. Do not recommend at all.

The guide, Karen, was fantastic! She shared interesting facts about many of the stops. During our visit there were protests that affected traffic. We were stuck in traffic for longer than expected and she filled the time well.

We then attempted to take the river tour, and that's where the good ended. The tour boat was dated and the inside seats were old and uncomfortable. We ended up leaving the tour before it started

Overall, a great experience and we learned a lot about the city and history!

This was a great way to spend our first day in London and it helped us learn our way around. The boat trip was fun and gave us a view of things from the water
I would highly recommend this tour!

With only a couple of days to spend in London and with boys with little feet, the BB was great. But only because we chose to do a big route on a Sunday - Saturday was super busy and we can’t even imagine how it would have worked during the week.
We were also really lucky to get Nobby as our guide. On Saturday we hopped on briefly and had a boring commentator, but we loved his commentary, loved his nuggets of knowledge (having just discussed Operation Paper Clip, it was great to hear it mentioned by Nobby), and loved his sense of humour. He made the tour so worthwhile we stayed in for a while route.
Thank you Nobby.

We typically use Hop on Hop Off tours to get get a feel for a destination, and we weren't disappointed with Londons Big Bus Tour. Our guide Lewis on the Red route, provided an informative commentary, and it was also extremely entertaining. He was great in using the microphone to query the country of origin of every group/couple that boarded the bus. It made for a load of fun. We would highly recommend Lewis and the rest of the team, for a great tour. We bought a three day pass, and we will be back on board tomorrow.

We spent the morning/early afternoon on the Hop On/Hop Off blue and red lines. The Red line has live guides which can really make a positive impact on the experience. We really lucked out with Courtney as a guide and Omar as a driver. Courtney was friendly and engaging - knowledgable and fun. She also managed some very loud guests in a direct but kind way that solved a problem that could have gotten out of hand.

Our only issues were some of the transfers were confusing (At Marble Arch all buses don't stop in the same place) but other than that - easy online booking, frequent buses (relatively speaking) and routes that hit all the major spots.

My friend and I did the red line tour and rode along with our tour guide Louis! He was so funny and friendly, and made me laugh throughout the trip! He was a great guide and he was funny, but also had some really cool things to say and facts about the landmarks. I would definitely ride again with Louis, thank you so much! We had a running joke about the zebra crossings/cross walks and it made me laugh the whole time.

My elderly parents and I bought premium tickets including both the hop on hop off and night tour. The website lists the starting point of the Night Tour as Stop 12, London Eye. We proceeded to stop 12 at the designated time, waited 40 minutes in the blustery cold, and messaged back and forth with the company until we realized that they had failed to update the stop numbers on the app. We rushed to the actual stop, where the ticket taker informed us they were aware of the error. This was an awful way to start the trip, made even worse by the fact that the company knew about the mistake

I have been to London countless times for shopping or work, but never really taken in the monuments or the history. Nobby was a fantastic tour guide. Really interesting and funny, and the route took us to see things I had never spotted before. Worth every penny. The tickets also give you great discounts to get into attractions and a free trip on city cruise.
Good announcer however the support guys to get us on the bus were not helpful. Ended up wating near a stop for 35 minutes for a bus to come and it never came... Not happy with the service....
Lionel was a great guide, very knowledgeable and really fun with humor. Michael was an excellent driver.

This was a great way to see the London sites and get a good overview of the history on the way.
The bus was comfortable, and we were well looked after by the tour guide.

He gave a very interesting commentary as we travelled effortlessly all around London. We saw the major sites, and learned a great deal. There were headphones if you needed them, but they were not necessary as the guide was easy to hear without them. It was really nice to have a bus tour with a live guide, rather than listening to a tape.

The bus stops were located near all major sites and shopping areas and were easy to find.

We had a great time, and would recommend this to everyone.

We used the big bus hop on and off as part of our London pass. When we had our passes scanned we were each given a paper receipt. Nothing was said about the importance of that piece of paper or that we would need it again. When we went to board the bus after our first stop, they asked for our paper receipts and one of our daughters had no idea where hers had gone. As a result we did not use the bus again. When I asked how we were to know to keep that receipt, the person pointed to the bottom of the brochure (which we weren't even given) where it says in small print that if you loose ypur receipt you will need to buy a new pass. I don't feel this was very fair as it certainly wasn't clear and I doubt we were the first family to have this experience!

After being sold tickets for the bus we were told by the rep that we shouldn’t have been sold them as most of the bus routes were closed due to roads being closed through protests.
I was told to contact them directly as the rep couldn’t do anything and they would give me a refund.
After emailing them I finally got a reply after a MONTH, and all it stated was it wasn’t there problem and they didn’t really care.
Avoid these and use the other company. (City tours i think) at least they were pre warning people.

Was a good tour. Worth if you want to see the city in short time.
All the guides were good except for the tour person wearing the uniform at Gloucester road from where I started was really rude and least interested in helping anyone who enquired. If I hadn't bought my ticket earlier I would have dropped my plans of tour with Big Bus because of this Man. I have his name though wouldn't like to disclose it here.

Perfect way to find your way around the city if you’re directionally challenged like myself

Came right past my hotel do pickup was easy and the guides knew their stuff so supper happy about that.

Only criticism is that blue route need more frequent pick ups

If you are fortunate enough to get Lionel as your guide on the red route - and Mark as the driver - then you are guaranteed an excellent experience. Lionel is knowledgeable, informative and entertaining. Great tour, great guide!

We were really looking forward to going around London with the big bus tours but it was a huge disappointment. The buses were way over crowded and running extremely slow. Not once did we get to sit on the top and enjoy any view whatsoever during the entire day. The river cruise was the same way. There were too many people and not enough places to sit and enjoy the tour especially when you are traveling with little kids. Not worth the money!

Today we spent several hours on the Big Bus Hop on Hop off tour. The first tour guide we got was named Chloe. She was confident and empathetic when dealing with people who both could not figure things out or who did not speak a language she could speak. Unfortunately she had to contend with a bus that needed repair and staff/drivers who did not seemingly show up on time. Still, through all that, the trip was as advertised and we saw many outstanding sites described by an outstanding host. I would book this company again.
This tour leaves from Victoria Coach station and takes through the main downtown areas. Drops you off at the London pier for the pleasant boat ride down the Thames.
Great tour guides. Very convenient. Get on/off and back on at your convenience. Frequent buses. Buses had recordings in many languages.

We just came back from our holiday in London and chose to see all the highlights using the Big Bus London. Great way to see the sites and there was always a bus 15 minutes (or less) to take you to your next stop.

A big shout out to Christopher who provided some personalized live commentary for my husband and I early in the morning when we were the only ones on the bus! Thank you Christopher.

Christine (from Canada)

You can get around way faster and easier on the underground. This was over twice the price of the underground. We spent all day waiting for buses, waiting for traffic, and there wasn’t even a live tour guide as advertised. Would NOT recommend :|

We really enjoyed our tour today with the many stops on the Big Bus. The highlight of our tour though was the walking tour with Steve. Traffic was horrible due to demonstrations by taxi drivers and since the buses were having to try to get around all that, Steve offered to take us on a walking tour. It was awesome! I think it would be great if they continued to offer it. Steve was friendly, knowledgeable, and very helpful with tips on the area. He was also really patient, as we kept stopping to take photos as we went (he even took a few family photos for us). We had a great day thanks to Steve and all the staff with Big Bus tours.
Thanks to our amazing tour guide, Oliver, we had a blast!! He was very informational and so funny! We saw everything we wanted! Our driver Gary was awesome!
It was such a cool time Oliver our tour guide and Gary our driver were both awesome! Super with family and friends!

We had a 3 day pass which also gave us roundtrip on cruise on Thames River, and additional walking tour opportunities. The Red Line is the one with the live narrative, the other lines have headphones with taped tours. The only issue is that with all the construction and traffic in London, the tours themselves take much longer than estimated. So you can't really go from one place to another very quickly. Leave lots of time if you have specific times to be somewhere. Otherwise, the tour was very good and, depending on the tour guide, it can be quite entertaining. Also, if you miss the last bus, and you can get to Marble Arch, they offer after hours travel back to certain hotel locations.
Very well organized, in short time easiest way to visit landmarks in London or any other interesting places. Not expensive, lot of hop on hop off stations.
Had a great experience. Louis was our guide and was fantastic, kept us laughing the whole ride. Great

We had the opportunity to view the top sights of London. The Changing of the Guards was wonderful. I wish we would have had more time to view some of the sights, but we made a list and went back and saw each sight that we felt interested us.

If you have one or two days and you want to see at least a glimpse of everything this city has to offer, this is a great way to do it, as it covers every interest point with many routes and drops points.

We had a choice of 3 companies. We chose the Big Bus because they had more help in purchasing discount tickets to other sights. the stops were convenient, the drivers were friendly and helpful and the live guide was informative.

First time in London, decided to use the big bus tour to see things & get around. The bus was great, very frequent and guides where informative and friendly. Veldice was our favourite guide, gave great info without sharing too much unwanted info and was very funny.

We enjoyed our experience, especially with the buses that had live commentary. One in particular his name was Valdes, he knew so much about everything that it had us looking from left to right constantly! And the information that he was sharing was not only knowledgeable, but very entertaining! Despite being stuck on the top in the rain, his sense of humor with the tour made sitting in the rain not that bad. Highly reccomend!
Great way to see London. Ask if the buses have road closure issues. Great humor in the guides. Wear a hat

On the whole this is the best way to see London and the tour reps are good and helpful. We saw lots in one day despite the most awful weather 🤣
However we paid £70 to include a free river cruise but when we got off at tge terminal we were told to come back in 20 minutes as it was full. When we returned there was an even bigger queue and told we would have to wait at least an hour. We decided not to as we wanted to see more sights
I have asked the Big Bus company for a response and they said "The cruise is a free gift with the bus ticket and as such the price paid for tickets does not vary whether the cruise is taken or not. I would however be very happy to arrange for you to be able to take the river cruise on another occasion."

Therefore dont rely on getting on the cruise.. we are unable to return so we cant take them up on the offer
Would definately do a bus tour again but there are other companies providing the same service to be fair
Great access to all of the sights, and our guides GiGi Englezou and Ahmed Abdullahi were excellent. Very informative, and super funny.

Very very expensive for a family of four but the red line was great fun and the tour guide Owen was great however on other lines you listen to the pre recorded guide with mostly instrumental music. Expensive for what it is could do better deals for families

A friend and I did the Big Bus Tour in January this year. Mehmet was an awesome tour guide and his live commentary was engaging and informative! We had a great day seeing all of the places that we most wanted to see in London. I highly recommend this tour.

My wife and I have been to London several times but have never tried the big bus daytime tour. We had a day trip cancelled but have seen the London sights many times. So we decided to try the big bus 2 day package.
We rode the red line through it’s entire route. We did not hop off and on as the weather and temperature was typically spring and for the same reason we did not take the Thames boat tour but have done so in the past.
Overall we enjoyed this tour very much and found our live guide to be very informative and entertaining.
I think this would be a very good way to take in the sights, hopping on and off at each sight as you wish and the Thames river tour and their night tour are great options.
For the price I would highly recommended this tour to any of our friends or family.

Included in my London Pass. A fantastic way to learn the layout the city and where the places you want to see are in relation to one another. The guides a very good and the tour comes in multiple languages via your headset. Keep in mind, this a nice, easy and inexpensive way to get around so expect the bus to get crowded especially in the afternoon and evening.

This is a TERRIBLE company! They will make you change your bus all the time. We wait lot of time for an empty bus and 3 stops later they make us change bus and we just get terrible spot.
They say they have wifi but only works in a FEW bus stops and not on the road
We get a broke bus and the sound just stop working.
I’ll never use this company again and I don’t recommend to anyone!

We did the 2 day tour with boat trip. The buses were very regular and the guides were interesting and funny on each one, they really knew their stuff. The boat trip was very relaxing to do on the way back to the hotel at the end of the day. Very impressed.

Organisation is totally lacking! The bus stops are not numbered and the descriptions of their locations is not very accurate. For example the red line stop 11 is described as “opposite the Royal Horseguards” when it is significantly further down the road. Some buses have no commentary which is really poor and we were unable to get on the green line - none of the big bus staff could tell us what was going on or why the route was closed. One red line bus had a guide by the name of Roxanne and her “commentary” was dreadful. She needs to be properly trained! We ended up unplugging the headphones and got off the bus and walked places instead.

We used several buses. all the tour guides were very knowledgeable about not just the sights but local items. Emma, was the best of the day, a great tour guide who added personal stories and humor into the tour as well.

The tour was really expensive for what it was. The tour guide appeared drunk and you could hardly hear him. Headphones were not provided. The trip is mainly around what felt like back streets and you don’t get to see the front of the palace as an example. Can not recommend.

This was the perfect way to start a beautiful holiday in London, since I have never been there the bus tour was excellent to get an indication and idea of what’s where in London. The commentators are world class with a great sense of humor and very helpful. I will recommend this to any new tourist in London it’s definitely worth the money.
It takes you around central London and you can see and learn so much from the roof of these stunning busses also the commentary is available in 12 different languages.

My daughter and I rode the Big Bus and it was a good experience. We have rode them in other countries and this was the first time that we had a guide on every bus and each one was personable. It would be great if there was some type of bus tracker so we could know when a bus was coming instead of waiting as we waited a half hour for one bus and could have used that time in a nearby store. They should also use technology and have some type of scanner for online tickets as you lose your ability to ride if you lose your ticket.
